text: What then? Israel has not obtained that which it seeks, but the election obtained [it], and the rest were hardened

title: Romans 11:8
text: even as it is written, "God gave to them a spirit of slumber, eyes not seeing, and ears not hearing" until this day.

title: Romans 11:9
text: And David said, "Let their table become for a snare and a trap and a stumbling block and a recompense to them.

title: Romans 11:10
text: Let their eyes be darkened so that they may not see, and their back always bowing."

title: Romans 11:11
text: I say then, Did they not stumble that they fall? Let it not be! But by their slipping away came salvation to the nations, to provoke them to jealousy.

title: Romans 11:12
text: But if their slipping away [is] the riches of [the] world, and their default is [the] riches of [the] nations, how much more their fullness?

title: Romans 11:13
text: For I speak to you, the nations; since I am the apostle of the nations, I glorify my ministry;

title: Romans 11:14
text: if by any means I may provoke [those who are] my flesh to jealousy, and might save some of them.

title: Romans 11:15
text: For if their casting away [is the] reconciling of [the] world, what [is] the reception except life from [the] dead?

title: Romans 11:16
text: For if the firstfruit [is] holy, the lump [is] also [holy]; and if the root [is] holy, also the branches.

title: Romans 11:17
text: And if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive tree, were grafted in among them, and became a sharer of the root and the fatness of the olive tree with them,

title: Romans 11:18
text: do not boast against the branches. But if you boast, [it is] not you [that] bears the root, but the root bears you.

title: Romans 11:19
text: You will say then, The branches were broken off so that I might be grafted in.

title: Romans 11:20
text: Well, because of unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by faith. Do not [be] high-minded, but fear.

title: Romans 11:21
text: For if God did not spare the natural branches, [fear] lest He also may not spare you either!

title: Romans 11:22
text: Behold then [the] kindness, and [the] severity of God; on those having fallen, severity; but on you, kindness, if you continue in the kindness. Otherwise you also will be cut off.

title: Romans 11:23
text: And those also, if they do not continue in unbelief, will be grafted in. For God is able to graft them in again.

title: Romans 11:24
text: For if you were cut out of the natural wild olive [tree], and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive [tree]; how much more these [being] according to nature will be grafted into [their] own olive-tree?

title: Romans 11:25
text: For I do not want you to be ignorant of this mystery, brothers, lest you should be wise within yourselves; that blindness in part has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the nations has comes in.

title: Romans 11:26
text: And so all Israel shall be saved; as it is written, "There shall come out of Zion the Deliverer, and He will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

title: Romans 11:27
text: For this [is] My covenant with them, when I have taken away their sins."

title: Romans 11:28
text: Indeed as regards the gospel, [they are] enemies for your sakes. But as regards the election, [they are] beloved for the fathers' sakes.

title: Romans 11:29
text: For the free gifts and calling of God [are] without repentance.

title: Romans 11:30
text: For as you also then disbelieved God, but now have been shown mercy through their disbelief,

title: Romans 11:31
text: even so these also have not believed now, so that through your mercy they may also obtain mercy.

title: Romans 11:32
text: For God has shut up all in unbelief, so that He might show mercy to all.

title: Romans 11:33
text: O [the] depth of [the] riches both of [the] wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable [are] His judgments, and His ways past finding out!

title: Romans 11:34
text: For who has known the mind of [the] Lord, or who became His counselor?

title: Romans 11:35
text: Or who first gave to Him, and it will be repaid to him?

title: Romans 11:36
text: For of Him and through Him and to Him [are] all things; to Him be glory forever! Amen.

title: Romans 12:1
text: I beseech you therefore, brothers, by the mercies of God to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, pleasing to God, [which is] your reasonable service.

title: Romans 12:2
text: And do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, in order to prove by you what [is] that good and pleasing and perfect will of God.

title: Romans 12:3
text: For I say, through the grace given to me, to every one who is among you, not to think [of himself] more highly than he ought to think. But set your mind to be right-minded, even as God has dealt to every man the measure of faith.

title: Romans 12:4
text: For even as we have many members in one body, and all members do not have the same function,

title: Romans 12:5
text: so we the many are one body in Christ, and each one members of one another.

title: Romans 12:6
text: Then having gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, if prophecy, according to the proportion of faith;

title: Romans 12:7
text: or ministry, in the ministry; or [he who] teaches, in the teaching;

title: Romans 12:8
text: or he who exhorts, in the encouragement; or he who shares, in simplicity; or he who takes the lead, in diligence; or he who shows mercy, in cheerfulness.

title: Romans 12:9
text: [Let] love [be] without hypocrisy, shrinking from evil, cleaving to good;

title: Romans 12:10
text: in brotherly love to one another, loving fervently, having led one another in honor.

title: Romans 12:11
text: As to diligence, not slothful, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord;

title: Romans 12:12
text: rejoicing in hope, patient in affliction, steadfastly continuing in prayer,

title: Romans 12:13
text: distributing to the needs of the saints, pursuing hospitality.

title: Romans 12:14
text: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and do not curse.

title: Romans 12:15
text: Rejoice with rejoicing ones, and weep with weeping ones;

title: Romans 12:16
text: minding the same thing toward one another, not minding high things, but yielding to the lowly. Do not be wise within yourselves.

title: Romans 12:17
text: Repay no one evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.

title: Romans 12:18
text: If [it is] possible, as far as [is] in you, seeking peace with all men.

title: Romans 12:19
text: not avenging yourselves, beloved, but giving place to wrath; for it is written, "Vengeance [is] Mine, I will repay, says [the] Lord."

title: Romans 12:20
text: Therefore if your enemy hungers, feed him. If he thirsts, give him drink. For [in so] doing you shall heap coals of fire on his head.

title: Romans 12:21
text: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

title: Romans 13:1
text: Let every soul be subject to the higher authorities. For there is no authority but of God; the authorities that exist are ordained by God.

title: Romans 13:2
text: So that the one resisting the authority resists the ordinance of God; and the ones who resist will receive judgment to themselves.

title: Romans 13:3
text: For the rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the bad. And do you desire to be not afraid of the authority? Do the good, and you shall have praise from it.

title: Romans 13:4
text: For it is a servant of God to you for good. For if you practice evil, be afraid, for it does not bear the sword in vain; for it is a servant of God, a revenger for wrath on him who does evil.

title: Romans 13:5
text: Therefore [you] must be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience' sake.

title: Romans 13:6
text: For because of this you also pay taxes. For they are God's servants, always giving attention to this very thing.

title: Romans 13:7
text: Therefore give to all [their] dues; to the [one due] tax, the tax; tribute to whom tribute [is due], fear to whom fear [is due], and honor to whom honor [is due].

title: Romans 13:8
text: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves another has fulfilled the law.

title: Romans 13:9
text: For: "Do not commit adultery; do not murder; do not steal; do not bear false witness; do not lust;" and if [there is] any other commandment, it is summed up in this word, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."

title: Romans 13:10
text: Love works no ill to its neighbor, therefore love [is] the fulfilling of the law.

title: Romans 13:11
text: This also, knowing the time, that [it is] already time to awake out of sleep; for now our salvation [is] nearer than when we believed.

title: Romans 13:12
text: The night [is] far spent, the day is at hand; therefore let us cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armor of light.

title: Romans 13:13
text: Let us walk becomingly, as in [the] day; not in carousings and drinking; not in co-habitation and lustful acts; not in strife and envy.

title: Romans 13:14
text: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and do not take thought beforehand for the lusts of the flesh.

title: Romans 14:1
text: And receive him who is weak in the faith, [but] not to judgments of [your] thoughts.

title: Romans 14:2
text: For indeed one believes to eat all things; but being weak, [another] eats vegetables.

title: Romans 14:3
text: Do not let him who eats despise him who does not eat; and do not let him who does not eat judge him who eats, for God has received him.

title: Romans 14:4
text: Who are you that judges another's servant? To his own master he stands or falls. But he will stand, for God is able to make him stand.

title: Romans 14:5
text: One indeed esteems a day above [another] day; and [another] esteems every day [alike]. Let each one be fully assured in his own mind.

title: Romans 14:6
text: He who regards the day regards [it] to the Lord; and he not regarding the day, does not regard [it] to the Lord. He who eats, eats to [the] Lord, for he gives God thanks; and he who does not eat, does not eat to [the] Lord, and gives God thanks.

title: Romans 14:7
text: For none of us lives to himself, and no one dies to himself.

title: Romans 14:8
text: For both if we live, we live to [the] Lord; and if we die, we die to [the] Lord. Therefore both if we live, and if we die, we are the Lord's.

title: Romans 14:9
text: For this Christ both died and rose and lived again, that He might be Lord both of [the] dead and living.

title: Romans 14:10
text: But why do you judge your brother? Or also why do you despise your brother? For all shall stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

title: Romans 14:11
text: For it is written, "[As] I live, says the Lord, every knee shall bow to Me, and every tongue shall confess to God."

title: Romans 14:12
text: So then each one of us will give account concerning himself to God.

title: Romans 14:13
text: Then let us not judge one another any more, but rather judge this, not to put a stumbling-block or an offense toward his brother.

title: Romans 14:14
text: I know and am persuaded in [the] Lord Jesus, that nothing by itself [is] common; except to him who esteems anything to be common, [it is] common.

title: Romans 14:15
text: But if your brother is grieved with [your] food, you no longer walk according to love. Do not with your food destroy him for whom Christ died.

title: Romans 14:16
text: Then do not let your good be spoken evil of,

title: Romans 14:17
text: for the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in [the] Holy Spirit.

title: Romans 14:18
text: For he who serves Christ in these things [is] well-pleasing to God, and approved by men.

title: Romans 14:19
text: So then let us pursue the things of peace, and the things for building up one another.

title: Romans 14:20
text: Do not undo the work of God for food. Truly, all things indeed [are] clean, but [it is] bad to the man eating because of a stumbling-block.

title: Romans 14:21
text: [It is] good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor [anything] by which your brother stumbles, or is offended, or is made weak.

title: Romans 14:22
text: Do you have faith? Have [it] to yourself before God. Blessed [is] he who does not condemn himself in what he approves.

title: Romans 14:23
text: But, the one doubting, if he eats, [he] has been condemned, because it is not of faith; and all that [is] not of faith is sin.

title: Romans 15:1
text: Then we who are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

title: Romans 15:2
text: Let every one of us please [his] neighbor for [his] good, to building up.

title: Romans 15:3
text: For even Christ did not please Himself; but as it is written, "The reproaches of those who reproached You fell on Me."

title: Romans 15:4
text: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, so that we through patience and comfort of the Scriptures might have hope.

title: Romans 15:5
text: And may the God of patience and consolation grant you to be like minded toward one another according to Christ Jesus,

title: Romans 15:6
text: so that with one mind [and] one mouth you may glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Romans 15:7
text: Therefore receive one another as Christ also received us, to [the] glory of God.

title: Romans 15:8
text: And I say, Jesus Christ has become a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises [made] to the fathers,

title: Romans 15:9
text: and that the nations might glorify God for [His] mercy, as it is written, "For this cause I will confess to You in the nations, and I will praise Your name."

title: Romans 15:10
text: And again He says, "Rejoice, O nations, with His people."

title: Romans 15:11
text: And again, "Praise the Lord, all the nations, and praise Him, all the peoples."

title: Romans 15:12
text: And again Isaiah says, "There shall be a root of Jesse, and He who shall rise to reign over the nations, in Him shall the nations trust."

title: Romans 15:13
text: And may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope through the power of [the] Holy Spirit.

title: Romans 15:14
text: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brothers, that you also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

title: Romans 15:15
text: But, brothers, I wrote to you boldly, as reminding you in part, because of the grace that is given to me by God,

title: Romans 15:16
text: that I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the nations, ministering the gospel of God, so that the offering up of the nations might be acceptable, being sanctified by [the] Holy Spirit.

title: Romans 15:17
text: Therefore I have boasting in Christ Jesus [as to] the things pertaining to God.

title: Romans 15:18
text: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ did not work out by me for [the] obedience of the nations in word and deed,

title: Romans 15:19
text: in power of miracles and wonders, in power of [the] Spirit of God, so that from Jerusalem, and all around to Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.

title: Romans 15:20
text: Yea, so I have been eager to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build on another man's foundation;

title: Romans 15:21
text: but as it is written, "To whom nothing was said about Him, they shall see. And they who have not heard shall understand."

title: Romans 15:22
text: For this cause I also have been greatly hindered from coming to you.

title: Romans 15:23
text: But now, having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come to you,

title: Romans 15:24
text: whenever I may go into Spain, I will come to you. For [in] traveling through I hope to see you, and to be set forward there by you, if first I may be filled of you in part.

title: Romans 15:25
text: But now I am going to Jerusalem to minister to the saints.

title: Romans 15:26
text: For it has pleased those of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints in Jerusalem.

title: Romans 15:27
text: Truly it has pleased them, and they are their debtors. For if the nations have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister to them in carnal things.

title: Romans 15:28
text: Therefore when I have completed this, and have sealed this fruit to them, I will come by you into Spain.

title: Romans 15:29
text: And I am sure that when I come to you, I shall come in the fullness of [the] blessing of the gospel of Christ.

title: Romans 15:30
text: But I exhort you, brothers, for the sake of the Lord Jesus Christ and for the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in [your] prayers to God for me,

title: Romans 15:31
text: that I may be delivered from those disbelieving in Judea, and that my service which [I have] for Jerusalem may be accepted by the saints;

title: Romans 15:32
text: so that [I may] come to you with joy by [the] will of God, and may be refreshed with you.

title: Romans 15:33
text: Now may the God of peace [be] with you all. Amen.

title: Romans 16:1
text: I commend to you Phoebe our sister, who is a servant of the church in Cenchrea,

title: Romans 16:2
text: that you receive her in [the] Lord, [as] becomes saints, and that you may assist her in whatever business she has need of you. For she has been a helper of many, and of myself also.

title: Romans 16:3
text: Greet Priscilla and Aquila, my helpers in Christ Jesus,

title: Romans 16:4
text: who have laid down their own necks for my life; to whom not only I give thanks, but also the churches of the nations.

title: Romans 16:5
text: Likewise [greet] the church that is in their house. Greet my beloved Epenetus, who is the first-fruits of Achaia to Christ.

title: Romans 16:6
text: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labor on us.

title: Romans 16:7
text: Greet Andronicus and Junias, my kinsmen and my fellow prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

title: Romans 16:8
text: Greet Amplias my beloved in [the] Lord.

title: Romans 16:9
text: Greet Urbanus, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

title: Romans 16:10
text: Greet Apelles, approved in Christ. Greet those who are of Aristobulus' [household].

title: Romans 16:11
text: Greet Herodion my kinsman. Greet those who are of the [household] of Narcissus, who are in [the] Lord.

title: Romans 16:12
text: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labor in [the] Lord. Greet the beloved Persis, who labored much in [the] Lord.

title: Romans 16:13
text: Greet Rufus, chosen in [the] Lord, and his mother and mine.

title: Romans 16:14
text: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brothers with them.

title: Romans 16:15
text: Greet Philologus and Julias, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints with them.

title: Romans 16:16
text: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The churches of Christ greet you.

title: Romans 16:17
text: And I exhort you, brothers, to watch those making divisions and offenses contrary to the doctrine which you have learned, and avoid them.

title: Romans 16:18
text: For they who are such do not serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches [they] deceive the hearts of the simple.

title: Romans 16:19
text: For your obedience reached to all. Therefore I am glad on your behalf, But I would have you truly wise [as] to good, and simple toward evil.

title: Romans 16:20
text: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you. Amen.

title: Romans 16:21
text: Timothy my fellow worker, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater my kinsmen, greet you.

title: Romans 16:22
text: I, Tertius, who wrote [this] epistle, greet you in [the] Lord.

title: Romans 16:23
text: Gaius my host, and the host of me and the whole church, greets you. Erastus the steward of the city greets you, and Quartus a brother.

title: Romans 16:24
text: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you all. Amen.

title: Romans 16:25
text: Now to Him who is able to establish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ according to the revelation of [the] mystery, having been unvoiced during eternal times;

title: Romans 16:26
text: but now has been made plain, and by the prophetic Scriptures, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith;

title: Romans 16:27
text: to God only wise [be] glory through Jesus Christ forever. Amen.

title: I Corinthians 1:1
text: Paul, a called apostle of Jesus Christ through [the] will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,

title: I Corinthians 1:2
text: to the church of God which is in Corinth, to those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called-out saints, with all those in every place who call on the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours.

title: I Corinthians 1:3
text: Grace [be] to you, and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: I Corinthians 1:4
text: I thank my God always on your behalf [for] the grace of God given you in Jesus Christ,

title: I Corinthians 1:5
text: that in everything you are enriched by Him, [in] all speech and in all knowledge;

title: I Corinthians 1:6
text: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you;

title: I Corinthians 1:7
text: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: I Corinthians 1:8
text: He shall also confirm you to [the] end, [that you may be] blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: I Corinthians 1:9
text: God [is] faithful, by whom you were called to [the] fellowship of His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

title: I Corinthians 1:10
text: But I exhort you, brothers, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, [that] you all speak the same thing and that there be no divisions among you; but that you be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

title: I Corinthians 1:11
text: For it has been declared to me concerning you, my brothers, by those of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.

title: I Corinthians 1:12
text: But I say this, that every one of you says, I am of Paul, and I of Apollos, and I of Cephas, and I of Christ.

title: I Corinthians 1:13
text: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you, or were you baptized in the name of Paul?

title: I Corinthians 1:14
text: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,

title: I Corinthians 1:15
text: lest any should say that I had baptized in my own name.

title: I Corinthians 1:16
text: And I also baptized the household of Stephanas. Besides these, I do not know if I baptized any other.

title: I Corinthians 1:17
text: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel; not in wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of no effect.

title: I Corinthians 1:18
text: For the preaching of the cross is foolishness to those being lost, but to us being saved, [it is] the power of God.

title: I Corinthians 1:19
text: For it is written, "I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and I will set aside the understanding of the perceiving ones."

title: I Corinthians 1:20
text: Where [is the] wise? Where [is] the scribe? Where [is] the lawyer of this world? Has not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

title: I Corinthians 1:21
text: For since, in the wisdom of God, the world [by] wisdom did not know God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save those who believe.

title: I Corinthians 1:22
text: For the Jews ask for a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom;

title: I Corinthians 1:23
text: but we preach Christ crucified, to the Jews a stumbling block, and to the Greeks foolishness.

title: I Corinthians 1:24
text: But to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God.

title: I Corinthians 1:25
text: Because the foolish thing of God is wiser [than] men, and the weak thing of God is stronger than men.

title: I Corinthians 1:26
text: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many wise men according to the flesh [are called], not many mighty, not many noble.

title: I Corinthians 1:27
text: But God has chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God has chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;

title: I Corinthians 1:28
text: and God has chosen the base things of the world, and things which are despised, and things which are not, in order to bring to nothing things that are;

title: I Corinthians 1:29
text: so that no flesh should glory in His presence.

title: I Corinthians 1:30
text: But of Him you are in Christ Jesus, who of God is made to us wisdom and righteousness and sanctification and redemption;

title: I Corinthians 1:31
text: so that, according as it is written, "He who glories, let him glory in [the] Lord."

title: I Corinthians 2:1
text: And I, brothers, when I came to you, did not come with excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring to you the testimony of God.

title: I Corinthians 2:2
text: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and Him crucified.

title: I Corinthians 2:3
text: And I was with you in weakness and in fear, and in much trembling.

title: I Corinthians 2:4
text: And my speech and my preaching [was] not with enticing words of men's wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,

title: I Corinthians 2:5
text: so that your faith should not stand in [the] wisdom of men, but in [the] power of God.

title: I Corinthians 2:6
text: But, we speak wisdom among those who are perfect; yet not the wisdom of this world, nor of the rulers of this world, that come to nothing.

title: I Corinthians 2:7
text: But we speak [the] wisdom of God in a mystery, which God has hidden, predetermining it before the world for our glory;

title: I Corinthians 2:8
text: which none of the rulers of this world knew (for if they had known, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory).

title: I Corinthians 2:9
text: But as it is written, "Eye has not seen, nor ear heard," nor has it entered into the heart of man, "the things which God has prepared for those who love Him."

title: I Corinthians 2:10
text: But God has revealed [them] to us by His Spirit; for the Spirit searches all things, yea, the deep things of God.

title: I Corinthians 2:11
text: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of man within him? So also no one knows the things of God except the Spirit of God.

title: I Corinthians 2:12
text: But we have not received the spirit of the world, but the Spirit from God, so that we might know the things that are freely given to us by God.

title: I Corinthians 2:13
text: These things we also speak, not in words which man's wisdom teaches, but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual.

title: I Corinthians 2:14
text: But the natural man does not receive the things of [the] Spirit of God, for they are foolishness to him; neither can he know [them], because they are spiritually discerned.

title: I Corinthians 2:15
text: But he who is spiritual judges all things, yet he himself is judged by no man.

title: I Corinthians 2:16
text: For who has known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct Him? But we have the mind of Christ.

title: I Corinthians 3:1
text: And I, brothers, could not speak to you as to spiritual ones, but as to carnal, as to babes in Christ.

title: I Corinthians 3:2
text: I have fed you with milk and not with solid food, for you were not yet able [to bear it]; nor are you able even now.

title: I Corinthians 3:3
text: For you are yet carnal. For in that [there is] among you envyings and strife and divisions, are you not carnal, and [do you not] walk according to men?

title: I Corinthians 3:4
text: For while one says, I am of Paul; and another, I [am] of Apollos; are you not carnal?

title: I Corinthians 3:5
text: Who then is Paul, and who [is] Apollos, but ministers by whom you believed, even to each the Lord gave?

title: I Corinthians 3:6
text: I have planted, Apollos watered, but God gave the increase.

title: I Corinthians 3:7
text: So then neither is he who plants anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

title: I Corinthians 3:8
text: So he planting, and he watering, are one, and each one shall receive [his] own reward according to [his] own labor.

title: I Corinthians 3:9
text: For we are fellow-workers of God, a field of God, and you are a building of God.

title: I Corinthians 3:10
text: According to the grace of God which is given to me, as a wise master builder, I have laid the foundation, and another builds [on it]. But let every man be careful how he builds [on it].

title: I Corinthians 3:11
text: For any other foundation can no one lay than that which is laid, which is Jesus Christ.

title: I Corinthians 3:12
text: And if anyone builds on this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble,

title: I Corinthians 3:13
text: each one's work shall be revealed. For the Day shall declare [it], because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try each one's work as to what kind it is.

title: I Corinthians 3:14
text: If anyone's work which he built remains, he shall receive a reward.

title: I Corinthians 3:15
text: If anyone's work shall be burned up, he shall suffer loss. But he shall be saved, yet so as by fire.

title: I Corinthians 3:16
text: Do you not know that you are a temple of God, and [that] the Spirit of God dwells in you?

title: I Corinthians 3:17
text: If anyone defiles the temple of God, God shall destroy him. For the temple of God is holy, which you are.

title: I Corinthians 3:18
text: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone among you seems to be wise in this world, let him become a fool so that he may be wise.

title: I Corinthians 3:19
text: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God; for it is written, "He takes the wise in their own craftiness."

title: I Corinthians 3:20
text: And again, "[The] Lord knows the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain."

title: I Corinthians 3:21
text: Therefore let no one glory in men. For all things are yours,

title: I Corinthians 3:22
text: whether it is Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or [the] world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours,

title: I Corinthians 3:23
text: and you are Christ's, and Christ [is] God's.

title: I Corinthians 4:1
text: So let a man think of us as ministers of Christ and stewards of [the] mysteries of God.

title: I Corinthians 4:2
text: And the rest, it is sought among stewards that a one be found faithful.

title: I Corinthians 4:3
text: But to me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a man's day; yea, I do not judge my own self,

title: I Corinthians 4:4
text: for I know nothing by myself. Yet I have not been justified by this, but He who judges me is [the] Lord.

title: I Corinthians 4:5
text: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts. And then shall each one have praise of God.

title: I Corinthians 4:6
text: And these things, brothers, I have [in a figure] transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, so that you might learn in us not to think [of men] above that which is written, so that no one of you may [be] puffed up against one another.

title: I Corinthians 4:7
text: For who makes you to differ [from another]? And what do you have that you did not receive? And if you did receive [it], why do you boast as [if you] had not received it?

title: I Corinthians 4:8
text: Already you are full! Already you are rich! You have reigned [as kings] without us! And I would to God that indeed you did reign, that we also might reign with you.

title: I Corinthians 4:9
text: For I think that God has set forth us last, the apostles, as it were appointed to death; for we have become a spectacle to the world and to angels and to men.

title: I Corinthians 4:10
text: We [are] fools for Christ's sake, but you [are] wise in Christ. We [are] weak, but you [are] strong. You [are] honorable, but we [are] despised.

title: I Corinthians 4:11
text: Even until this present hour we both hunger and thirst and are naked and are buffeted and have no certain dwelling place.

title: I Corinthians 4:12
text: And we labor, working with our own hands. Being reviled, we bless; being persecuted, we suffer it;

title: I Corinthians 4:13
text: being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the offscouring of all [things] until now.

title: I Corinthians 4:14
text: I do not write these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn [you].

title: I Corinthians 4:15
text: For though you have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet [you do] not [have] many fathers; for I have begotten you in Christ Jesus through the gospel.

title: I Corinthians 4:16
text: Therefore I beseech you, be imitators of me.

title: I Corinthians 4:17
text: For this cause I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved son and faithful in [the] Lord, who shall remind you [of] my ways which are in Christ, as I teach everywhere in every church.

title: I Corinthians 4:18
text: As to my not coming to you now, some are puffed up.

title: I Corinthians 4:19
text: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord wills. And I will not know the speech of those who are puffed up, but the power.

title: I Corinthians 4:20
text: For the kingdom of God [is] not in word, but in power.

title: I Corinthians 4:21
text: What do you desire? Shall I come to you with a rod, or [in] love and the spirit of meekness?

title: I Corinthians 5:1
text: Everywhere [it is] reported [that there is] fornication among you, and such fornication as is not named among the nations, so as one to have [his] father's wife.

title: I Corinthians 5:2
text: And you are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, so that he who has done this deed may be taken from your midst.

title: I Corinthians 5:3
text: For as being absent in body but present in spirit, I indeed have judged already [as though I were] present [concerning] him who worked out this thing;

title: I Corinthians 5:4
text: in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together, with my spirit; also, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ;

title: I Corinthians 5:5
text: to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

title: I Corinthians 5:6
text: Your boasting [is] not good. Do you not know that a little leaven leavens the whole lump?

title: I Corinthians 5:7
text: Therefore purge out the old leaven so that you may be a new lump, as you are unleavened. For also Christ our Passover is sacrificed for us.

title: I Corinthians 5:8
text: Therefore let us keep [the] feast; not with old leaven, nor with the leaven of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened [bread] of sincerity and truth.

title: I Corinthians 5:9
text: I wrote to you in the letter not to associate intimately with fornicators;

title: I Corinthians 5:10
text: yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world, or with the covetous, or extortioners, or with idolaters; for then you must go out of the world.

title: I Corinthians 5:11
text: But now I have written to you not to associate intimately, if any man called a brother [and is] either a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a reviler, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such a one not to eat.

title: I Corinthians 5:12
text: For what [is it] to me to also judge those who are outside? Do you not judge those who are inside?

title: I Corinthians 5:13
text: But God judges those who are outside. Therefore put out from you the evil one.

title: I Corinthians 6:1
text: Do any of you dare, when you have a matter against another, to go to law before the unjust, and not before the saints?

title: I Corinthians 6:2
text: Do you not know that the saints shall judge the world? And if the world shall be judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

title: I Corinthians 6:3
text: Do you not know that we shall judge angels, not to speak of this life?

title: I Corinthians 6:4
text: If, then, you truly have judgments of [the things] of this life, set those who are least esteemed in the church [to judge].

title: I Corinthians 6:5
text: For I speak to your shame. [Is it] so [that] there is not a wise one among you, not even one in your midst who shall be able to judge between his brother?

title: I Corinthians 6:6
text: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before the unbelievers.

title: I Corinthians 6:7
text: Indeed then there is already a failure with you all, that you have lawsuits with yourselves. Why not instead be wronged? Why not instead be defrauded?

title: I Corinthians 6:8
text: But you do wrong and defraud, and these things to brothers.

title: I Corinthians 6:9
text: Do you not know that the unrighteous shall not inherit [the] kingdom of God? Do not be deceived; neither fornicators, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor abusers, nor homosexuals,

title: I Corinthians 6:10
text: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor revilers, nor extortioners, shall inherit [the] kingdom of God.

title: I Corinthians 6:11
text: And such were some of you. But you are washed, but you are sanctified, but you are justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and by the Spirit of our God.

title: I Corinthians 6:12
text: All things are lawful to me, but not all things profit. All things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of any.

title: I Corinthians 6:13
text: Meats for the belly and the belly for meats, but God shall destroy both it and them. But the body [is] not for fornication, but for the Lord; and the Lord is for the body.

title: I Corinthians 6:14
text: And God has both raised up the Lord, and also will raise us up by His own power.

title: I Corinthians 6:15
text: Do you not know that your bodies are the members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make [them] the members of a harlot? Let it not be!

title: I Corinthians 6:16
text: Or do you not know that he being joined to a harlot is one body? For He says, The two shall be one flesh.

title: I Corinthians 6:17
text: But he being joined to the Lord is one spirit.

title: I Corinthians 6:18
text: Flee fornication. Every sin that a man does is outside the body, but he who commits fornication sins against [his] own body.

title: I Corinthians 6:19
text: Or do you not know that your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit in you, whom you have of God? And you are not your own,

title: I Corinthians 6:20
text: for you are bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God's.

title: I Corinthians 7:1
text: Now concerning what you wrote to me: [It is] good for a man not to touch a woman.

title: I Corinthians 7:2
text: But, [to avoid] fornication, let each have his [own] wife, and let each have her own husband.

title: I Corinthians 7:3
text: Let the husband give to the wife proper kindness, and likewise the wife also to the husband.

title: I Corinthians 7:4
text: The wife does not have authority over [her] own body, but the husband. And likewise also the husband does not have power [over his] own body, but the wife.

title: I Corinthians 7:5
text: Do not deprive one another, unless [it is] with consent for a time, so that you may [give yourselves to] fasting and prayer. And come together again so that Satan does not tempt you for your incontinence.

title: I Corinthians 7:6
text: But I speak this by permission, not of commandment.

title: I Corinthians 7:7
text: For I would that all men were even as I myself am. But each has his proper gift from God, one according to this manner and another according to that.

title: I Corinthians 7:8
text: I say therefore to the unmarried and the widows, It is good for them if they remain even as I.

title: I Corinthians 7:9
text: But if they do not have self-control, let them marry; for it is better to marry than to burn.

title: I Corinthians 7:10
text: And to the married I command (not I, but the Lord), a woman not to be separated from [her] husband.

title: I Corinthians 7:11
text: But if she is indeed separated, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to [her] husband. And a husband is not to leave [his] wife.

title: I Corinthians 7:12
text: But to the rest I speak, not the Lord, If any brother has a wife who does not believe, and she is pleased to dwell with him, do not let him put her away.

title: I Corinthians 7:13
text: And the woman who has a husband who does not believe, if he is pleased to dwell with her, do not let her leave him.

title: I Corinthians 7:14
text: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband; else your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

title: I Corinthians 7:15
text: But if the unbelieving one separates, let [them] be separated. A brother or a sister is not in bondage in such [cases], but God has called us in peace.

title: I Corinthians 7:16
text: For what do you know, O wife, whether you shall save [your] husband? Or what do you know, O man, whether you shall save [your] wife?

title: I Corinthians 7:17
text: But as God has distributed to each one, as the Lord has called each one, so let him walk. And so I ordain in all churches.

title: I Corinthians 7:18
text: [Was] any called having been circumcised? Do not be uncircumcised. Was anyone called in uncircumcision? Do not be circumcised.

title: I Corinthians 7:19
text: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of God.

title: I Corinthians 7:20
text: Let each one remain in the calling in which he was called.

title: I Corinthians 7:21
text: Were you called as a slave? It does not matter to you, but if you are able to become free, use [it] rather.

title: I Corinthians 7:22
text: For he who is called a slave in [the] Lord is a freed man of [the] Lord. And likewise, he who is called a free man is a slave of Christ.

title: I Corinthians 7:23
text: You are bought with a price, do not be the slaves of men.

title: I Corinthians 7:24
text: Each in whatever way he was called, brothers, in this remain with God.

title: I Corinthians 7:25
text: But concerning virgins, I have no commandment from [the] Lord. Yet I give my judgment, as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be faithful.

title: I Corinthians 7:26
text: Then I think this is good, because of the present necessity; that [it is] good for a man to be so.

title: I Corinthians 7:27
text: Are you bound to a wife? Do not seek to be free. Are you freed from a wife? Do not seek a wife.

title: I Corinthians 7:28
text: But if you do marry, you have not sinned; and if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. But such shall have trouble in the flesh, but I spare you.

title: I Corinthians 7:29
text: But this I say, brothers, The time [is] short. It remains that both those who have wives should be as not having one.

title: I Corinthians 7:30
text: And they who weep are as [though they did] not weep. And they who rejoice are as [though they did] not rejoice. And they who buy are as though they did not possess.

title: I Corinthians 7:31
text: And they who use this world are as not abusing [it], for the fashion of this world is passing away.

title: I Corinthians 7:32
text: But I desire you to be without anxiety. The [one] who is unmarried cares for the things that belong to [the] Lord, how to please the Lord.

title: I Corinthians 7:33
text: But the [one] who is married cares for the things of the world, how to please [his] wife.

title: I Corinthians 7:34
text: The wife and the virgin [are] different. The unmarried woman cares for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares for the things of the world, how she may please [her] husband.

title: I Corinthians 7:35
text: And this I speak for your own profit, not that I may cast a snare on you, but for that which is right, and that you may attend on the Lord without distraction.

title: I Corinthians 7:36
text: But if anyone thinks [it] behaving himself indecently toward his virginity (if he is past [his] prime, and so it ought to be) let him do what he will; he does not sin; let them marry.

title: I Corinthians 7:37
text: But [he] who stands steadfast in his heart, having no necessity, but who has authority over [his] own will (and has so judged in his heart that he will keep his virginity) he does well.

title: I Corinthians 7:38
text: So then he who gives in marriage does well. But he who does not give in marriage does better.

title: I Corinthians 7:39
text: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband lives, but if her husband is dead, she is at liberty to be remarried to whom she will, only in the Lord.

title: I Corinthians 7:40
text: But she is happier if she so remains, according to my judgment. And I also think that I have [the] Spirit of God.

title: I Corinthians 8:1
text: But concerning the sacrifices to idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love edifies.

title: I Corinthians 8:2
text: And if any man thinks that he knows anything, he knows nothing yet as he ought to know.

title: I Corinthians 8:3
text: But if any one loves God, he has been known of him.

title: I Corinthians 8:4
text: Then concerning the eating of the things sacrificed to idols, we know that an idol [is] nothing in [the] world, and that [there] is no other God except one.

title: I Corinthians 8:5
text: For though there are those who are called gods, whether in Heaven or in earth (as there are many gods and many lords),

title: I Corinthians 8:6
text: [there is] to us [only] one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in Him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we by Him.

title: I Corinthians 8:7
text: But this knowledge [is] not in all. But some being aware of the idol eat as an idolatrous sacrifice until now, and their conscience being weak is defiled.

title: I Corinthians 8:8
text: But food does not commend us to God. For neither if we eat are we the better, nor if we do not eat are we the worse.

title: I Corinthians 8:9
text: But take heed lest by any means this liberty of yours becomes a stumbling block to those who are weak.

title: I Corinthians 8:10
text: For if anyone sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol temple, will not the weak one's conscience be lifted up so as to eat things sacrificed to idols?

title: I Corinthians 8:11
text: And on your knowledge the weak brother will fall, he for whom Christ died.

title: I Corinthians 8:12
text: And sinning in this way against [your] brothers, and wounding their conscience, being weak, you sin against Christ.

title: I Corinthians 8:13
text: Therefore, if food offends my brother, I will eat no flesh forever, that I do not offend my brother.

title: I Corinthians 9:1
text: Am I not an apostle? Am I not free? Have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? Are you not my work in [the] Lord?

title: I Corinthians 9:2
text: If I am not an apostle to others, yet doubtless I am to you, for you are the seal of my apostleship in [the] Lord.

title: I Corinthians 9:3
text: My answer to those who examine me is this:

title: I Corinthians 9:4
text: Do we not have authority to eat and to drink?

title: I Corinthians 9:5
text: Do we not have authority to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and [as] the brothers of the Lord do, and Cephas?

title: I Corinthians 9:6
text: Or [is it] only Barnabas and I [who] have no authority to cease working?

title: I Corinthians 9:7
text: Who serves as a soldier at his own wages at any time? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock and does not partake of the milk of the flock?

title: I Corinthians 9:8
text: Do I say these things according to man? Or does not the Law say the same also?

title: I Corinthians 9:9
text: For it is written in the law of Moses, "You shall not muzzle the mouth of the ox treading out grain." Does God take care for oxen?

title: I Corinthians 9:10
text: Or does He say [it] altogether for our sakes? It was written for us, so that he who plows should plow [in] hope, and so that he who threshes [in] hope should be partaker of his hope.

title: I Corinthians 9:11
text: If we have sown to you spiritual things, [is it] a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?

title: I Corinthians 9:12
text: If others have a share of [this] authority [over] you, rather [should] not we? But we have not used this authority, but we endured all things lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.

title: I Corinthians 9:13
text: Do you not know that those who minister about holy things live [of the things] of the temple? And those attending the altar are partakers with the altar.

title: I Corinthians 9:14
text: Even so, the Lord ordained those announcing the gospel to live from the gospel.

title: I Corinthians 9:15
text: But I have used none of these things, nor have I written these things that it should be done so to me; for [it is] good for me rather to die than that anyone nullify my glorying.

title: I Corinthians 9:16
text: For though I preach the gospel, no glory is to me. For necessity is laid on me; yea, woe is to me if I do not preach the gospel!

title: I Corinthians 9:17
text: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward; but if against my will, I am entrusted with a stewardship.

title: I Corinthians 9:18
text: What then is my reward? That when I preach the gospel I may make the gospel of Christ without charge, that I may not abuse my authority in the gospel.

title: I Corinthians 9:19
text: For though I am free from all, yet I have made myself servant to all, so that I might gain the more.

title: I Corinthians 9:20
text: And to the Jews I became as a Jew, so that I might gain the Jews. To those who are under the Law, [I became] as under the Law, so that I might gain those who are under the Law.

title: I Corinthians 9:21
text: To those who are outside Law, [I became] as outside Law (not being outside law to God, but under [the] law to Christ), so that I might gain those who are outside Law.

title: I Corinthians 9:22
text: To the weak I became as the weak, so that I might gain the weak. I am made all things to all [men], so that I might by all means save some.

title: I Corinthians 9:23
text: And this I do for the sake of the gospel, so that I might be partaker of it [with you].

title: I Corinthians 9:24
text: Do you not know that those running in a race all run, but one receives the prize? So run, that you may obtain.

title: I Corinthians 9:25
text: And everyone who strives for the mastery is temperate in all things. Then those truly that they may receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

title: I Corinthians 9:26
text: So then I run, not as if I were uncertain. And so I fight, not as [one who] beats the air.

title: I Corinthians 9:27
text: But I buffet my body, and lead [it] captive, lest proclaiming to others I myself might be rejected.

title: I Corinthians 10:1
text: And, brothers, I do not want you to be ignorant that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea.

title: I Corinthians 10:2
text: And all were baptized to Moses in the cloud and in the sea,

title: I Corinthians 10:3
text: and all ate the same spiritual food,

title: I Corinthians 10:4
text: and all drank the same spiritual drink; for they drank of the spiritual Rock that followed them, and that Rock was Christ.

title: I Corinthians 10:5
text: But with many of them God was not well pleased, for they were scattered in the wilderness.

title: I Corinthians 10:6
text: And these things were our examples, that we should not be lusters after evil, as they also lusted.

title: I Corinthians 10:7
text: Nor should we be idolaters, even as some of them, as it is written: "The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play."

title: I Corinthians 10:8
text: Nor let us commit fornication, as some of them fornicated, and twenty-three thousand fell in one day.

title: I Corinthians 10:9
text: Nor let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted Him and were destroyed by serpents.

title: I Corinthians 10:10
text: Nor murmur as some of them also murmured and were destroyed by the destroyer.

title: I Corinthians 10:11
text: And all these things happened to them [as] examples; and [it] is written for our warning on whom the ends of the world have come.

title: I Corinthians 10:12
text: So let him who thinks he stands take heed lest he fall.

title: I Corinthians 10:13
text: No temptation has taken you but [what is] common to man; but God [is] faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but with the temptation also will make a way to escape, so that you may be able to bear [it].

title: I Corinthians 10:14
text: Therefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.

title: I Corinthians 10:15
text: I speak as to wise men, you judge what I say.

title: I Corinthians 10:16
text: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?

title: I Corinthians 10:17
text: For we, the many, are one bread [and] one body; for we are all partakers of that one bread.

title: I Corinthians 10:18
text: Behold Israel after the flesh. Are not those who eat of the sacrifices also partakers of the altar?

title: I Corinthians 10:19
text: What then do I say? That the idol is anything, or that an idolatrous sacrifice is anything?

title: I Corinthians 10:20
text: But [I say] that the things which the nations sacrifice, [they] sacrifice to demons and not to God. And I do not desire that you should have fellowship with demons.

title: I Corinthians 10:21
text: You cannot drink [the] cup of the Lord and the cup of demons; you cannot be partakers of [the] Lord's table and of a table of demons.

title: I Corinthians 10:22
text: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than He?

title: I Corinthians 10:23
text: All things are lawful to me, but not all things profit. All things are lawful to me, but not all things build up.

title: I Corinthians 10:24
text: Let no one seek his own, but each one another's.

title: I Corinthians 10:25
text: Eat whatever is sold in the meat market, asking no question for conscience' sake;

title: I Corinthians 10:26
text: "for the earth [is] the Lord's, and the fullness of it."

title: I Corinthians 10:27
text: If any of those who do not believe invite you [to a feast], and if you are disposed to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for conscience' sake.

title: I Corinthians 10:28
text: But if anyone says to you, This is slain in sacrifice to idols, do not eat for the sake of him who showed [it], and for conscience' sake; "for the earth [is] the Lord's, and the fullness of it";

title: I Corinthians 10:29
text: conscience, I say, not your own, but the other's. For why is my liberty judged by another's conscience?

title: I Corinthians 10:30
text: For if I by grace am a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that [for] which I give thanks?

title: I Corinthians 10:31
text: Therefore whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

title: I Corinthians 10:32
text: Give no offense, either to the Jews, or to the Greeks or to the church of God;

title: I Corinthians 10:33
text: even as I please all [men] in all [things], not seeking my own profit, but the [profit] of many, so that they may be saved.

title: I Corinthians 11:1
text: Be imitators of me, even as I also [am] of Christ.

title: I Corinthians 11:2
text: But I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and you keep the doctrines as I delivered [them] to you.

title: I Corinthians 11:3
text: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman [is] the man; and the head of Christ [is] God.

title: I Corinthians 11:4
text: Every man praying or prophesying with [his] head covered dishonors his Head.

title: I Corinthians 11:5
text: But every woman who prays or prophesies with [her] head unveiled dishonors her head; for that is even the same as if she were shaved.

title: I Corinthians 11:6
text: For if the woman is not veiled, let her also be shorn. But [if it] is a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be veiled.

title: I Corinthians 11:7
text: For a man indeed ought not to have [his] head covered, because he is the image and glory of God. But the woman is [the] glory of [the] man.

title: I Corinthians 11:8
text: For the man is not of the woman, but the woman of the man.

title: I Corinthians 11:9
text: Nor was the man created for the woman, but the woman for the man.

title: I Corinthians 11:10
text: For this reason the woman ought to have authority on [her] head because of the angels.

title: I Corinthians 11:11
text: But neither is the man without the woman, nor the woman without the man, in the Lord.

title: I Corinthians 11:12
text: For as the woman [is] of the man, even so the man [is] also by the woman; but all things of God.

title: I Corinthians 11:13
text: Judge among yourselves: is it right that a woman pray to God unveiled?

title: I Corinthians 11:14
text: Does not even nature itself teach you that if man has long hair, it is a shame to him?

title: I Corinthians 11:15
text: But if a woman should have long hair, it is a glory to her; for her hair is given to her in place of a veil.

title: I Corinthians 11:16
text: But if anyone seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, nor the churches of God.

title: I Corinthians 11:17
text: But in enjoining this, I do not praise [you], because you come together not for the better, but for the worse.

title: I Corinthians 11:18
text: For first of all, when you come together in the church, I hear that there are divisions among you, and I partly believe it.

title: I Corinthians 11:19
text: For there must also be heresies among you, that the approved ones may be revealed among you.

title: I Corinthians 11:20
text: Therefore when you come together into one place, [this] is not to eat [the] Lord's supper.

title: I Corinthians 11:21
text: For in eating each one takes his own supper first; and one is hungry, and another drunken.

title: I Corinthians 11:22
text: For do you not have houses [in which] to eat and drink? Or do you despise the church of God, and shame those who do not have? What shall I say to you? Shall I praise you for this? I do not praise [you]!

title: I Corinthians 11:23
text: For I received from the Lord what I also delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus in the night in which he was betrayed took bread;

title: I Corinthians 11:24
text: And giving thanks, He broke [it] and said, "Take, eat; this is My body, which is broken for you; this do in remembrance of Me."

title: I Corinthians 11:25
text: In the same way [He took] the cup also, after supping, saying, "This cup is the New Covenant in My blood; as often as you drink it, do this in remembrance of Me."

title: I Corinthians 11:26
text: For "as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you show" the Lord's death until He shall come.

title: I Corinthians 11:27
text: So that whoever shall eat this bread and drink [this] cup of the Lord unworthily, he will be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.

title: I Corinthians 11:28
text: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of [that] bread and drink of that cup.

title: I Corinthians 11:29
text: For he who eats and drinks unworthily eats and drinks condemnation to himself, not discerning the Lord's body.

title: I Corinthians 11:30
text: For this cause many among you [are] weak and sickly, and many sleep.

title: I Corinthians 11:31
text: For if we would judge ourselves, we would not be judged.

title: I Corinthians 11:32
text: But when we are judged, we are chastened by [the] Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.

title: I Corinthians 11:33
text: So that, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

title: I Corinthians 11:34
text: But if anyone hungers, let him eat at home, so that you do not come together to condemnation. And the rest I will set in order when I come.

title: I Corinthians 12:1
text: Now concerning spiritual [gifts], brothers, I would not have you ignorant.

title: I Corinthians 12:2
text: You know that being led away, you nations were led to dumb idols.

title: I Corinthians 12:3
text: Therefore I make known to you that no one speaking by [the] Spirit of God says Jesus [is] a curse, and [that] no one can say that Jesus [is] Lord, but by the Holy Spirit.

title: I Corinthians 12:4
text: But there are differences of gifts, but the same Spirit.

title: I Corinthians 12:5
text: And there are differences of ministries, but the same Lord.

title: I Corinthians 12:6
text: And there are differences of workings, but it is the same God working all things in all.

title: I Corinthians 12:7
text: But to each one is given the showing forth of the Spirit to [our] profit.

title: I Corinthians 12:8
text: For through the Spirit is given to one a word of wisdom; and to another a word of knowledge, according to the same Spirit;

title: I Corinthians 12:9
text: and to another faith by the same Spirit; and to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;

title: I Corinthians 12:10
text: and to another workings of powers, to another prophecy; and to another discerning of spirits; and to another kinds of tongues; and to another the interpretation of tongues.

title: I Corinthians 12:11
text: But the one and the same Spirit works all these things, distributing separately to each one as He desires.

title: I Corinthians 12:12
text: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, [are] one body; so also [is] Christ.

title: I Corinthians 12:13
text: For also by one Spirit we are all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free, even all were made to drink into one Spirit.

title: I Corinthians 12:14
text: For the body is not one member, but many.

title: I Corinthians 12:15
text: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

title: I Corinthians 12:16
text: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

title: I Corinthians 12:17
text: If all the body [were] an eye, where [would be] the hearing? If all hearing, where [would be] the smelling?

title: I Corinthians 12:18
text: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body as it has pleased Him.

title: I Corinthians 12:19
text: And if they were all one member, where [would be] the body?

title: I Corinthians 12:20
text: But now indeed many [are] the members, yet only one body.

title: I Corinthians 12:21
text: And the eye cannot say to the hand, I have no need of you; nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

title: I Corinthians 12:22
text: But much rather the members of the body seeming to be weaker are necessary.

title: I Corinthians 12:23
text: And those [members] of the body which we think to be less honorable, on these we put more abundant honor around [them]. And our unpresentable [members] have more abundant propriety.

title: I Corinthians 12:24
text: For our presentable [members] have no need, but God tempered the body together, giving more abundant honor to the [member] having need;

title: I Corinthians 12:25
text: that there not be division in the body, but [that] the members should have the same care for one another.

title: I Corinthians 12:26
text: And if one member suffers, all the members suffer with [it]; if one member is glorified, all the members rejoice with [it].

title: I Corinthians 12:27
text: And you are the body of Christ, and members in part.

title: I Corinthians 12:28
text: And God set some in the church, firstly, apostles; secondly, prophets; thirdly, teachers, then works of power, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, kinds of languages.

title: I Corinthians 12:29
text: [Are] all apostles? [Are] all prophets? [Are] all teachers? [Are] all workers of power?

title: I Corinthians 12:30
text: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak languages? Do all interpret?

title: I Corinthians 12:31
text: But zealously strive after the better gifts. And yet I show to you a more excellent way.

title: I Corinthians 13:1
text: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I have become [as] sounding brass or a tinkling cymbal.

title: I Corinthians 13:2
text: And though I have prophecies, and understand all mysteries and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so as to move mountains, and do not have charity, I am nothing.

title: I Corinthians 13:3
text: And though I give out all my goods [to feed the poor], and though I deliver my body to be burned, and have not charity, I am profited nothing.

title: I Corinthians 13:4
text: Charity has patience, is kind; charity is not envious, is not vain, is not puffed up;

title: I Corinthians 13:5
text: does not behave indecently, does not seek her own, is not easily provoked, thinks no evil.

title: I Corinthians 13:6
text: Charity does not rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices in the truth,

title: I Corinthians 13:7
text: quietly covers all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

title: I Corinthians 13:8
text: Charity never fails. But if [there are] prophecies, they will be abolished; if tongues, they shall cease; if knowledge, it will be abolished.

title: I Corinthians 13:9
text: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.

title: I Corinthians 13:10
text: But when the perfect thing comes, then that which is in part will be caused to cease.

title: I Corinthians 13:11
text: When I was an infant, I spoke as an infant, I thought as an infant, I reasoned as an infant. But when I became a man, I did away with the things of an infant.

title: I Corinthians 13:12
text: For now we see in a mirror dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I shall fully know even as I also am fully known.

title: I Corinthians 13:13
text: And now faith, hope, charity, these three remain; but the greatest of these [is] charity.

title: I Corinthians 14:1
text: Follow after love and desire spiritual [things], but rather that you may prophesy.

title: I Corinthians 14:2
text: For he who speaks in a tongue does not speak to men but to God. For no one hears, but in spirit he speaks mysteries.

title: I Corinthians 14:3
text: But he who prophesies speaks to men [for] building up, and exhortation, and comfort.

title: I Corinthians 14:4
text: The one speaking in a tongue builds himself up, but he prophesying builds up a church.

title: I Corinthians 14:5
text: I wish all of you to speak in languages, but rather that you may prophesy; for greater [is] he prophesying than he speaking in tongues, unless he interpret so that the church may receive building up.

title: I Corinthians 14:6
text: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, what will I profit you, except I speak to you either in revelation, or in knowledge, or in prophecy, or in teaching?

title: I Corinthians 14:7
text: Yet lifeless things giving a sound, whether flute or harp, if they do not give a distinction in the sound, how will it be known what is being piped or harped?

title: I Corinthians 14:8
text: For also if a trumpet gives an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself for the battle?

title: I Corinthians 14:9
text: So also you, if you do not give a clear word through the language, how will it be known what [is] being said? For you will be speaking into the air.

title: I Corinthians 14:10
text: So it may be many kinds of sounds are in [the] world, and not one [is] without a distinct sound.

title: I Corinthians 14:11
text: Therefore if I do not know the power of the sound, I will be a foreigner to him speaking, and he speaking [will be] a foreigner to me.

title: I Corinthians 14:12
text: Even so you, since you are zealots of spiritual [things], seek to build up the church, in order that you may abound

title: I Corinthians 14:13
text: So then he speaking in a language, let him pray that he may interpret.

title: I Corinthians 14:14
text: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.

title: I Corinthians 14:15
text: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will also pray with the mind; I will sing with the spirit, and I will also sing with the mind.

title: I Corinthians 14:16
text: Else, if you bless in the spirit, he occupying the place of the unlearned, how will he say the amen at your giving of thanks, since he does not know what you say?

title: I Corinthians 14:17
text: For you truly give thanks well, but the other is not built up.

title: I Corinthians 14:18
text: I thank my God [that] I speak more languages than all of you;

title: I Corinthians 14:19
text: yet in a church I desire to speak five words with my mind, so that I might also teach others, than ten thousand words in a tongue.

title: I Corinthians 14:20
text: Brothers, do not be children in your minds, but in malice be like infants, and in your minds be mature.

title: I Corinthians 14:21
text: In the law it is written, "By other tongues and other lips I will speak to this people, and even so they will not hear Me, says the Lord."

title: I Corinthians 14:22
text: So that tongues are not a sign to those who believe, but to those who do not believe. But prophesying [is] not to those who do not believe, but to those who believe.

title: I Corinthians 14:23
text: Therefore if the whole church has come together, and all speak in languages, and if uninstructed ones or unbelievers come in, will they not say that you rave?

title: I Corinthians 14:24
text: But if all prophesy, and some unbeliever or one not instructed comes, he is convicted by all, he is judged by all.

title: I Corinthians 14:25
text: And so the secrets of his heart become revealed. And so, falling down on [his] face, he will worship God and report that God is truly among you.

title: I Corinthians 14:26
text: Then how is it, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a tongue, has a revelation, has an interpretation. Let all things be for building up.

title: I Corinthians 14:27
text: If one speaks in a language, [let it be] by two, or [at] the most three, and in succession. And let one interpret.

title: I Corinthians 14:28
text: But if there is no interpreter, let him be silent in a church; and let him speak to himself and to God.

title: I Corinthians 14:29
text: And [if there are] two or three prophets, let them speak, and let the others judge.

title: I Corinthians 14:30
text: If [a revelation] is revealed to another sitting by, let the first be silent.

title: I Corinthians 14:31
text: For you may all prophesy one by one, so that all may learn and all may be comforted.

title: I Corinthians 14:32
text: And the spirits of the prophets [are] subject to the prophets.

title: I Corinthians 14:33
text: For God is not [the author] of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.

title: I Corinthians 14:34
text: Let your women be silent in the churches; for it is not permitted to them to speak, but to be in subjection, as the Law also says.

title: I Corinthians 14:35
text: And if they desire to learn anything, let them ask their husbands at home; for it is a shame for a woman to speak in a church.

title: I Corinthians 14:36
text: Or did the Word of God go out from you? Or did it reach only to you?

title: I Corinthians 14:37
text: If anyone thinks to be a prophet, or a spiritual one, let him recognize the things I write to you, that they are a commandment of the Lord.

title: I Corinthians 14:38
text: But if any is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

title: I Corinthians 14:39
text: So then, brothers, seek to prophesy, and do not forbid to speak in languages.

title: I Corinthians 14:40
text: Let all things be done decently and in order.

title: I Corinthians 15:1
text: And, brothers, I declare to you the gospel which I preached to you, which also you have received, and in which you stand;

title: I Corinthians 15:2
text: by which you also are being kept safe, if you hold fast the word which I preached to you, unless you believed in vain.

title: I Corinthians 15:3
text: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received, that Christ died for our sins, according to the Scriptures,

title: I Corinthians 15:4
text: and that He was buried, and that He rose again the third day according to the Scriptures;

title: I Corinthians 15:5
text: and that He was seen by Cephas, then by the Twelve.

title: I Corinthians 15:6
text: Afterward He was seen by over five hundred brothers at once, of whom the greater part remain until this present day, but also some fell asleep.

title: I Corinthians 15:7
text: Afterward He was seen by James, then by all the apostles.

title: I Corinthians 15:8
text: And last of all He was seen by me also, as one born out of time.

title: I Corinthians 15:9
text: For I am the least of the apostles and am not sufficient to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

title: I Corinthians 15:10
text: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and His grace which [was] toward me has not been without fruit, but I labored more abundantly than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God with me.

title: I Corinthians 15:11
text: Therefore whether [it was] I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

title: I Corinthians 15:12
text: But if Christ is proclaimed, that He was raised from [the] dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

title: I Corinthians 15:13
text: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

title: I Corinthians 15:14
text: And if Christ has not been raised, then our proclamation [is] worthless, and your faith [is] also worthless.

title: I Corinthians 15:15
text: And we are also found [to be] false witnesses of God, because we testified of God that He raised Christ; whom He did not raise if the dead are not raised.

title: I Corinthians 15:16
text: For if [the] dead are not raised, then Christ is not raised.

title: I Corinthians 15:17
text: And if Christ is not raised, your faith [is] foolish; you are yet in your sins.

title: I Corinthians 15:18
text: Then also those that fell asleep in Christ were lost.

title: I Corinthians 15:19
text: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.

title: I Corinthians 15:20
text: But now Christ has risen from [the] dead, [and] has become the firstfruit of those who slept.

title: I Corinthians 15:21
text: For since death [is] through man, the resurrection of [the] dead also [is] through a Man.

title: I Corinthians 15:22
text: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ all will be made alive.

title: I Corinthians 15:23
text: But each in [his] own order: Christ the first-fruit, and afterward they who are Christ's at His coming;

title: I Corinthians 15:24
text: then [is] the end, when He delivers the kingdom to God, even the Father; when He makes to cease all rule and all authority and power.

title: I Corinthians 15:25
text: for it is right for Him to reign until He has put all the enemies under His feet.

title: I Corinthians 15:26
text: The last enemy made to cease [is] death.

title: I Corinthians 15:27
text: For He put all things under His feet. But when He says that all things have been put under [His feet], it is plain that [it] excepts Him who has put all things under Him.

title: I Corinthians 15:28
text: But when all things are subjected to Him, then the Son Himself also will be subject to Him who has subjected things to Him, so that God may be all things in all.

title: I Corinthians 15:29
text: Otherwise, what will they do, those being baptized on behalf of [the] dead? If the dead are not at all raised, why indeed are they baptized on behalf of [the] dead?

title: I Corinthians 15:30
text: And why are we also in danger every hour?

title: I Corinthians 15:31
text: Day by day I die, by your rejoicing, which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord.

title: I Corinthians 15:32
text: If according to man I fought with beasts in Ephesus, what advantage is to me if [the] dead are not raised? "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die!"

title: I Corinthians 15:33
text: Do not be deceived, evil companionships corrupt good habits.

title: I Corinthians 15:34
text: Be righteously awake, and sin not; for some have ignorance of God. I speak [this] to your shame.

title: I Corinthians 15:35
text: But someone will say, How are the dead raised up, and with what body do they come?

title: I Corinthians 15:36
text: Foolish one! What you sow is not made alive unless it dies.

title: I Corinthians 15:37
text: And what you sow, you do not sow the body that [is] going to be, but a bare grain (perhaps of wheat or of some of the rest).

title: I Corinthians 15:38
text: And God gives it a body as it has pleased Him, and to each of the seeds its own body.

title: I Corinthians 15:39
text: All flesh [is] not the same flesh; but one [kind of] flesh of men, and another flesh of beasts, and another of fish, and another of birds.

title: I Corinthians 15:40
text: [There are] also heavenly bodies and earthly bodies. But the glory of the heavenly [is] truly different, and that of the earthly different;

title: I Corinthians 15:41
text: one glory of [the] sun, and another glory of [the] moon, and another glory of [the] stars; for [one] star differs from [another] star in glory.

title: I Corinthians 15:42
text: So also the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption, it is raised in incorruption;

title: I Corinthians 15:43
text: it is sown in dishonor, it is raised in glory; it is sown in weakness, it is raised in power;

title: I Corinthians 15:44
text: it is sown a natural body, it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.

title: I Corinthians 15:45
text: And so it is written, "The first man, Adam, [was made] a living soul," the last Adam was a life-giving Spirit.

title: I Corinthians 15:46
text: But not the spiritual first, but the natural; afterward the spiritual.

title: I Corinthians 15:47
text: The first man [was] out of earth, earthy; the second Man [was] the Lord from Heaven.

title: I Corinthians 15:48
text: Such the earthy [man], such also the earthy ones. And such the heavenly [Man], such also the heavenly ones.

title: I Corinthians 15:49
text: And according as we bore the image of the earthy [man], we shall also bear the image of the heavenly [Man].

title: I Corinthians 15:50
text: And I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit [the] kingdom of God, nor does corruption inherit incorruption.

title: I Corinthians 15:51
text: Behold, I speak a mystery to you; we shall not all fall asleep, but we shall all be changed;

title: I Corinthians 15:52
text: in a moment, in a glance of an eye, at the last trumpet. For a trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall all be changed.

title: I Corinthians 15:53
