text: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal [must] put on immortality.

title: I Corinthians 15:54
text: But when this corruptible shall put on incorruption, and when this mortal shall put on immortality, then will take place the word that is written, "Death is swallowed up in victory.

title: I Corinthians 15:55
text: O death, where [is] your sting? O grave, where [is] your victory?"

title: I Corinthians 15:56
text: The sting of death [is] sin, and the strength of sin [is] the law.

title: I Corinthians 15:57
text: But thanks [be] to God who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: I Corinthians 15:58
text: So that, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, knowing that your labor is not without fruit in the Lord.

title: I Corinthians 16:1
text: And concerning the collection for the saints, as I charged the churches of Galatia, so also you do.

title: I Corinthians 16:2
text: On the first [day] of the week let each of you put by himself, storing up what ever he is prospered, so that there may be no collections when I come.

title: I Corinthians 16:3
text: And when I come, whomever you shall approve by [your] letters, I will send them to bring your gift to Jerusalem.

title: I Corinthians 16:4
text: And if it is suitable for me to go also, they shall go with me.

title: I Corinthians 16:5
text: But I will come to you when I pass through Macedonia; for I am going through Macedonia.

title: I Corinthians 16:6
text: And it may be that I will stay with you, and even spend the winter with you, so that you may set me forward wherever I go.

title: I Corinthians 16:7
text: For I do not desire to see you now in passage, but I am hoping to stay some time with you, if the Lord permits.

title: I Corinthians 16:8
text: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost.

title: I Corinthians 16:9
text: For a great and effective door opened to me, and many [are] opposing.

title: I Corinthians 16:10
text: But if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he works the work of the Lord, even as I [do].

title: I Corinthians 16:11
text: Therefore let not any despise him, but set him forward in peace, so that he may come to me; for I am waiting for him with the brothers.

title: I Corinthians 16:12
text: As regards [our] brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not altogether [his] will that he come now. But he will come when he has opportunity.

title: I Corinthians 16:13
text: Watch! Stand fast in the faith! Be men! Be strong!

title: I Corinthians 16:14
text: Let all your things be done in charity.

title: I Corinthians 16:15
text: But I exhort you, brothers. You know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruit of Achaia, and they appointed themselves to ministry to the saints.

title: I Corinthians 16:16
text: See that you also submit to such ones, and to everyone working and laboring with [me].

title: I Corinthians 16:17
text: I am glad at the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus; for these supplied your lack.

title: I Corinthians 16:18
text: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours; then acknowledge such ones.

title: I Corinthians 16:19
text: The churches of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you much in [the] Lord, with the church that is in their house.

title: I Corinthians 16:20
text: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

title: I Corinthians 16:21
text: The salutation of Paul with my own hand.

title: I Corinthians 16:22
text: If anyone does not love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be accursed. The Lord comes!

title: I Corinthians 16:23
text: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you.

title: I Corinthians 16:24
text: Let my love [be] with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.

title: II Corinthians 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy [our] brother, to the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in all Achaia.

title: II Corinthians 1:2
text: Grace [be] unto you, and peace from God our Father and [from the] Lord Jesus Christ.

title: II Corinthians 1:3
text: Blessed [be] God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and the God of all comfort,

title: II Corinthians 1:4
text: He comforting us in all our trouble, so that we may be able to comfort those who are in every trouble, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

title: II Corinthians 1:5
text: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also abounds by Christ.

title: II Corinthians 1:6
text: And if we are troubled, [it is] for your consolation and salvation, being worked out in [the] endurance of the same sufferings which we also suffer; if we are comforted, [it is] for your consolation and salvation.

title: II Corinthians 1:7
text: And our hope of you [is] certain, knowing that as you are partakers of the sufferings, so also of the consolation.

title: II Corinthians 1:8
text: For, brothers, we would not have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength; so much so that we despaired even of life.

title: II Corinthians 1:9
text: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, so that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead;

title: II Corinthians 1:10
text: who delivered us from so great a death, and does deliver; in whom we trust that He will yet deliver [us],

title: II Corinthians 1:11
text: with you also helping together by prayer for us, so that the gracious gift by many persons be [the cause of] thanksgiving through many for us.

title: II Corinthians 1:12
text: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity; not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God; we have had our conduct in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

title: II Corinthians 1:13
text: For we write no other things to you than what you read or recognize, and I trust you shall recognize them even to the end,

title: II Corinthians 1:14
text: even as you have recognized us [in] part, that we are your rejoicing, even as you also [are] ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.

title: II Corinthians 1:15
text: And in this confidence I intended to come to you before, so that you might have a second benefit,

title: II Corinthians 1:16
text: and to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia to you, and to be brought on my way toward Judea by you.

title: II Corinthians 1:17
text: Then purposing this, did I indeed use lightness? Or the things that I purpose, do I purpose them according to the flesh, so that with me there should be yes, yes, and no, no?

title: II Corinthians 1:18
text: But [as] God [is] true, our word toward you was not yes and no.

title: II Corinthians 1:19
text: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us; by me and Silas and Timothy; was not yes and no, but in Him was, yes!

title: II Corinthians 1:20
text: For all the promises of God in Him [are] yes, and in Him Amen, to the glory of God by us.

title: II Corinthians 1:21
text: But He confirming us and anointing us with you in Christ [is] God.

title: II Corinthians 1:22
text: And He has sealed us and having given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.

title: II Corinthians 1:23
text: And I call God [as] witness to my soul that in order to spare you I have not yet come to Corinth.

title: II Corinthians 1:24
text: Not that we have dominion over your faith, but we are helpers of your joy; for by faith you stand.

title: II Corinthians 2:1
text: But I determined this within myself, that I would not come to you again in grief.

title: II Corinthians 2:2
text: For if I make you sorry, who then is he who makes me glad, but the same who has been made sorry by me?

title: II Corinthians 2:3
text: And I wrote this to you, lest when I came I should have sorrow from the [ones] of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is [the joy] of you all.

title: II Corinthians 2:4
text: For out of much trouble and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be grieved, but that you might know the love which I have more abundantly to you.

title: II Corinthians 2:5
text: But if anyone has caused grief, he has not grieved me, except in part; so that I not overbear all of you.

title: II Corinthians 2:6
text: This punishment by the majority [is] enough for such a one;

title: II Corinthians 2:7
text: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive and comfort [him], lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overwhelming sorrow.

title: II Corinthians 2:8
text: So I beseech you to confirm [your] love toward him.

title: II Corinthians 2:9
text: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

title: II Corinthians 2:10
text: But to whom you forgive anything, I also [forgive]. For if I forgave anything, for your sakes I forgave [it] to him in the person of Christ;

title: II Corinthians 2:11
text: so that we should not be overreached by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his devices.

title: II Corinthians 2:12
text: And, when I came to Troas to [preach] Christ's gospel, and a door was opened to me by [the] Lord,

title: II Corinthians 2:13
text: I had no rest in my spirit because I did not find Titus my brother. But taking my leave of them, I went from there into Macedonia.

title: II Corinthians 2:14
text: Now thanks [be] to God, who always causes us to triumph in Christ, and He revealing through us the odor of the knowledge of Him in every place.

title: II Corinthians 2:15
text: For we are to God a sweet savor of Christ, in those being saved, and in those being lost;

title: II Corinthians 2:16
text: to the one [we are] the savor of death to death, and to the other we are the savor of life to life. And who is sufficient for these things?

title: II Corinthians 2:17
text: For we are not as many, hawking the Word of God; but as of sincerity, but as of God. We speak in Christ in the sight of God.

title: II Corinthians 3:1
text: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, like some, epistles of commendation to you, or [letters] of commendation from you?

title: II Corinthians 3:2
text: You are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read by all men,

title: II Corinthians 3:3
text: [it] having been made plain that you are the epistle of Christ, ministered by us, not having been written with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not on tablets of stone, but in fleshly tablets of [the] heart.

title: II Corinthians 3:4
text: And we have such trust through Christ toward God,

title: II Corinthians 3:5
text: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think anything as of ourselves, but our sufficiency [is] of God;

title: II Corinthians 3:6
text: who also has made us able ministers of the new covenant; not of the letter, but of the spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

title: II Corinthians 3:7
text: But if the ministry of death, having been engraved in letters in stone was with glory (so that the sons of Israel could not steadfastly behold the face of Moses because of the glory of his face), which ministry was to be done away;

title: II Corinthians 3:8
text: shall not the ministry of the Spirit be with more glory?

title: II Corinthians 3:9
text: For if the ministry of condemnation [is] glorious, much more does the ministry of righteousness exceed in glory.

title: II Corinthians 3:10
text: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, because of the glory that excels.

title: II Corinthians 3:11
text: For if that which has been done away [was] glorious, much more that which remains [is] glorious.

title: II Corinthians 3:12
text: Then since we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech.

title: II Corinthians 3:13
text: And we are not like Moses, [who] put a veil over his face so that the sons of Israel could not steadfastly look to the end of the thing being done away.

title: II Corinthians 3:14
text: (But their thoughts were blinded; for until the present the same veil remains on the reading of the old covenant, not taken away.) But this veil has been done away in Christ.

title: II Corinthians 3:15
text: But until this day, when Moses is read, the veil is on their heart.

title: II Corinthians 3:16
text: But whenever it turns to [the] Lord, the veil shall be taken away.

title: II Corinthians 3:17
text: And the Lord [is] that Spirit; and where the Spirit of [the] Lord [is], there [is] liberty.

title: II Corinthians 3:18
text: But we all, with [our] face having been unveiled, having beheld the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are being changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Lord Spirit.

title: II Corinthians 4:1
text: Therefore since we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we do not faint.

title: II Corinthians 4:2
text: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor adulterating the Word of God, but [by] the revelation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.

title: II Corinthians 4:3
text: But also if our gospel is hidden, it is hidden to those being lost,

title: II Corinthians 4:4
text: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving ones, so that the light of the glorious gospel of Christ (who is the image of God) should not dawn on them.

title: II Corinthians 4:5
text: For we do not preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.

title: II Corinthians 4:6
text: For [it is] God who said, "Out of darkness Light shall shine;" who shone in our hearts to [give] the brightness of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

title: II Corinthians 4:7
text: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, so that the excellence of the power may be of God and not of us;

title: II Corinthians 4:8
text: in every [way] having been troubled, but not having been hemmed in; having been perplexed, but not utterly at a loss;

title: II Corinthians 4:9
text: having been persecuted, but not having been forsaken; having been thrown down, but not having been destroyed;

title: II Corinthians 4:10
text: always bearing about the dying of the Lord Jesus in the body, so that the life of Jesus also might be revealed in our body.

title: II Corinthians 4:11
text: For we who live are always being delivered to death for Jesus' sake, so that the life of Jesus might also be revealed in our body.

title: II Corinthians 4:12
text: So then death works in us, but life in you.

title: II Corinthians 4:13
text: For we, having the same spirit of faith (according as it is written, "I believed, and therefore I have spoken"); we also believed and therefore speak,

title: II Corinthians 4:14
text: knowing that He who raised up the Lord Jesus shall also raise us up by Jesus, and shall present [us] with you.

title: II Corinthians 4:15
text: For all things [are] for your sake, so that the superabounding grace might be made to abound through the thanksgiving of the greater number, to the glory of God.

title: II Corinthians 4:16
text: For this cause we do not faint; but though our outward man perishes, yet the inward [man] is being renewed day by day.

title: II Corinthians 4:17
text: For the lightness of our present affliction works out for us a far more excellent eternal weight of glory,

title: II Corinthians 4:18
text: we not considering the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen; for the things which [are] seen [are] not lasting, but the things which [are] not seen [are] everlasting.

title: II Corinthians 5:1
text: For we know that if our earthly house of [this] tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

title: II Corinthians 5:2
text: For indeed in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed with our dwelling-place out of Heaven;

title: II Corinthians 5:3
text: if indeed [in] being clothed, we shall not be found naked.

title: II Corinthians 5:4
text: For we who are in [this] tabernacle groan, being burdened; inasmuch as we do not wish to be unclothed, but to be clothed, so that the mortal might be swallowed up by the life.

title: II Corinthians 5:5
text: And He who has worked in us for this same thing [is] God, who also [is] giving to us the earnest of the Spirit.

title: II Corinthians 5:6
text: Then being always confident, knowing that while we are at home in the body, we are away from home from the Lord;

title: II Corinthians 5:7
text: for we walk by faith, not by sight;

title: II Corinthians 5:8
text: then we are confident and we are pleased rather to go away from home out of the body, and to come home to the Lord.

title: II Corinthians 5:9
text: Therefore we are also laboring to be well-pleasing to Him, whether at home or away from home.

title: II Corinthians 5:10
text: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each one may receive the things [done] in his body, according to that which he has done, whether good or bad.

title: II Corinthians 5:11
text: Therefore, knowing the terror of the Lord, we persuade men. But we are revealed to God, and I trust also that we are revealed in your consciences.

title: II Corinthians 5:12
text: For we do not commend ourselves again to you, but are giving you occasion to glory on our behalf, so that you may have [it] to [answer those] boasting in appearance, and not in heart.

title: II Corinthians 5:13
text: For if we are out of our mind, [it is] to God; or [if] we are in our senses, [it is] for you.

title: II Corinthians 5:14
text: For the love of Christ constrains us, judging this, that if one died for all, then all died;

title: II Corinthians 5:15
text: and He died for all, that the living ones may live no more to themselves, but to Him who died for them having been raised.

title: II Corinthians 5:16
text: So as we now know no one according to flesh, but even if we have known Christ according to flesh, yet now we no longer know [Him] so.

title: II Corinthians 5:17
text: So that if any one [is] in Christ, [that one is] a new creature; old things have passed away; behold, all things have become new.

title: II Corinthians 5:18
text: And all things [are] of God, who has reconciled us to Himself through Jesus Christ, and has given to us the ministry of reconciliation;

title: II Corinthians 5:19
text: whereas God was in Christ reconciling [the] world to Himself, not imputing their trespasses to them, and putting the word of reconciliation in us.

title: II Corinthians 5:20
text: Then we are ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as God exhorting through us, we beseech [you] on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

title: II Corinthians 5:21
text: For He has made Him who knew no sin, [to be] sin for us, that we might become [the] righteousness of God in Him.

title: II Corinthians 6:1
text: But working together, we also call on you not to receive the grace of God in vain.

title: II Corinthians 6:2
text: (For He says, "In an acceptable time I heard you, and in a day of salvation, I helped you;" Behold, now [is] the accepted time. Behold, now [is] the day of salvation.)

title: II Corinthians 6:3
text: [We are] in nothing giving cause of stumbling, in no way, so that the ministry may not be blamed,

title: II Corinthians 6:4
text: but in everything commending ourselves as God's servants, in much patience, in troubles, in emergencies, in distresses,

title: II Corinthians 6:5
text: in stripes, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;

title: II Corinthians 6:6
text: in pureness, in knowledge, in long-suffering, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in love unfeigned,

title: II Corinthians 6:7
text: in [the] word of truth, in [the] power of God, through the weapons of righteousness on the right [hand] and on the left,

title: II Corinthians 6:8
text: through glory and dishonor, through evil report and good report; as deceivers and [yet] true;

title: II Corinthians 6:9
text: as unknown and [yet] well known; as dying and, behold, we live; as chastened and not killed;

title: II Corinthians 6:10
text: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, [yet] possessing all things.

title: II Corinthians 6:11
text: O Corinthians, our mouth is opened to you, our heart has been enlarged.

title: II Corinthians 6:12
text: You are not restrained in us, but you are restrained in your own affections.

title: II Corinthians 6:13
text: But for the same reward, (I speak as to children), you also be enlarged.

title: II Corinthians 6:14
text: Do not be unequally yoked together [with] unbelievers; for what fellowship does righteousness [have] with lawlessness? And what partnership does light [have] with darkness?

title: II Corinthians 6:15
text: And what agreement does Christ [have] with Belial? Or what part does a believer [have] with an unbeliever?

title: II Corinthians 6:16
text: And what agreement does a temple of God [have] with idols? For you are the temple of [the] living God, as God has said, "I will dwell in them and walk among [them]; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people."

title: II Corinthians 6:17
text: Therefore come out from among them and be separated, says the Lord, and do not touch the unclean [thing]. And I will receive you

title: II Corinthians 6:18
text: and I will be a Father to you, and you shall be My sons and daughters, says [the] Lord Almighty.

title: II Corinthians 7:1
text: Then having these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all defilements of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

title: II Corinthians 7:2
text: Make room for us. We wronged no one, we corrupted no one, we overreached no one.

title: II Corinthians 7:3
text: I do not speak [this] to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts for [us] to die together, and to live together.

title: II Corinthians 7:4
text: My boldness of speech [is] great toward you; my glorying on your behalf [is] much. I have been filled with comfort, I am overflowing with joy on all our trouble.

title: II Corinthians 7:5
text: For, indeed, coming into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but being troubled in every way, [with] fightings [on the] outside, and fears [on the] inside.

title: II Corinthians 7:6
text: But He who comforts the lowly comforted us by the coming of Titus.

title: II Corinthians 7:7
text: And not only by his coming, but by the comfort with which he was comforted over you, telling us your longing, your mourning, your zeal for me; so that I rejoiced the more.

title: II Corinthians 7:8
text: For even if I grieved you in the letter, I do not regret; if indeed I did regret; for I see that that letter grieved you for an hour.

title: II Corinthians 7:9
text: Now I rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you grieved to repentance. For you were grieved according to God, so that you might suffer loss by nothing in us.

title: II Corinthians 7:10
text: For the grief according to God works repentance to salvation, not to be regretted, but the grief of the world works out death.

title: II Corinthians 7:11
text: For behold this same thing (you being grieved according to God); how much it worked out earnestness in you; but [also] defense; but [also] indignation; but [also] fear; but [also] desire; but [also] zeal; but [ also] vengeance! In everything you approved yourselves to be clear in the matter.

title: II Corinthians 7:12
text: Then, though I wrote to you, [it was] not on account of the one who did wrong, nor on account of the one who suffered wrong, but for the sake of revealing our earnestness on your behalf, for you before God.

title: II Corinthians 7:13
text: Therefore we have been comforted in your comfort, and we rather rejoiced more abundantly over the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.

title: II Corinthians 7:14
text: For if I have boasted anything about you to him, I was not ashamed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, even so our boasting as to Titus became truth.

title: II Corinthians 7:15
text: And his tender feelings are more abundant toward you, remembering the obedience of you all, as you received him with fear and trembling.

title: II Corinthians 7:16
text: Therefore I rejoice that I have confidence in you in everything.

title: II Corinthians 8:1
text: And, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given among the churches of Macedonia;

title: II Corinthians 8:2
text: that in much testing of trouble, the overflowing of their joy, and the depth of their poverty, abounded to the riches of their generosity.

title: II Corinthians 8:3
text: For I testify [that] according to [their] ability, and beyond their ability; [they] gave willingly;

title: II Corinthians 8:4
text: with much beseeching, begging us [that they might] receive of us the grace and the fellowship of the ministry to the saints.

title: II Corinthians 8:5
text: And not as we hoped, but first [they] gave themselves to the Lord, and to us through [the] will of God,

title: II Corinthians 8:6
text: for us to call on Titus, that even as he began before, so he would also complete this grace to you also.

title: II Corinthians 8:7
text: But even as you abound in everything, in faith, and in word, and in knowledge, and in all earnestness, and in your love to us; you should abound in this grace also.

title: II Corinthians 8:8
text: I do not speak according to command, but through the eagerness of others, and testing the trueness of your love.

title: II Corinthians 8:9
text: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though He was rich, for your sakes He became poor, in order that you might be made rich through His poverty.

title: II Corinthians 8:10
text: And in this I give [my] judgment; for this is profitable for you, who began before, not only to do, but also to be willing a year ago.

title: II Corinthians 8:11
text: But now also finish the doing [of it], so that, as [there was] a readiness to will, so also the finishing, [giving] out of [what] you have.

title: II Corinthians 8:12
text: For if the eagerness is present, [it is] acceptable according to [what] one has, [and] not according to [what] one does not have.

title: II Corinthians 8:13
text: For [it is] not that others may [have] ease, but you trouble;

title: II Corinthians 8:14
text: but by equality in the present time; your abundance for their need, that their abundance also may be for your need; so that there may be equality;

title: II Corinthians 8:15
text: as it is written, "He [gathering] much, he had nothing left over; and he [gathering] little did not have less."

title: II Corinthians 8:16
text: But thanks [be] to God, who put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.

title: II Corinthians 8:17
text: For indeed he accepted the entreaty. But being more earnest, of his own accord he went to you.

title: II Corinthians 8:18
text: And we have sent with him the brothers whose praise [is] in the gospel throughout all the churches;

title: II Corinthians 8:19
text: and not only [so], but also he having been chosen by the churches to travel with us with this gift, which is administered by us to the glory of the Lord Himself, and [as a witness of] your eager mind;

title: II Corinthians 8:20
text: avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us;

title: II Corinthians 8:21
text: providing for honest things, not only before [the] Lord, but also before men.

title: II Corinthians 8:22
text: And we have sent with them our brother whom we have often proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest by the great confidence which [I have] in you.

title: II Corinthians 8:23
text: If anyone inquires of Titus, [he is] my partner and fellow-worker for you, or [of] our brothers, [they are] the messengers of the churches, [the] glory of Christ.

title: II Corinthians 8:24
text: Therefore show them a proof of your love and of our boasting toward you in the presence of the churches.

title: II Corinthians 9:1
text: For indeed regarding the ministry to the saints, it is not necessary for me to write to you.

title: II Corinthians 9:2
text: For I know your eagerness, of which I boast to Macedonia on your behalf, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal has aroused the greater number.

title: II Corinthians 9:3
text: Yet I sent the brothers, lest our boasting (which [is] on your behalf) should not be in vain, that, as I said, you may be ready.

title: II Corinthians 9:4
text: [I say this] lest perhaps Macedonians should come with me and find you unprepared. We (not to say you) would then be put to shame in this confident boasting.

title: II Corinthians 9:5
text: Therefore I thought [it] necessary to exhort the brothers that they would go forward to you, and make up beforehand your blessing, it having been promised that this would be ready, thus as [a matter of] blessing, and not as of covetousness.

title: II Corinthians 9:6
text: But [I say] this, He who sows sparingly shall also reap sparingly, and he who sows bountifully shall also reap bountifully.

title: II Corinthians 9:7
text: Each one, as he purposes in his heart, [let him give]; not of grief, or of necessity, for God loves a cheerful giver.

title: II Corinthians 9:8
text: And God [is] able to make all grace abound toward you, that in everything, always having all self-sufficiency, you may abound to every good work;

title: II Corinthians 9:9
text: As it is written, "He scattered; he has given to the poor; his righteousness remains forever."

title: II Corinthians 9:10
text: Now He who supplies seed to the sower, and bread for eating, may He supply and multiply your seed, and increase the fruits of your righteousness

title: II Corinthians 9:11
text: you being enriched in everything to all generosity, which works out thanksgiving to God through us.

title: II Corinthians 9:12
text: For the ministry of this service not only supplies the things lacking of the saints, but also multiplying through many thanksgivings to God,

title: II Corinthians 9:13
text: through the proof of this ministry [they] glorify God for your freely expressed submission to the gospel of Christ, and the generosity of the fellowship toward them and toward all,

title: II Corinthians 9:14
text: and [in] their prayer for you, who long after you, because of the exceeding grace of God on you.

title: II Corinthians 9:15
text: Thanks [be] to God for His unspeakable free gift.

title: II Corinthians 10:1
text: And I myself, Paul, beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ; I, who indeed to look upon [am] lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.

title: II Corinthians 10:2
text: But I ask, not being present, that I may be bold with the confidence which I think to be daring against some, who thought [of] us as walking according to flesh.

title: II Corinthians 10:3
text: For though walking about in flesh, we do not war according to flesh.

title: II Corinthians 10:4
text: For the weapons of our warfare [are] not fleshly, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds,

title: II Corinthians 10:5
text: pulling down imaginations and every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought into the obedience of Christ;

title: II Corinthians 10:6
text: and having readiness to avenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.

title: II Corinthians 10:7
text: Do you look at things according to appearance? If anyone has persuaded himself that he [is] Christ's, let him think this again as to himself, that as he [is] Christ's, even so we [are] Christ's.

title: II Corinthians 10:8
text: For even if I also should boast somewhat more fully of our authority (which the Lord has given us for building up, and not for pulling you down) I will not be put to shame;

title: II Corinthians 10:9
text: so that I might not seem to terrify you by letters.

title: II Corinthians 10:10
text: For indeed they say, the letters [are] weighty and powerful, but the bodily presence [is] weak, and his speech is contemptible.

title: II Corinthians 10:11
text: Let such a one think this, that, such as we [are] in word by letters, being absent, such [we will be] also in deed when we are present.

title: II Corinthians 10:12
text: For we do not dare to rank or compare ourselves with some of the ones commending themselves. But they, measuring themselves among themselves, and comparing themselves to themselves, are not perceptive.

title: II Corinthians 10:13
text: But we will not boast beyond measure, but according to the measure of the rule which the God of measure distributed to us, to reach even to you.

title: II Corinthians 10:14
text: For we do not overstretch ourselves as [though] not reaching to you. For we also came to you in the gospel of Christ;

title: II Corinthians 10:15
text: not boasting beyond measure in the labors of others, but having hope that the growing faith among you will be increased according to our rule, to overflowing;

title: II Corinthians 10:16
text: to preach the gospel in that beyond you, and not to boast in another's rule in things made ready.

title: II Corinthians 10:17
text: But he who glories, let him glory in [the] Lord.

title: II Corinthians 10:18
text: For not he who commends himself is approved, but he whom the Lord commends.

title: II Corinthians 11:1
text: I would that you were bearing with me a little in foolishness; but indeed bear with me.

title: II Corinthians 11:2
text: For I am jealous [over] you with godly jealousy. For I have espoused you to one Man, to present [you as] a pure virgin to Christ.

title: II Corinthians 11:3
text: But I fear lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve in his craftiness, so your thoughts should be corrupted from the simplicity due to Christ.

title: II Corinthians 11:4
text: For if, indeed, the [one] coming proclaims another Jesus, whom we have not proclaimed, or [if] you receive another spirit, which you did not receive, or another gospel, which you never accepted, you might well endure [these].

title: II Corinthians 11:5
text: For I judge [myself] to have come behind the highest apostles [in] nothing.

title: II Corinthians 11:6
text: But even if [I am] unskilled in speech, yet not in knowledge; but in every way [I] have been clearly revealed to you in all things.

title: II Corinthians 11:7
text: Or did I commit sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached the gospel of God to you without charge?

title: II Corinthians 11:8
text: I stripped other churches, taking wages for the serving of you.

title: II Corinthians 11:9
text: And being present with you, and in need, I was not a burden to anyone. For the brothers from Macedonia made up completely my need. And in every way I have kept myself from being burdensome [to you], and I will keep myself.

title: II Corinthians 11:10
text: The truth of Christ is in me that this boasting shall not be silenced in me in the regions of Achaia.

title: II Corinthians 11:11
text: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows.

title: II Corinthians 11:12
text: But what I do, that I will do, so that I may cut off occasion from those who desire occasion; so that in the thing in which they boast, they may be found even as we.

title: II Corinthians 11:13
text: For such ones [are] false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.

title: II Corinthians 11:14
text: Did not even Satan marvelously transform himself into an angel of light?

title: II Corinthians 11:15
text: Therefore [it is] no great thing if his ministers also transform themselves as ministers of righteousness, whose end shall be according to their works.

title: II Corinthians 11:16
text: Again I say, Let no one think me foolish. If otherwise, yet receive me as foolish, so that I may also boast a little.

title: II Corinthians 11:17
text: What I speak, I do not speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this boldness of boasting.

title: II Corinthians 11:18
text: Since many glory according to the flesh, I also will boast.

title: II Corinthians 11:19
text: For you gladly bear with fools, being wise.

title: II Corinthians 11:20
text: For you endure if anyone enslaves you, if anyone devours, if anyone takes [from you], if anyone exalts himself, if anyone strikes you in the face.

title: II Corinthians 11:21
text: I speak according to dishonor, as though we have been weak. But in whatever anyone dares (I speak foolishly), I also dare.

title: II Corinthians 11:22
text: Are they Hebrews? I also! Are they Israelites? I also! Are they the seed of Abraham? I also!

title: II Corinthians 11:23
text: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as beside myself,) I [am] more! [I have been] in labors more abundantly, in stripes above measure, in prisons more, in deaths many times.

title: II Corinthians 11:24
text: Five times from the Jews I received forty [stripes] minus one.

title: II Corinthians 11:25
text: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked. I have spent a night and a day in the deep.

title: II Corinthians 11:26
text: I have been in travels often; in dangers from waters; in dangers from robbers; in dangers from [my] race; in dangers from [the] heathen; in dangers in [the] city; in dangers in [the] wilderness; in dangers on [the]  sea; in dangers among false brothers.

title: II Corinthians 11:27
text: [I have been] in hardship and toil; often in watchings; in hunger and thirst; often in fastings; in cold and nakedness;

title: II Corinthians 11:28
text: besides the things outside conspiring against me daily, the care of all the churches.

title: II Corinthians 11:29
text: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I do not burn?

title: II Corinthians 11:30
text: If it is right to boast, I will boast, I will boast [of] the things of my weakness.

title: II Corinthians 11:31
text: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who is blessed forever, knows that I do not lie.

title: II Corinthians 11:32
text: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king guarded the city of [the] Damascenes, desiring to lay hold of me.

title: II Corinthians 11:33
text: And I was let down in a basket through a window through the wall, and escaped their hands.

title: II Corinthians 12:1
text: Indeed, it is not profitable for me to boast. For I will come to visions and revelations of [the] Lord.

title: II Corinthians 12:2
text: I know a man in Christ fourteen years before (whether in [the] body, I do not know; or outside of [the] body, I do not know; God knows) such a one [was] caught up to [the] third Heaven.

title: II Corinthians 12:3
text: And I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I do not know; God knows),

title: II Corinthians 12:4
text: that he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not allowed for a man to utter.

title: II Corinthians 12:5
text: I will glory of such a one, yet I will not boast on my behalf, except in my weaknesses.

title: II Corinthians 12:6
text: For if I desire to boast, I shall not be foolish. For I will speak the truth. But I spare, lest anyone should think of me as [being] beyond what he sees me, or hears of me;

title: II Corinthians 12:7
text: and by the surpassing revelations, lest I not be made haughty, a thorn in the flesh was given to me, a messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I be made haughty.

title: II Corinthians 12:8
text: For this thing I besought the Lord three times, that it might depart from me.

title: II Corinthians 12:9
text: And He said to me, My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may overshadow me.

title: II Corinthians 12:10
text: Therefore I am pleased in weaknesses, in insults, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake; for when I am weak, then I am powerful.

title: II Corinthians 12:11
text: I have become foolish boasting. You compelled me. For I ought to be commended by you. For I lacked nothing of the highest apostles, though I am nothing.

title: II Corinthians 12:12
text: Truly the signs of the apostles were worked out among you in all patience, in miracles and in wonders, and by works of power.

title: II Corinthians 12:13
text: For what is it in which you were inferior to the rest of the churches, except that I myself did not burden you? Forgive me this wrong.

title: II Corinthians 12:14
text: Behold, a third [time] I am ready to come to you. And I will not burden you, for I do not seek your things, but you. For the children ought not to lay up treasure for the parents, but the parents for the children.

title: II Corinthians 12:15
text: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for your souls, even if loving you more and more, I am loved [the] less.

title: II Corinthians 12:16
text: But let it be so, I did not burden you. But being crafty, I caught you with bait.

title: II Corinthians 12:17
text: By any whom I have sent to you, did I overreach you by him?

title: II Corinthians 12:18
text: I begged Titus and sent with [him] the brother. Did Titus overreach you? Did we not walk in the same spirit? Did we not walk in the same steps?

title: II Corinthians 12:19
text: Again, do you think we are defending to you? We speak before God in Christ, but [we do] all things, dearly beloved, for your building up.

title: II Corinthians 12:20
text: For I fear, lest somehow coming I might not find you as I wish, and [that] I shall be found by you such as you might not wish; lest somehow [there be] strifes, envyings, angers, contentions, backbitings, whisperings, proud thoughts, tumults;

title: II Corinthians 12:21
text: lest in my coming again my God will humble me with you; and I shall mourn many who have already sinned, and not repenting over the uncleanness, and fornication, and lustfulness which they have practiced.

title: II Corinthians 13:1
text: I am coming to you this third [time]. In the mouth of two or three witnesses every word shall be established.

title: II Corinthians 13:2
text: I told you before, and I say beforehand, as being present the second [time] and being absent now. I write to those who sinned before, and to all the rest, that if I come again, I will not spare.

title: II Corinthians 13:3
text: Since you seek a proof of Christ speaking in me (who is not weak toward you, but is powerful in you;

title: II Corinthians 13:4
text: for even if He was crucified out of weakness, yet He lives by [the] power of God. For indeed even we are weak in Him, but we shall live with Him by [the] power of God toward you),

title: II Corinthians 13:5
text: examine yourselves, whether you are in the faith, prove your own selves. Do you not know your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you, unless you are reprobates?

title: II Corinthians 13:6
text: But I trust that you will know that we are not reprobates.

title: II Corinthians 13:7
text: But I pray to God [for] you not to do evil, none. And not that we may appear approved, but that you should do the good things, though we are deemed to be reprobates.

title: II Corinthians 13:8
text: For we have no power against the truth, but for the truth.

title: II Corinthians 13:9
text: For we are glad when we are weak, and you are powerful. But we pray also for this, your perfection.

title: II Corinthians 13:10
text: Therefore I write these things while absent, lest being present I may not deal sharply [with you] according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up, and not for pulling down.

title: II Corinthians 13:11
text: Finally, brothers, rejoice. Perfect yourselves; encourage yourselves; mind the same thing; be at peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you.

title: II Corinthians 13:12
text: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

title: II Corinthians 13:13
text: All the saints greet you.

title: II Corinthians 13:14
text: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit [be] with you all. Amen.

title: Galatians 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle (not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised Him from the dead),

title: Galatians 1:2
text: and all the brothers with me, to the churches of Galatia.

title: Galatians 1:3
text: Grace [be] to you, and peace from God the Father and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

title: Galatians 1:4
text: who gave Himself for our sins, that He might deliver us from this present evil world according to the will of God and our Father,

title: Galatians 1:5
text: to whom [be] glory forever and ever. Amen.

title: Galatians 1:6
text: I marvel that you so soon are being moved away from Him who called you into [the] grace of Christ, to another gospel,

title: Galatians 1:7
text: which is not another, but some are troubling you, and desiring to pervert the gospel of Christ.

title: Galatians 1:8
text: But even if we or an angel from Heaven preach a gospel to you beside what we preached to you, let him be accursed.

title: Galatians 1:9
text: As we said before, and now I say again, If anyone preaches a gospel to you beside what you have received, let him be accursed.

title: Galatians 1:10
text: For now do I persuade men, or God? Or do I seek to please men? For if I yet pleased men, I would not be a servant of Christ.

title: Galatians 1:11
text: And, brothers, I make known to you the gospel which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

title: Galatians 1:12
text: For I did not receive it from man, nor was I taught [it] except by a revelation of Jesus Christ.

title: Galatians 1:13
text: For you heard my manner of life when [I was] in Judaism, that I persecuted the church of God with surpassing [zeal], and ravaged it.

title: Galatians 1:14
text: And I progressed in Judaism beyond many contemporaries in my race, being much more a zealot of the traditions of my fathers.

title: Galatians 1:15
text: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and having called [me] by His grace,

title: Galatians 1:16
text: to reveal His Son in me so that I might preach Him among the nations, immediately I did not confer with flesh and blood;

title: Galatians 1:17
text: Nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those apostles before me, but I went into Arabia and returned again to Damascus.

title: Galatians 1:18
text: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

title: Galatians 1:19
text: But I saw no other of the apostles, except James the Lord's brother.

title: Galatians 1:20
text: And what I write to you, behold, before God, I do not lie.

title: Galatians 1:21
text: Then I went into the regions of Syria and of Cilicia,

title: Galatians 1:22
text: and was unknown by face to the churches of Judea in Christ.

title: Galatians 1:23
text: But only they were hearing that he who then persecuted us, now preaches the faith which he once ravaged.

title: Galatians 1:24
text: And they glorified God in me.

title: Galatians 2:1
text: Then through fourteen years, I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with [me] also.

title: Galatians 2:2
text: And I went up by revelation. And I put before them the gospel which I proclaim in the nations, but privately to those [seeming to be] pillars, lest I run, or I ran, into vanity.

title: Galatians 2:3
text: (But not even Titus, the [one] with me, a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.)

title: Galatians 2:4
text: But because of those false brothers stealing in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus; they desiring to enslave us;

title: Galatians 2:5
text: to whom not even for an hour did we yield in subjection, that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.

title: Galatians 2:6
text: But from those who seemed to be something (what kind they were then does not matter to me; God does not accept the face of man), for those seeming [important] conferred nothing to me.

title: Galatians 2:7
text: But on the contrary, seeing that I have been entrusted [with] the gospel of the uncircumcision, as Peter to the circumcision;

title: Galatians 2:8
text: for He working in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision also worked in me to the nations.

title: Galatians 2:9
text: and knowing the grace given to me, James, and Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, gave right hands of fellowship to Barnabas and me, that we [go] to the nations, but they to the circumcision.

title: Galatians 2:10
text: Only [they asked] that we remember the poor, which very thing I was eager to do.

title: Galatians 2:11
text: But when Peter came to Antioch, I opposed [him] to his face, because he was to be blamed.

title: Galatians 2:12
text: For before some came from James, he ate with the nations. But when they came, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing those of the circumcision.

title: Galatians 2:13
text: And the rest of the Jews also dissembled with him, so as even Barnabas was led away with their dissembling.

title: Galatians 2:14
text: But when I saw that they did not walk uprightly with the truth of the gospel, I said to Peter before all, If you, being a Jew, live as a Gentile, and not as the Jews, why do you compel [the] nations to judaize?

title: Galatians 2:15
text: We Jews by nature, and not sinners of the nations,

title: Galatians 2:16
text: knowing that a man is not justified by works of the Law, but through faith [in] Jesus Christ; even we believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith in Christ, and not by works of the Law. For all flesh will not be justified by works of law.

title: Galatians 2:17
text: But if, while we seek to be justified in Christ, we also were found [to be] sinners, [is] Christ therefore a minister of sin? Let it not be [said]!

title: Galatians 2:18
text: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I confirm myself [as] a transgressor.

title: Galatians 2:19
text: For through the Law I died to the law, that I might live to God.

title: Galatians 2:20
text: I have been crucified with Christ, and I live; [yet] no longer I, but Christ lives in me. And [that] life I now live in the flesh, I live by faith toward the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself on my behalf.

title: Galatians 2:21
text: I do not set aside the grace of God, for if righteousness [is] through law, then Christ died without cause.

title: Galatians 3:1
text: O foolish Galatians, who bewitched you not to obey the truth, to whom before [your] eyes Jesus Christ was written among you crucified?

title: Galatians 3:2
text: This only I would learn from you: Did you receive the Spirit by works of [the] law, or by hearing of faith?

title: Galatians 3:3
text: Are you so foolish? Having begun in [the] Spirit, do you now perfect [yourself] in the flesh?

title: Galatians 3:4
text: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if indeed [it is] even in vain?

title: Galatians 3:5
text: Then He supplying the Spirit to you and working powerful works in you, [is it] by works of [the] law, or by hearing of faith?

title: Galatians 3:6
text: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.

title: Galatians 3:7
text: Therefore know that those of faith, these are the sons of Abraham.

title: Galatians 3:8
text: And the Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the nations through faith, preached the gospel before to Abraham, [saying], "In you shall all nations be blessed."

title: Galatians 3:9
text: So then those of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.

title: Galatians 3:10
text: For as many as are out of works of the Law, these are under a curse; for it is written, "Cursed [is] everyone who does not continue in all things which are written in the Book of the Law, to do them."

title: Galatians 3:11
text: But that no one is justified by the Law in the sight of God [is] clear, for, "The just shall live by faith."

title: Galatians 3:12
text: But the Law is not of faith; but, "The man who does these things shall live in them."

title: Galatians 3:13
text: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the Law, being made a curse for us (for it is written, "Cursed [is] everyone having been hanged on a tree");

title: Galatians 3:14
text: so that the blessing of Abraham might be to the nations in Jesus Christ, and that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

title: Galatians 3:15
text: Brothers, I speak according to man, a covenant having been ratified, even [among] mankind, no one sets aside or adds to [it].

title: Galatians 3:16
text: And to Abraham and to his Seed the promises were spoken. It does not say, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, "And to your Seed," which is Christ.

title: Galatians 3:17
text: And I say this, A covenant having been ratified to Christ by God in Christ, the Law (coming into being four hundred and thirty years after) does not annul the promise, so as to abolish it.

title: Galatians 3:18
text: For if the inheritance [is] of Law, [it is] no more of promise; but God gave [it] to Abraham by way of promise.

title: Galatians 3:19
text: Why then the Law? It was added because of transgressions, until the Seed should come [to those] to whom it had been promised, being ordained through angels in the Mediator's hand.

title: Galatians 3:20
text: But the Mediator is not [a mediator] of one, but God is one.

title: Galatians 3:21
text: [Is] the Law then against the promises of God? Let it not be [said]! For if a law had been given which could have given life, indeed righteousness would have been out of Law.

title: Galatians 3:22
text: But the Scripture shut up all under sin, so that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

title: Galatians 3:23
text: But before faith came, we were kept under Law, having been shut up to the faith about to be revealed.

title: Galatians 3:24
text: So that the Law has become a trainer of us until Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

title: Galatians 3:25
text: But faith coming, we are no longer under a trainer.

title: Galatians 3:26
text: For you are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.

title: Galatians 3:27
text: For as many as were baptized into Christ, you put on Christ.

title: Galatians 3:28
text: There cannot be Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is no male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

title: Galatians 3:29
text: And if you [are] Christ's, then you are Abraham's seed and heirs according to the promise.

title: Galatians 4:1
text: But I say, Over so long a time the heir is an infant, he does not differ from a slave, though being lord of all;

title: Galatians 4:2
text: but he is under guardians and housemasters until the term appointed before by the father.

title: Galatians 4:3
text: Even so we, when we were infants, were in bondage under the elements of the world.

title: Galatians 4:4
text: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent forth His Son, coming into being out of a woman, having come under Law,

title: Galatians 4:5
text: that He might redeem those under Law, so that we might receive the adoption of sons.

title: Galatians 4:6
text: And because you are sons, God has sent forth the Spirit of His Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

title: Galatians 4:7
text: So that you are no longer a slave, but a son; and if a son, also an heir of God through Christ.

title: Galatians 4:8
text: But then, indeed, not knowing God, you served as slaves [to] those not by nature being gods.

title: Galatians 4:9
text: But now, knowing God, but rather are known by God, how do you turn again to the weak and beggarly elements to which you desire to slave anew?

title: Galatians 4:10
text: You observe days and months and times and years.

title: Galatians 4:11
text: I fear [for] you, lest somehow I have labored among you in vain.

title: Galatians 4:12
text: Brothers, I beseech you, be as I [am]; for I [am] as you. You have not injured me at all.

title: Galatians 4:13
text: But you know that through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel to you before,

title: Galatians 4:14
text: and you did not despise my temptation in my flesh, nor did you spurn [it]. But you received me as an angel of God, as Christ Jesus.

title: Galatians 4:15
text: What then was your blessedness? For I bear you record that, if you were able, plucking out your eyes, [you] would have given [them] to me.

title: Galatians 4:16
text: So then did I become your enemy speaking to you the truth?

title: Galatians 4:17
text: They are zealous for you, [but] not well. But they [only] desire to shut you out, that you be zealous to them.

title: Galatians 4:18
text: But [it is] good to be zealous always in [a] good [thing], and not only in my being present with you.

title: Galatians 4:19
text: My children, [for] whom I again travail until Christ should be formed in you,

title: Galatians 4:20
text: even now I desired to be present with you, and to change my voice; for I am in doubt [as] to you.

title: Galatians 4:21
text: Tell me, those desiring to be under Law, do you not hear the Law?

title: Galatians 4:22
text: For it is written: Abraham had two sons, the one out of the slave-woman, and one out of the free woman.

title: Galatians 4:23
text: But, indeed, he out of the slave-woman has been born according to flesh, and he out of the free woman through the promise;

title: Galatians 4:24
text: which things are being allegorized; for these are the two covenants, one indeed from Mount Sinai bringing forth to slavery, which is Hagar.

title: Galatians 4:25
text: For Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to Jerusalem which now is, and is in slavery with her children.

title: Galatians 4:26
text: But the Jerusalem [from] above is free, who is the mother of us all.

title: Galatians 4:27
text: For it is written, "Rejoice, barren one not bearing; break forth and shout, you not travailing; for more are the children of the desolate than she having the husband."

title: Galatians 4:28
text: But brothers, we, like Isaac, are children of promise.

title: Galatians 4:29
text: But then even as he born according to flesh persecuted him [born] according to the Spirit, so also now.

title: Galatians 4:30
text: But what does the Scripture say? "Cast out the slave-woman and her son; for in no way shall the son of the slave-woman inherit with the son of the free woman."

title: Galatians 4:31
text: Then, brothers, we are not children of a slave-woman, but of the free woman.

title: Galatians 5:1
text: Stand fast therefore in the liberty with which Christ has made us free, and do not again be held with the yoke of bondage.

title: Galatians 5:2
text: Behold, I, Paul, say to you that if you are circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

title: Galatians 5:3
text: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do all the Law,

title: Galatians 5:4
text: you who are justified by Law are deprived of all effect from Christ; you fell from grace.

title: Galatians 5:5
text: For we through [the] Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness out of faith.

title: Galatians 5:6
text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any strength, but faith working through love.

title: Galatians 5:7
text: You were running well. Who hindered you [that] you do not obey the truth?

title: Galatians 5:8
text: [This] persuasion [is] not from Him who calls you.

title: Galatians 5:9
text: A little leaven leavens all the lump.

title: Galatians 5:10
text: I have confidence in you in the Lord, that you will think nothing else, but that he troubling you shall bear the judgment, whoever he may be.

title: Galatians 5:11
text: And I, brothers, if I yet proclaim circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the offense of the Cross has ceased.

title: Galatians 5:12
text: I wish that those causing you to doubt will cut themselves off.

title: Galatians 5:13
text: For, brothers, you were called to liberty. Only do not [use] the liberty for [an] opening to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

title: Galatians 5:14
text: For all the Law is fulfilled in one word, [even] in this, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."

title: Galatians 5:15
text: But if you bite and devour one another, take heed that you are not consumed by one another.

title: Galatians 5:16
text: I say, then, Walk in [the] Spirit and you shall not fulfill [the] lusts of [the] flesh.

title: Galatians 5:17
text: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh. And these are contrary to one another; lest whatever you may will, these things you do.

title: Galatians 5:18
text: But if you are led by [the] Spirit, you are not under law.

title: Galatians 5:19
text: Now the works of the flesh are clearly revealed, which are: adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lustfulness,

title: Galatians 5:20
text: idolatry, sorcery, hatreds, fightings, jealousies, angers, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

title: Galatians 5:21
text: envyings, murders, drunkennesses, revelings, and things like these; of which I tell you before, as I also said before, that they who do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

title: Galatians 5:22
text: But the fruit of the Spirit is: love, joy, peace, long-suffering, kindness, goodness, faith,

title: Galatians 5:23
text: meekness, self-control; against such things there is no law.

title: Galatians 5:24
text: But those belonging to Christ have crucified the flesh with [its] passions and lusts.

title: Galatians 5:25
text: If we live in [the] Spirit, let us also walk in [the] Spirit.

title: Galatians 5:26
text: Let us not become glory-seeking, provoking one another, envying one another.

title: Galatians 6:1
text: Brothers, if a man is overtaken in a fault, you the spiritual ones restore such a one in the spirit of meekness, considering yourself, lest you also be tempted.

title: Galatians 6:2
text: Bear one another's burdens, and so you will fulfill the law of Christ.

title: Galatians 6:3
text: For if anyone thinks himself to be something, being nothing, he deceives himself.

title: Galatians 6:4
text: But let each one prove his own work, and then he alone will have a boast in himself, and not in another.

title: Galatians 6:5
text: For each one will bear [his] own load.

title: Galatians 6:6
text: But let him who is taught in the Word share with the [one] teaching in all good things.

title: Galatians 6:7
text: Do not be deceived, God is not mocked. For whatever a man sows, that he also will reap.

title: Galatians 6:8
text: For he sowing to his flesh will reap corruption from the flesh. But he sowing to the Spirit will reap life everlasting from the Spirit.

title: Galatians 6:9
text: But we should not lose heart in well-doing, for in due season we shall reap, if [we] do not faint.

title: Galatians 6:10
text: So then as we have time, let us work good toward all, especially toward those of the household of faith.

title: Galatians 6:11
text: See in what large letters I write to you with my hand.

title: Galatians 6:12
text: As many as desire to look well in [the] flesh, these compel you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

title: Galatians 6:13
text: For they themselves, having been circumcised, do not even keep the Law, but they desire you to be circumcised so that they may boast in your flesh.

title: Galatians 6:14
text: But may it never be for me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified to me, and I to the world.

title: Galatians 6:15
text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision [has] any strength, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

title: Galatians 6:16
text: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace and mercy [be] upon them and upon the Israel of God.

title: Galatians 6:17
text: For the rest, let no one give troubles to me, for I bear in my body the brands of the Lord Jesus.

title: Galatians 6:18
text: Brothers, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with your spirit. Amen.

title: Ephesians 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints who are in Ephesus, and faithful in Christ Jesus.

title: Ephesians 1:2
text: Grace [be] to you, and peace from God our Father and [from the] Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Ephesians 1:3
text: Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenlies in Christ;

title: Ephesians 1:4
text: according as He chose us in Him before [the] foundation of [the] world, that we should be holy and without blame before Him in love,

title: Ephesians 1:5
text: having predestined us to the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to Himself, according to the good pleasure of His will,

title: Ephesians 1:6
text: to [the] praise of [the] glory of His grace, in which He has made us accepted in the [One] having been loved.

title: Ephesians 1:7
text: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of His grace,

title: Ephesians 1:8
text: which He caused to abound toward us in all wisdom and understanding;

title: Ephesians 1:9
text: having made known to us the mystery of His will, according to His good pleasure which He purposed in Himself,

title: Ephesians 1:10
text: for an administration of the fullness of times, to head up all things in Christ, both the things in Heaven, and the things on earth, [even] in Him,

title: Ephesians 1:11
text: in whom also we have been chosen to an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of Him who works all things according to the counsel of His own will,

title: Ephesians 1:12
text: for us to be to [the] praise of His glory, who previously had trusted in Christ;

title: Ephesians 1:13
text: in whom also you, hearing the word of truth, the gospel of our salvation, in whom also believing, you were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,

title: Ephesians 1:14
text: who is the earnest of our inheritance, to [the] redemption of the purchased possession, to [the] praise of His glory.

title: Ephesians 1:15
text: Therefore I also, hearing of your faith in the Lord Jesus and love to all the saints,

title: Ephesians 1:16
text: do not cease giving thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

title: Ephesians 1:17
text: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in [the] knowledge of Him,

title: Ephesians 1:18
text: the eyes of your understanding being enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of His calling, and what is the riches of the glory of His inheritance in the saints,

title: Ephesians 1:19
text: and what [is] the surpassing greatness of His power toward us, the ones believing according to the working of His mighty strength

title: Ephesians 1:20
text: which He worked [in] Christ in raising Him from [the] dead, and He seated [Him] at His right hand in the heavenlies,

title: Ephesians 1:21
text: far above all principality and authority and power and dominion, and every name being named, not only in this world, but also in the coming age.

title: Ephesians 1:22
text: And He has put all [things] under His feet and gave Him [to be] Head over all [things] to the church,

title: Ephesians 1:23
text: which is His body, the fullness of Him who fills all in all.

title: Ephesians 2:1
text: And He [has made you alive], who were once dead in trespasses and sins,

title: Ephesians 2:2
text: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now works in the children of disobedience;

title: Ephesians 2:3
text: among whom we also had our way of life in times past, in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the thoughts, and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

title: Ephesians 2:4
text: But God, who is rich in mercy, for His great love [with] which He loved us

title: Ephesians 2:5
text: (even when we were dead in sins) has made us alive together with Christ (by grace you are saved),

title: Ephesians 2:6
text: and has raised [us] up together and made [us] sit together in the heavenlies in Christ Jesus,

title: Ephesians 2:7
text: so that in the ages to come He might show the exceeding riches of His grace in [His] kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.

title: Ephesians 2:8
text: For by grace you are saved through faith, and that not of yourselves, [it is] the gift of God,

title: Ephesians 2:9
text: not of works, lest anyone should boast.

title: Ephesians 2:10
text: For we are [His] workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to good works, which God has before ordained that we should walk in them.

title: Ephesians 2:11
text: Therefore remember that you, the nations, in time past [were] in [the] flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;

title: Ephesians 2:12
text: and that at that time you were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world.

title: Ephesians 2:13
text: But now in Christ Jesus you who were once afar off are made near by the blood of Christ.

title: Ephesians 2:14
text: For He is our peace, He making us both one, and [He] has broken down the middle wall of partition [between us],

title: Ephesians 2:15
text: having abolished in His flesh the enmity (the Law of commandments [contained] in ordinances) so that in Himself He might make the two into one new man, making peace [between them];

title: Ephesians 2:16
text: and so that He might reconcile both to God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity in Himself.

title: Ephesians 2:17
text: And He came and preached peace to you who were afar off, and to those who were near.

title: Ephesians 2:18
text: For through Him we both have access by one Spirit to the Father.

title: Ephesians 2:19
text: Now therefore you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with the saints, and of the household of God,

title: Ephesians 2:20
text: and are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ Himself being [the] chief cornerstone,

title: Ephesians 2:21
text: in whom every building having been fitly framed together, grows into a holy sanctuary in the Lord;

title: Ephesians 2:22
text: in whom you also are built together for a dwelling place of God through [the] Spirit.

title: Ephesians 3:1
text: For this cause, I, Paul, am the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you nations,

title: Ephesians 3:2
text: if you have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given to me toward you,

title: Ephesians 3:3
text: that by revelation He made known to me the mystery (as I wrote before in few words,

title: Ephesians 3:4
text: by which, when you read, you may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)

title: Ephesians 3:5
text: which in other ages was not made known to the sons of men, as it is now revealed to His holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit,

title: Ephesians 3:6
text: that the nations should be fellow heirs, and of the same body, and partaker of His promise in Christ through the gospel.

title: Ephesians 3:7
text: Of this [gospel] I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given to me by the effectual working of His power.

title: Ephesians 3:8
text: This grace is given to me ([who am] less than the least of all saints) to preach the gospel of the unsearchable riches of Christ among the nations,

title: Ephesians 3:9
text: and to bring to light what [is] the fellowship of the mystery which from eternity has been hidden in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ;

title: Ephesians 3:10
text: so that now to the rulers and powers in the heavenlies might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,

title: Ephesians 3:11
text: according to the eternal purpose which He purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord;

title: Ephesians 3:12
text: in whom we have boldness and access with confidence through His faith.

title: Ephesians 3:13
text: For this reason I desire that you faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

title: Ephesians 3:14
text: For this cause I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

title: Ephesians 3:15
text: of whom the whole family in Heaven and earth is named,

title: Ephesians 3:16
text: that He would grant you, according to the riches of His glory, to be strengthened with might by His Spirit in the inner man;

title: Ephesians 3:17
text: that Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

title: Ephesians 3:18
text: may be able to comprehend with all saints what [is] the breadth and length and depth and height,

title: Ephesians 3:19
text: and to know the love of Christ which passes knowledge, that you might be filled with all the fullness of God.

title: Ephesians 3:20
text: Now to Him who is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

title: Ephesians 3:21
text: to Him [be] glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, forever. Amen.

title: Ephesians 4:1
text: I therefore, the prisoner in [the] Lord, beseech you that you walk worthy of the calling with which you are called,

title: Ephesians 4:2
text: with all lowliness and meekness, with long-suffering, forbearing one another in love,

title: Ephesians 4:3
text: endeavoring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

title: Ephesians 4:4
text: [There is] one body and one Spirit, even as you are called in one hope of your calling,

title: Ephesians 4:5
text: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

title: Ephesians 4:6
text: one God and Father of all, who [is] above all and through all and in you all.

title: Ephesians 4:7
text: But to every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

title: Ephesians 4:8
text: Therefore He says, "When He ascended up on high, He led captivity captive and gave gifts to men."

title: Ephesians 4:9
text: (Now that He ascended, what is it but that He also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?

title: Ephesians 4:10
text: He who descended is the same also as He who ascended up far above all heavens, that He might fill all things.)

title: Ephesians 4:11
text: And truly He gave some [to be] apostles, and some [to be] prophets, and some [to be] evangelists, and some [to be] pastors and teachers,

title: Ephesians 4:12
text: for the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ.

title: Ephesians 4:13
text: And this until we all come into the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full-grown man, to [the] measure of [the] stature of the fullness of Christ;

title: Ephesians 4:14
text: so that we no longer may be infants, tossed to and fro and carried about by every wind of doctrine, in the dishonesty of men, in cunning craftiness, to the wiles of deceit.

title: Ephesians 4:15
text: But that you, speaking the truth in love, may in all things grow up to Him who is the Head, [even] Christ;

title: Ephesians 4:16
text: from whom the whole body, fitted together and compacted by that which every joint supplies, according to [the] effectual working in the measure of each part, producing the growth of the body to the edifying of itself in love.

title: Ephesians 4:17
text: This I say therefore, and testify in [the] Lord, that you should not walk from now on as other nations walk, in [the] vanity of their mind,

title: Ephesians 4:18
text: having the understanding darkened, being alienated [from] the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart.

title: Ephesians 4:19
text: For they, being past feeling, have given themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

title: Ephesians 4:20
text: But you have not so learned Christ,

title: Ephesians 4:21
text: if indeed you have heard Him and were taught by Him, as [the] truth is in Jesus.

title: Ephesians 4:22
text: For you ought to put off the old man (according to your way of living before) who is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts,

title: Ephesians 4:23
text: and be renewed in the spirit of your mind.

title: Ephesians 4:24
text: And you should put on the new man, who according to God [was] created in righteousness and true holiness.

title: Ephesians 4:25
text: Therefore putting away lying, let each man speak truth with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.

title: Ephesians 4:26
text: Be angry, and do not sin. Do not let the sun go down upon your wrath,

title: Ephesians 4:27
text: neither give place to the Devil.

title: Ephesians 4:28
text: Let him who stole steal no more, but rather let him labor, working with [his] hands the thing which [is] good, so that he may have [something] to give to him who needs.

title: Ephesians 4:29
text: Let not any filthy word go out of your mouth, but if any [is] good to building up [in respect of] need, that it may give grace to the ones hearing.

title: Ephesians 4:30
text: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, by whom you are sealed until [the] day of redemption.

title: Ephesians 4:31
text: Let all bitterness and wrath and anger and tumult and evil speaking be put away from you, with all malice.

title: Ephesians 4:32
text: And be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake has forgiven you.

title: Ephesians 5:1
text: Therefore be followers of God, as dear children.

title: Ephesians 5:2
text: And walk in love, as Christ also has loved us, and has given Himself for us as an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet smelling savor.

title: Ephesians 5:3
text: For let fornication and all uncleanness or covetousness not be once named among you, as becomes saints,

title: Ephesians 5:4
text: neither baseness, foolish talking, jesting, which are not becoming, but rather giving of thanks.

title: Ephesians 5:5
text: For you know this, that no fornicator, or unclean person, or covetous [one] (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

title: Ephesians 5:6
text: Let no man deceive you with vain words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the children of disobedience.

title: Ephesians 5:7
text: Therefore do not be partakers with them.

title: Ephesians 5:8
text: For you were once darkness, but now [you are] light in [the] Lord; walk as children of light

title: Ephesians 5:9
text: (for the fruit of the Spirit [is] in all goodness and righteousness and truth),

title: Ephesians 5:10
text: proving what is acceptable to the Lord.

title: Ephesians 5:11
text: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove [them].

title: Ephesians 5:12
text: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done by them in secret.

title: Ephesians 5:13
text: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light, for whatever makes manifest [is] light.

title: Ephesians 5:14
text: Therefore he says, "Awake, sleeping ones! And arise from the dead, and Christ shall give you light."

title: Ephesians 5:15
text: See then that you walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,

title: Ephesians 5:16
