text: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

title: Ephesians 5:17
text: Therefore do not be unwise, but understand what the will of the Lord [is].

title: Ephesians 5:18
text: And do not be drunk with wine, in which is excess, but be filled with the Spirit,

title: Ephesians 5:19
text: speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

title: Ephesians 5:20
text: always giving thanks for all things to God [the] Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,

title: Ephesians 5:21
text: submitting yourselves to one another in the fear of God.

title: Ephesians 5:22
text: Wives, submit yourselves to [your] own husbands, as to the Lord.

title: Ephesians 5:23
text: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ [is] the head of the church; and He is the Savior of the body.

title: Ephesians 5:24
text: Therefore as the church is subject to Christ, so [let] the wives [be] to their own husbands in everything.

title: Ephesians 5:25
text: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church and gave Himself for it,

title: Ephesians 5:26
text: that He might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the Word,

title: Ephesians 5:27
text: that He might present it to Himself [as] the glorious church, without spot or wrinkle or any such things, but that it should be holy and without blemish.

title: Ephesians 5:28
text: So men ought to love their wives as their [own] bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.

title: Ephesians 5:29
text: For no man ever yet hated his [own] flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord loves the church.

title: Ephesians 5:30
text: For we are members of His body, of His flesh, and of His bones.

title: Ephesians 5:31
text: "For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother and shall be joined to his wife, and the two of them shall be one flesh."

title: Ephesians 5:32
text: This is a great mystery, but I speak concerning Christ and the church.

title: Ephesians 5:33
text: But also let everyone of you in particular so love his wife even as himself, and the wife that she defers to her husband.

title: Ephesians 6:1
text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

title: Ephesians 6:2
text: Honor your father and mother (which is the first commandment with a promise),

title: Ephesians 6:3
text: so that it may be well with you, and that you may live long on the earth.

title: Ephesians 6:4
text: And fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath, but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

title: Ephesians 6:5
text: Slaves, obey [your] masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ;

title: Ephesians 6:6
text: not with eye-service, as men-pleasers, but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from [the] heart,

title: Ephesians 6:7
text: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men

title: Ephesians 6:8
text: (knowing that whatever good thing he does, he shall receive the same from the Lord, whether [he is] a slave or a freeman).

title: Ephesians 6:9
text: And masters, do the same things to them, forbearing threatening, knowing that your Master also is in Heaven. There is no respect of persons with Him.

title: Ephesians 6:10
text: Finally, my brothers, be strong in [the] Lord and in the power of His might.

title: Ephesians 6:11
text: Put on the whole armor of God so that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

title: Ephesians 6:12
text: For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the world's rulers, of the darkness of this age, against spiritual wickedness in high [places].

title: Ephesians 6:13
text: Therefore take to yourselves the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

title: Ephesians 6:14
text: Therefore stand, having your loins girded about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness

title: Ephesians 6:15
text: and your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace.

title: Ephesians 6:16
text: Above all, take the shield of faith, with which you shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

title: Ephesians 6:17
text: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the Word of God,

title: Ephesians 6:18
text: praying always with all prayer and supplication in [the] Spirit, and watching to this very thing with all perseverance and supplication for all saints.

title: Ephesians 6:19
text: And pray for me, that utterance may be given to me, that I may open my mouth boldly to make known the mystery of the gospel,

title: Ephesians 6:20
text: for which I am an ambassador in bonds; so that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

title: Ephesians 6:21
text: But, so that you also may know my affairs [and] how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in [the] Lord, shall make known to you all things,

title: Ephesians 6:22
text: whom I have sent to you for the same purpose, that you might know our affairs and [that] he might comfort your hearts.

title: Ephesians 6:23
text: Peace to the brothers, and love with faith, from God [the] Father and [the] Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Ephesians 6:24
text: Grace [be] with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.

title: Philippians 1:1
text: Paul and Timothy, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and deacons.

title: Philippians 1:2
text: Grace to you, and peace from God our Father and from [the] Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Philippians 1:3
text: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

title: Philippians 1:4
text: always in every prayer of mine making [my] request for you all with joy

title: Philippians 1:5
text: for your fellowship in the gospel from [the] first day until now;

title: Philippians 1:6
text: being confident of this very thing, that He who has begun a good work in you will perform [it] until the day of Jesus Christ,

title: Philippians 1:7
text: even as it is righteous for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart, inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partakers of my grace.

title: Philippians 1:8
text: For God is my witness how greatly I long after you all in [the] bowels of Jesus Christ.

title: Philippians 1:9
text: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in full knowledge and [in] all perception;

title: Philippians 1:10
text: that you may distinguish [between] things that differ, that you may be sincere and without offense until the day of Jesus Christ,

title: Philippians 1:11
text: being filled [with the] fruits of righteousness through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

title: Philippians 1:12
text: But I desire that you should understand, brothers, that the things [which happened] to me have fallen out rather to [the] furtherance of the gospel;

title: Philippians 1:13
text: so that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other [places].

title: Philippians 1:14
text: And most of the brothers in [the] Lord, becoming confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

title: Philippians 1:15
text: Some indeed even preach Christ because of envy and strife, and some also of good will.

title: Philippians 1:16
text: Those, indeed, preach Christ out of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds.

title: Philippians 1:17
text: But these [others] preach in love, knowing that I am set for the defense of the gospel.

title: Philippians 1:18
text: What then? Nevertheless, in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is preached. And I rejoice in this. Yet, also I will rejoice.

title: Philippians 1:19
text: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer and [the] supply of [the] Spirit of Jesus Christ,

title: Philippians 1:20
text: according to my earnest expectation and hope that I shall be ashamed in nothing, but as always now Christ shall be magnified in my body with all boldness, whether it is by life or by death.

title: Philippians 1:21
text: For to me to live [is] Christ, and to die [is] gain.

title: Philippians 1:22
text: But if [I] live in [the] flesh, this [is] the fruit of [my] labor. Yet I do not know what I shall choose.

title: Philippians 1:23
text: For I am pressed together by the two: having a desire to depart and to be with Christ, which is far better.

title: Philippians 1:24
text: But to remain in the flesh [is] more needful for you.

title: Philippians 1:25
text: And having this confidence, I know that I shall remain and continue with you all, for your advancement and joy of faith,

title: Philippians 1:26
text: so that your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.

title: Philippians 1:27
text: Only let your conduct be as becomes the gospel of Christ, so that whether I come and see you, or else am absent, I may hear of your [affairs], that you stand fast in one spirit, striving together with one mind for the faith of the gospel,

title: Philippians 1:28
text: and terrified in nothing by your adversaries. [For this is] to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.

title: Philippians 1:29
text: For to you it is given on behalf of Christ not only to believe on Him, but also to suffer for His sake,

title: Philippians 1:30
text: having the same conflict which you saw in me, and now hear [to be] in me.

title: Philippians 2:1
text: If [there is] therefore any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of [the] Spirit, if any tendernesses and mercies,

title: Philippians 2:2
text: then fulfill my joy, that you may be like-minded, having the same love, [being] of one accord and of one mind.

title: Philippians 2:3
text: [Let] nothing [be done] through strife or vainglory, but in lowliness of mind let each esteem others better than themselves.

title: Philippians 2:4
text: Do not let each man look upon his own things, but each man also [on] the things of others.

title: Philippians 2:5
text: For let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus,

title: Philippians 2:6
text: who, being in the form of God, thought [it] not robbery to be equal with God,

title: Philippians 2:7
text: but made Himself of no reputation, and took [upon Himself] the form of a servant, and was made in [the] likeness of men.

title: Philippians 2:8
text: And being found in fashion as a man, He humbled Himself [and] became obedient unto death, even [the] death of the cross.

title: Philippians 2:9
text: Therefore God has highly exalted Him, and has given Him a name [which is] above every name,

title: Philippians 2:10
text: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of heavenly ones, and of earthly ones, and of ones under [the] earth;

title: Philippians 2:11
text: and [that] every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ [is] Lord, to [the] glory of God [the] Father.

title: Philippians 2:12
text: Therefore, my beloved, as you have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, cultivate your own salvation with fear and trembling.

title: Philippians 2:13
text: For it is God who works in you both to will and to do of [His] good pleasure.

title: Philippians 2:14
text: Do all things without murmurings and disputings,

title: Philippians 2:15
text: so that you may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation. Among these you shine as lights in the world,

title: Philippians 2:16
text: holding forth the word of life, so that I may rejoice with you in [the] day of Christ, that I have not run in vain nor labored in vain.

title: Philippians 2:17
text: Yea, and if I am offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy and rejoice with you all.

title: Philippians 2:18
text: And you also rejoice [in] the same, and rejoice with me.

title: Philippians 2:19
text: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy shortly to you, so that I also may be of good comfort when I know [your state].

title: Philippians 2:20
text: For I have no one who is like-minded, who will naturally care for [your state].

title: Philippians 2:21
text: For all seek their own, not the things which are of Jesus Christ.

title: Philippians 2:22
text: But you know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he has served with me in the gospel.

title: Philippians 2:23
text: Therefore I hope to send him presently, as soon as I shall see the things about me.

title: Philippians 2:24
text: But I trust in [the] Lord that I myself shall also come shortly.

title: Philippians 2:25
text: Yet I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother and fellow-worker, and fellow-soldier, but your messenger and he who ministered to my wants.

title: Philippians 2:26
text: For he longed after you all and was full of heaviness, because you had heard that he had been sick.

title: Philippians 2:27
text: For indeed he was sick, coming near death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

title: Philippians 2:28
text: Therefore I sent him the more eagerly, so that you may rejoice when you see him again, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

title: Philippians 2:29
text: Therefore receive him in the Lord with all gladness, and hold such in honor,

title: Philippians 2:30
text: because for the work of Christ he was near death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.

title: Philippians 3:1
text: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in [the] Lord. To write the same things to you is indeed not grievous to me, but for you [it is] safe.

title: Philippians 3:2
text: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision party.

title: Philippians 3:3
text: For we are the circumcision who worship God in the spirit and rejoice in Christ Jesus and have no confidence in the flesh;

title: Philippians 3:4
text: though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other thinks that he has reason to trust in the flesh, I more.

title: Philippians 3:5
text: I was circumcised [the] eighth day, of [the] stock of Israel, [of the] tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of the Hebrews. As regards the Law, [I was] a Pharisee;

title: Philippians 3:6
text: concerning zeal, persecuting the church; regarding the righteousness in the Law, blameless.

title: Philippians 3:7
text: But whatever things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.

title: Philippians 3:8
text: But no, rather, I also count all things to be loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord, for whose sake I have suffered the loss of all things, and count them [to be] dung, so that I may win Christ

title: Philippians 3:9
text: and be found in Him; not having my own righteousness, which is of the Law, but through [the] faith of Christ, the righteousness of God by faith,

title: Philippians 3:10
text: that I may know Him and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being made conformable to His death;

title: Philippians 3:11
text: if by any means I might attain to the resurrection of the dead.

title: Philippians 3:12
text: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect, but I am pressing on, if I may lay hold of that for which I also was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

title: Philippians 3:13
text: My brothers, I do not count myself to have taken possession, but one [thing I do], forgetting the things behind and reaching forward to the things before,

title: Philippians 3:14
text: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

title: Philippians 3:15
text: Let us therefore, as many as [are] perfect, be of this mind. And if in anything you are otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this to you.

title: Philippians 3:16
text: Yet, as to what we have already attained, let us walk in the same rule, let us mind the same thing.

title: Philippians 3:17
text: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and mark those who walk this way, for you have us [for] a pattern.

title: Philippians 3:18
text: (For many are walking, of whom I have told you often and now tell you even weeping, [as] the enemies of the cross of Christ;

title: Philippians 3:19
text: whose end [is] destruction, whose god [is their] belly, and [whose] glory [is] in their shame, [those] who mind earthly things.)

title: Philippians 3:20
text: For our citizenship is in Heaven, from which also we are looking for the Savior, [the] Lord Jesus Christ,

title: Philippians 3:21
text: who shall change our body of humiliation so that it may be fashioned like His glorious body, according to the working of His power, even to subdue all things to Himself.

title: Philippians 4:1
text: Therefore, my brothers, ones loved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand fast in this way in [the] Lord, beloved ones.

title: Philippians 4:2
text: I beg Euodia and Syntyche that they be of the same mind in [the] Lord.

title: Philippians 4:3
text: And I also beg you, true yoke-fellow, help those women who labored in the gospel with me and with Clement, and others of my fellow-laborers, whose names [are] in the Book of Life.

title: Philippians 4:4
text: Rejoice in [the] Lord always. Again I say, Rejoice!

title: Philippians 4:5
text: Let your moderation be known to all men. The Lord [is] at hand.

title: Philippians 4:6
text: Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

title: Philippians 4:7
text: And the peace of God which passes all understanding shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

title: Philippians 4:8
text: Finally, my brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things [are] honest, whatever [things are] right, whatever [things are] pure, whatever [things are] lovely, whatever [things are] of good report; if [ there is] any virtue and if [there is] any praise, think on these things.

title: Philippians 4:9
text: Do those things which you have also learned and received and heard and seen in me. And the God of peace shall be with you.

title: Philippians 4:10
text: But I rejoiced in [the] Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me has flourished again. Although you indeed did think, but you lacked opportunity.

title: Philippians 4:11
text: Not that I speak according to need, for I have learned to be content in whatever state I am.

title: Philippians 4:12
text: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound. In everything and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

title: Philippians 4:13
text: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

title: Philippians 4:14
text: Yet you did well in sharing my troubles.

title: Philippians 4:15
text: Now you Philippians know also that in [the] beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as regards giving and receiving, except you alone.

title: Philippians 4:16
text: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my necessity.

title: Philippians 4:17
text: I do not say this because I desire a gift, but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.

title: Philippians 4:18
text: But I have all, and abound. I have been filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things [which you sent], an odor of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable and well-pleasing to God.

title: Philippians 4:19
text: But my God shall supply all your need according to His riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

title: Philippians 4:20
text: Now unto God and our Father [be] glory forever and ever. Amen.

title: Philippians 4:21
text: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

title: Philippians 4:22
text: All the saints greet you, most of all those who are of Caesar's household.

title: Philippians 4:23
text: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you all. Amen.

title: Colossians 1:1
text: Paul, [an] apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy [our] brother,

title: Colossians 1:2
text: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colosse. Grace to you, and peace from God our Father and from [the] Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Colossians 1:3
text: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

title: Colossians 1:4
text: since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love [you have] to all the saints,

title: Colossians 1:5
text: for the hope which is laid up for you in Heaven, of which you heard before in the Word of the truth of the gospel,

title: Colossians 1:6
text: which has come to you as [it has] also in all the world, and it is bearing fruit, even also among you, since the day you heard and fully knew the grace of God in truth,

title: Colossians 1:7
text: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow-servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ for you,

title: Colossians 1:8
text: he also having shown your love in [the] Spirit to us.

title: Colossians 1:9
text: For this cause we also, since the day we heard, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that you might be filled [with] the knowledge of His will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding,

title: Colossians 1:10
text: that you might walk worthy of the Lord to all pleasing, being fruitful in every work and increasing in the knowledge of God,

title: Colossians 1:11
text: being empowered with all power, according to the might of His glory, to all patience and long-suffering with joyfulness,

title: Colossians 1:12
text: giving thanks to the Father, who has made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light.

title: Colossians 1:13
text: [For He] has delivered us from the power of darkness and has translated [us] into the kingdom of His dear Son;

title: Colossians 1:14
text: in whom we have redemption through His blood, the remission of sins.

title: Colossians 1:15
text: who is [the] image of the invisible God, [the] First-born of all creation.

title: Colossians 1:16
text: For all things were created by Him, the things in the heavens, and the things on the earth, the visible and the invisible, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers, all things were created through Him and for Him.

title: Colossians 1:17
text: And He is before all things, and by Him all things consist.

title: Colossians 1:18
text: And He is [the] Head of the body, the church, who is [the] Beginning, the First-born from the dead, that He may be pre-eminent in all things.

title: Colossians 1:19
text: For it pleased [the Father] that in Him all fullness should dwell.

title: Colossians 1:20
text: And through Him having made peace through the blood of His cross, it pleased the Father to reconcile all things to Himself through Him, whether the things on earth or the things in Heaven.

title: Colossians 1:21
text: And you, who were once alienated and enemies in [your] mind by wicked works, yet now He has reconciled

title: Colossians 1:22
text: in the body of His flesh through death, to present you holy and without blame, and without charge in His sight,

title: Colossians 1:23
text: if indeed you continue in the faith grounded and settled, and [are] not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which you have heard [and] which was proclaimed in all the creation under Heaven, of which I, Paul, became a minister,

title: Colossians 1:24
text: who now rejoice in my sufferings on your behalf, and I fill up the things lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh, on behalf of His body, which [is] the church;

title: Colossians 1:25
text: of which I became a minister, according to the administration of God given to me for you, to fulfill the word of God;

title: Colossians 1:26
text: the mystery which has been hidden from ages and from generations, but now has been revealed to His saints.

title: Colossians 1:27
text: [For to them] God would make known what [are] the riches of the glory of this mystery among the nations, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory,

title: Colossians 1:28
text: whom we preach, warning every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, so that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus.

title: Colossians 1:29
text: For which I also labor, striving according to the working of Him who works in me in power.

title: Colossians 2:1
text: For I want you to know what a great conflict I have for you and those at Laodicea, and [for] as many as have not seen my face in [the] flesh,

title: Colossians 2:2
text: that their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and to all riches of the full assurance of the understanding, to [the] full knowledge of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;

title: Colossians 2:3
text: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

title: Colossians 2:4
text: And I say this that not anyone should beguile you with enticing words.

title: Colossians 2:5
text: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and beholding your order and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

title: Colossians 2:6
text: Therefore as you have received Christ Jesus the Lord, [so] walk in Him,

title: Colossians 2:7
text: rooted and built up in Him, and established in the faith, as you have been taught, abounding in it with thanksgiving.

title: Colossians 2:8
text: Beware lest anyone rob you through philosophy and vain deceit, according to the tradition of men, according to the elements of the world, and not according to Christ.

title: Colossians 2:9
text: For in Him dwells all the fullness of the Godhead bodily.

title: Colossians 2:10
text: And you are complete in Him, who is the Head of all principality and power,

title: Colossians 2:11
text: in whom also you are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ,

title: Colossians 2:12
text: buried with Him in baptism, in whom also you were raised through the faith of the working of God, raising Him from the dead.

title: Colossians 2:13
text: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, He has made alive together with Him, having forgiven you all trespasses,

title: Colossians 2:14
text: blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.

title: Colossians 2:15
text: Having stripped rulers and authorities, He made a show of them publicly, triumphing [over] them in it.

title: Colossians 2:16
text: Therefore let no one judge you in food or in drink, or in respect of a holy day, or of the new moon, or of the sabbaths.

title: Colossians 2:17
text: For these are a shadow of things to come, but the body [is] of Christ.

title: Colossians 2:18
text: Let no one defraud you, delighting in humility and worship of the angels, intruding into things which he has not seen, without a cause [being] vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

title: Colossians 2:19
text: and not holding the Head, from whom all the body, having been supplied with the joints and bands, and having been joined together, will grow with the growth of God.

title: Colossians 2:20
text: If then you died with Christ from the elements of the world, why, as [though] living in [the] world, are you subject to [its] ordinances:

title: Colossians 2:21
text: touch not, taste not, handle not;

title: Colossians 2:22
text: which things are all for corruption in the using, according to the commands and doctrines of men?

title: Colossians 2:23
text: [These] things indeed have a reputation of wisdom in self-imposed worship and humility, and unsparing severity the body, not in any honor for the satisfying of the flesh.

title: Colossians 3:1
text: If then you were raised with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ is sitting at [the] right hand of God.

title: Colossians 3:2
text: Be mindful of things above, not on things on the earth.

title: Colossians 3:3
text: For you died, and your life has been hidden with Christ in God.

title: Colossians 3:4
text: When Christ our Life [is] revealed, then you also will be revealed with Him in glory.

title: Colossians 3:5
text: Therefore put to death your members which are on the earth: fornication, uncleanness, passion, evil desire, and covetousness (which is idolatry),

title: Colossians 3:6
text: on account of which things' sake the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience,

title: Colossians 3:7
text: among whom you also once walked, when you lived in these.

title: Colossians 3:8
text: But now also put off all [these] things: anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, shameful speech out of your mouth.

title: Colossians 3:9
text: Do not lie to one another, having put off the old man with his deeds

title: Colossians 3:10
text: and having put on the new, having been renewed in knowledge according to [the] image of Him who created him,

title: Colossians 3:11
text: where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, foreigner, Scythian, slave [or] freeman, but Christ [is] all things in all.

title: Colossians 3:12
text: Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, put on tender feelings of mercy, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, long-suffering,

title: Colossians 3:13
text: forbearing one another and forgiving yourselves, if anyone has a complaint against any. As Christ forgave you, so also you [do].

title: Colossians 3:14
text: And above all these things [put on] love, which is [the] bond of perfectness.

title: Colossians 3:15
text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which you also are called in one body, and be thankful.

title: Colossians 3:16
text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom, teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

title: Colossians 3:17
text: And everything, whatever you do in word or deed, [do] all in the name of [the] Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and [the] Father by Him.

title: Colossians 3:18
text: Wives, be subject to [your] own husbands, as is becoming in [the] Lord.

title: Colossians 3:19
text: Husbands, love [your] wives, and do not be bitter against them.

title: Colossians 3:20
text: Children, obey [your] parents in all things, for this is well-pleasing to the Lord.

title: Colossians 3:21
text: Fathers, do not provoke your children, lest they be discouraged.

title: Colossians 3:22
text: Slaves, obey [your] masters according to the flesh in all things; not with eye-service, as men-pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

title: Colossians 3:23
text: And whatever you do, do [it] heartily, as to the Lord and not to men;

title: Colossians 3:24
text: knowing that from the Lord you shall receive the reward of the inheritance. For you serve [the] Lord Christ.

title: Colossians 3:25
text: But he who does wrong shall receive [justice] for the wrong which he did, and there is no respect of persons.

title: Colossians 4:1
text: Masters, give to [your] slaves what [is] just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in Heaven.

title: Colossians 4:2
text: Continue in prayer and watch in it with thanksgiving,

title: Colossians 4:3
text: praying together about us also, that God may open to us a door of the Word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I also have been bound,

title: Colossians 4:4
text: that I may make it clear, as I ought to speak.

title: Colossians 4:5
text: Walk in wisdom toward those on the outside, redeeming the time.

title: Colossians 4:6
text: Let your speech [be] always with grace, having been seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

title: Colossians 4:7
text: Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful minister and fellow-servant in [the] Lord, will make known to you all things about me.

title: Colossians 4:8
text: I sent [him] to you for this very purpose, that he might know the things about you, and that he might comfort your hearts,

title: Colossians 4:9
text: along with Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is [one] of you. They shall make known to you all things here.

title: Colossians 4:10
text: Aristarchus my fellow prisoner greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (regarding whom you received commandments; if he comes to you, receive him),

title: Colossians 4:11
text: and [greetings from] Jesus, who is called Justus, those being of the circumcision. These alone [are my] fellow-workers for the kingdom of God, who became a comfort to me.

title: Colossians 4:12
text: Epaphras greets you, he being of you, a servant of Christ, always laboring fervently for you in prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

title: Colossians 4:13
text: For I bear him record that he has a great zeal for you and for those [who are] in Laodicea and those in Hierapolis.

title: Colossians 4:14
text: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

title: Colossians 4:15
text: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church in his house.

title: Colossians 4:16
text: And when this letter is read before you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the [letter] of Laodicea.

title: Colossians 4:17
text: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which you have received in [the] Lord, that you fulfill it.

title: Colossians 4:18
text: The salutation of Paul, by my own hand. Remember my bonds. Grace [be] with you. Amen.

title: I Thessalonians 1:1
text: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy to the church of the Thessalonians, in God [the] Father and in [the] Lord Jesus Christ. Grace to you, and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: I Thessalonians 1:2
text: We give thanks to God for you always, making mention of you in our prayers,

title: I Thessalonians 1:3
text: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father,

title: I Thessalonians 1:4
text: knowing, beloved brothers, your election of God.

title: I Thessalonians 1:5
text: For our gospel did not come to you in word only, but also in power and in [the] Holy Spirit, and in much assurance, as you know what kind [of men] we were among you for your sake.

title: I Thessalonians 1:6
text: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord, welcoming the word in much affliction, with joy of [the] Holy Spirit,

title: I Thessalonians 1:7
text: so that you were examples to all who believe in Macedonia and Achaia.

title: I Thessalonians 1:8
text: For from you the Word of the Lord sounded out, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we do not need to speak anything.

title: I Thessalonians 1:9
text: For they themselves witness what kind of entrance we had to you, even how you turned from idols to God in order to serve the living and true God,

title: I Thessalonians 1:10
text: and to wait for His Son from Heaven (whom He raised from [the] dead), Jesus, who delivered us from the wrath to come.

title: I Thessalonians 2:1
text: For, my brothers, you yourselves know our coming in to you, that it was not in vain.

title: I Thessalonians 2:2
text: But also suffering before, being insulted in Philippi, as you know, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God in much agony.

title: I Thessalonians 2:3
text: For our exhortation [to you was] not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile,

title: I Thessalonians 2:4
text: but as we have been approved by God to be entrusted [with] the gospel, even so we speak, not as pleasing men, but God, who tries our hearts.

title: I Thessalonians 2:5
text: For neither at any time did we use flattering words, as you know, nor with pretense of covetousness; God [is] witness.

title: I Thessalonians 2:6
text: Nor did we seek glory from men, neither from you nor from others, being able to be [so] with heaviness, as apostles of Christ.

title: I Thessalonians 2:7
text: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse warmly cherishes her children.

title: I Thessalonians 2:8
text: So affectionately longing for you, we were willing to have imparted to you, not only the gospel of God, but also our own souls, because you have become beloved to us.

title: I Thessalonians 2:9
text: For, brothers, you remember our labor and toil. [For] laboring night and day in order not to put a burden on any one of you, we preached the gospel of God to you.

title: I Thessalonians 2:10
text: You and God [are] witnesses how holily and justly and blamelessly we were to you who believe,

title: I Thessalonians 2:11
text: even as you know how we exhorted and comforted and testified to each one of you, as a father to his children,

title: I Thessalonians 2:12
text: that you should walk worthy of God, who has called you to His kingdom and glory.

title: I Thessalonians 2:13
text: And for this cause we thank God without ceasing, that when you received [the] Word of hearing, of God, you welcomed [it as] the Word of God, not as a word of men, but [as] it is, truly [the] Word of God, which also effectually works in you who believe.

title: I Thessalonians 2:14
text: For you, brothers, became imitators of the churches of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus. For you also have suffered these things by [your] own countrymen, even as they also by the Jews;

title: I Thessalonians 2:15
text: who both killed the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, also driving us out and they do not please God and [being] contrary to all men,

title: I Thessalonians 2:16
text: forbidding us to speak to the nations that they might be saved, to fill up their sins always; but the wrath has come upon them to [the] uttermost.

title: I Thessalonians 2:17
text: But, my brothers, when we were taken away from you for an hour's time (in presence, not in heart), we were much more eager with much desire to see your face.

title: I Thessalonians 2:18
text: Therefore we desired to come to you, truly I, Paul, both once and twice; but Satan hindered us.

title: I Thessalonians 2:19
text: For what [is] our hope or joy, or crown of rejoicing? [Are] you not even [to be] in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at His coming?

title: I Thessalonians 2:20
text: For you are our glory and joy.

title: I Thessalonians 3:1
text: Therefore when we could no longer endure, we were pleased to be left at Athens alone.

title: I Thessalonians 3:2
text: And we sent Timothy, our brother and minister of God, and our fellow laborer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

title: I Thessalonians 3:3
text: so that no one should be drawn aside by these afflictions. For you yourselves know that we are appointed to them.

title: I Thessalonians 3:4
text: For truly, when we were with you, we told you before that we were going to suffer affliction, as it also happened, even you know.

title: I Thessalonians 3:5
text: For this cause, when I could no longer endure, I also sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter may have tempted you and our labor may have been in vain.

title: I Thessalonians 3:6
text: But now when Timothy came from you to us and brought us good news [of] your faith and love, and that you have good remembrance of us always, desiring to see us (as we also you),

title: I Thessalonians 3:7
text: then, my brothers, we were comforted over you, through your faith, even in all our affliction and needs;

title: I Thessalonians 3:8
text: for now we live, if you stand fast in [the] Lord.

title: I Thessalonians 3:9
text: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy [with] which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

title: I Thessalonians 3:10
text: night and day praying exceedingly for [me] to see your face and to perfect the things lacking in your faith?

title: I Thessalonians 3:11
text: And may God Himself and our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ direct our way to you.

title: I Thessalonians 3:12
text: And may the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all, even as we do toward you,

title: I Thessalonians 3:13
text: in order to establish your hearts blameless in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all His saints.

title: I Thessalonians 4:1
text: For the rest, then, my brothers, we beseech you and exhort [you] in [the] Lord Jesus, that, as you have received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, so you would abound more [and more].

title: I Thessalonians 4:2
text: For we know what commands we gave you by the Lord Jesus.

title: I Thessalonians 4:3
text: For this is the will of God, your sanctification, for you to abstain from fornication,

title: I Thessalonians 4:4
text: each one of you to know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honor

title: I Thessalonians 4:5
text: (not in the passion of lust, even as the nations who do not know God),

title: I Thessalonians 4:6
text: not to go beyond and defraud his brother in this matter (because the Lord [is the] avenger concerning all these, as we also have forewarned you and testified).

title: I Thessalonians 4:7
text: For God has not called us to uncleanness, but in sanctification.

title: I Thessalonians 4:8
text: Therefore he who despises does not despise man, but God, who also has given us His Holy Spirit.

title: I Thessalonians 4:9
text: But regarding brotherly love, you do not need that I write to you, for you yourselves are taught by God to love one another.

title: I Thessalonians 4:10
text: And indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we beseech you, brothers, that you abound more [and more],

title: I Thessalonians 4:11
text: and that you try earnestly to be quiet and to do [your] own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you,

title: I Thessalonians 4:12
text: so that you may walk becomingly toward those outside, and that you may lack nothing.

title: I Thessalonians 4:13
text: But I would not have you ignorant, brothers, concerning those who are asleep, that you be not grieved, even as others who have no hope.

title: I Thessalonians 4:14
text: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will also bring with Him all those who have fallen asleep through Jesus.

title: I Thessalonians 4:15
text: For we say this to you by the Word of [the] Lord, that we who are alive [and] remain until the coming of the Lord shall not go before those who are asleep.

title: I Thessalonians 4:16
text: For the Lord Himself shall descend from Heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet of God. And the dead in Christ shall rise first.

title: I Thessalonians 4:17
text: Then we who are alive [and] remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air. And so we shall ever be with the Lord.

title: I Thessalonians 4:18
text: Therefore comfort one another with these words.

title: I Thessalonians 5:1
text: But of the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that I write to you.

title: I Thessalonians 5:2
text: For you yourselves know accurately that the day of [the] Lord comes like a thief in the night.

title: I Thessalonians 5:3
text: For when they shall say, Peace and safety! Then sudden destruction comes on them, as travail upon a woman with child. And they shall not escape.

title: I Thessalonians 5:4
text: But you, brothers, are not in darkness, that the Day should overtake you like a thief.

title: I Thessalonians 5:5
text: You are all the sons of light and the sons of the day. We are not of the night, or of darkness.

title: I Thessalonians 5:6
text: Therefore let us not sleep as the rest [do], but let us watch and be calm.

title: I Thessalonians 5:7
text: For those sleeping sleep in the night, and those being drunken are drunken in the night.

title: I Thessalonians 5:8
text: But let us, who are of the day, be calm, having put on [the] breastplate of faith and love and [the] hope of salvation [for] a helmet.

title: I Thessalonians 5:9
text: For God has not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

title: I Thessalonians 5:10
text: who died for us, so that whether we watch or sleep we should live together with Him.

title: I Thessalonians 5:11
text: Therefore comfort one another, and edify one another, even as you also do.

title: I Thessalonians 5:12
text: And, brothers, we beseech you to know those who labor among you, and are over you in [the] Lord, and who admonish you,

title: I Thessalonians 5:13
text: and to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

title: I Thessalonians 5:14
text: Now we exhort you, brothers, warn those who are unruly, comfort the faint-hearted, support the weak, be patient toward all.

title: I Thessalonians 5:15
text: See [that] none gives evil for evil to anyone, but always pursue the good, both towards one another and towards all.

title: I Thessalonians 5:16
text: Rejoice evermore.

title: I Thessalonians 5:17
text: Pray without ceasing.

title: I Thessalonians 5:18
text: In everything give thanks, for this [is the] will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

title: I Thessalonians 5:19
text: Do not quench the Spirit.

title: I Thessalonians 5:20
text: Do not despise prophesying.

title: I Thessalonians 5:21
text: Prove all things, hold fast to the good.

title: I Thessalonians 5:22
text: Abstain from every appearance of evil.

title: I Thessalonians 5:23
text: And may the God of peace Himself sanctify you, and may your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless to the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: I Thessalonians 5:24
text: Faithful [is] He who called you, who also will do [it].

title: I Thessalonians 5:25
text: Brothers, pray for us.

title: I Thessalonians 5:26
text: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

title: I Thessalonians 5:27
text: I charge you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

title: I Thessalonians 5:28
text: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you. Amen.

title: II Thessalonians 1:1
text: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy to the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and [the] Lord Jesus Christ.

title: II Thessalonians 1:2
text: Grace to you, and peace from God our Father and [the] Lord Jesus Christ.

title: II Thessalonians 1:3
text: We are bound to thank God always for you, my brothers, as it is right, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each one of you abounds toward one another;

title: II Thessalonians 1:4
text: so much so that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God, for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations which you endure.

title: II Thessalonians 1:5
text: For [this is] a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that you may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God for which you also suffer,

title: II Thessalonians 1:6
text: since [it is] a righteous thing with God to repay tribulation to those who trouble you,

title: II Thessalonians 1:7
text: and to give rest with us to you who are troubled, at the revealing of the Lord Jesus from Heaven with the angels of His power,

title: II Thessalonians 1:8
text: in flaming fire taking vengeance on those who do not know God and who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ,

title: II Thessalonians 1:9
text: who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of His power,

title: II Thessalonians 1:10
text: when He shall come to be glorified in His saints and to be admired in all those who believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that Day.

title: II Thessalonians 1:11
text: Therefore we also pray always for you that our God would count you worthy of [this] calling and fulfill all the good pleasure of His goodness and the work of faith with power,

title: II Thessalonians 1:12
text: that the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and [the] Lord Jesus Christ.

title: II Thessalonians 2:1
text: Now we beseech you, my brothers, with regard to the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to Him,

title: II Thessalonians 2:2
text: that you should not be soon shaken [in] mind or troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word or letter, as through us, as [if] the Day of Christ is at hand.

title: II Thessalonians 2:3
text: Let not anyone deceive you by any means. For [that Day shall not come] unless there first comes a falling away, and the man of sin shall be revealed, the son of perdition,

title: II Thessalonians 2:4
text: who opposes and exalts himself above all that is called God, or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself forth, that he is God.

title: II Thessalonians 2:5
text: Do you not remember that I told you these things when I was still with you?

title: II Thessalonians 2:6
text: And now you know what holds him back, for him to might be revealed in his own time.

title: II Thessalonians 2:7
text: For the mystery of lawlessness is already working, only he [is] now holding back until it comes out of the midst.

title: II Thessalonians 2:8
text: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the breath of His mouth and shall destroy with the brightness of His coming,

title: II Thessalonians 2:9
text: whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

title: II Thessalonians 2:10
text: and with all deceit of unrighteousness in those who perish, because they did not receive the love of the truth, so that they might be saved.

title: II Thessalonians 2:11
text: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie,

title: II Thessalonians 2:12
text: so that all those who do not believe the truth, but delight in unrighteousness, might be condemned.

title: II Thessalonians 2:13
text: But we are bound to give thanks always to God for you, brothers beloved of the Lord, because God has from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of [the] Spirit and belief of [the] truth,

title: II Thessalonians 2:14
text: to which He called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: II Thessalonians 2:15
text: Therefore, my brothers, stand fast and hold the teachings which you have been taught, whether by word or by our letter.

title: II Thessalonians 2:16
text: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself, and God, even our Father, who has loved us and has given [us] everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

title: II Thessalonians 2:17
text: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good word and work.

title: II Thessalonians 3:1
text: Finally, my brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have [free] course and be glorified, even as [it is] with you.

title: II Thessalonians 3:2
text: And pray that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men; for all [do not have] faith.

title: II Thessalonians 3:3
text: But the Lord is faithful, who shall establish you and keep [you] from evil.

title: II Thessalonians 3:4
text: And we have confidence in [the] Lord regarding you, that you both do and will do the things which we command you.

title: II Thessalonians 3:5
text: And may the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patience of Christ.

title: II Thessalonians 3:6
text: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks disorderly, and not after the teaching which he received from us.

title: II Thessalonians 3:7
text: For you yourselves know how you ought to follow us. For we did not behave ourselves disorderly among you,

title: II Thessalonians 3:8
text: neither did we eat any man's bread [for nothing], but we worked with labor and travail night and day, so that we might not be heavy on any of you

title: II Thessalonians 3:9
text: (not because we do not have power, but to make ourselves an example to you, to imitate us).

title: II Thessalonians 3:10
text: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this, that if anyone would not work, neither should he eat.

title: II Thessalonians 3:11
text: For we hear that there are some who walk disorderly among you, not working at all, but being busybodies.

title: II Thessalonians 3:12
text: Now we command and exhort those who are such, by our Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.

title: II Thessalonians 3:13
text: But you, brothers, do not be weary in well doing.

title: II Thessalonians 3:14
text: And if anyone does not obey our word by this letter, mark that one and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.

title: II Thessalonians 3:15
text: Yet do not count [him] as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

title: II Thessalonians 3:16
text: And may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord [be] with you all.

title: II Thessalonians 3:17
text: The greeting of Paul by my own hand which is [the] sign in every letter, so I write.

title: II Thessalonians 3:18
text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you all. Amen.

title: I Timothy 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the command of God our Savior, and of [the] Lord Jesus Christ, our hope,

title: I Timothy 1:2
text: to Timothy, [my] own son in [the] faith. Grace, mercy and peace from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

title: I Timothy 1:3
text: Even as I begged you to remain at Ephesus, when I was going to Macedonia, that you might charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

title: I Timothy 1:4
text: nor to give heed to fables and endless genealogies (which provide doubts rather than a stewardship of God in faith).

title: I Timothy 1:5
text: But the end of the commandment is love out of a pure heart, and a good conscience, and faith unfeigned,

title: I Timothy 1:6
text: from which some, having swerved, have turned aside to foolish talking,

title: I Timothy 1:7
text: desiring to be teachers of the law, neither understanding what they say nor that which they affirm.

title: I Timothy 1:8
text: But we know that the law [is] good if a man uses it lawfully,

title: I Timothy 1:9
text: knowing this, that the law [is] not made for a righteous one, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

title: I Timothy 1:10
text: for fornicators, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and anything else that is contrary to sound doctrine,

title: I Timothy 1:11
text: according to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

title: I Timothy 1:12
text: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who strengthened me, because He counted me faithful, putting [me] into the ministry--

title: I Timothy 1:13
text: the [one] who before was a blasphemer and a persecutor and insolent. But I obtained mercy, because being ignorant, I did [it] in unbelief.

title: I Timothy 1:14
text: [And] the grace of our Lord was exceedingly abundant, with faith and love in Christ Jesus.

title: I Timothy 1:15
text: Faithful [is] the Word and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.

title: I Timothy 1:16
text: But for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might show forth all long-suffering, as a pattern to those being about to believe on Him to life everlasting.

title: I Timothy 1:17
text: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, [the] only wise God, [be] honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

title: I Timothy 1:18
text: This charge I commit to you, [my] son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before [about] you, in order that you might war a good warfare by them,

title: I Timothy 1:19
text: holding faith and a good conscience, which some have put away and made shipwreck as to faith.

title: I Timothy 1:20
text: Among these are Hymeneus and Alexander, whom I have delivered to Satan so that they may learn not to blaspheme.

title: I Timothy 2:1
text: First of all, then, I exhort [that] supplications, prayers, intercessions, [and] giving of thanks be made for all men,

title: I Timothy 2:2
text: for kings and all who are in authority, so that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and reverence.

title: I Timothy 2:3
text: For this [is] good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,

title: I Timothy 2:4
text: who will have all men to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.

title: I Timothy 2:5
text: For God [is] one, and [there is] one Mediator between God and man, [the] Man Christ Jesus,

title: I Timothy 2:6
text: who gave Himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

title: I Timothy 2:7
text: To this I am ordained a preacher and an apostle (I speak the truth in Christ, I do not lie), a teacher of [the] nations, in faith and truth.

title: I Timothy 2:8
text: Therefore, I desire that men pray everywhere, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.

title: I Timothy 2:9
text: In the same way also, I desire that women adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and sensibleness, not [adorned] with braiding, or gold, or pearls, or costly clothing,

title: I Timothy 2:10
text: but with good works, which becomes women professing godliness.

title: I Timothy 2:11
text: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

title: I Timothy 2:12
text: But I do not allow a woman to teach, or to exercise authority [over] a man, but to be in silence.

title: I Timothy 2:13
text: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

title: I Timothy 2:14
text: And Adam was not deceived, but [the] woman being deceived was in the transgression.

title: I Timothy 2:15
text: But she will be kept safe through childbearing, if they continue in faith and love and holiness with sensibleness.

title: I Timothy 3:1
text: Faithful [is] the word: If anyone reaches out to overseership, he desires a good work.

title: I Timothy 3:2
text: Then it behooves the overseer to be without reproach, husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, well-ordered, hospitable, apt at teaching,

title: I Timothy 3:3
text: not a drinker, not quarrelsome, not greedy of ill gain, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous,

title: I Timothy 3:4
text: ruling his own house well, having children in subjection with all honor.

title: I Timothy 3:5
text: (For if a man does not know to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)

title: I Timothy 3:6
text: not a novice, lest being puffed up he may fall into the condemnation of the Devil.

title: I Timothy 3:7
text: But he must also have a good report from those on the outside, lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the Devil.

title: I Timothy 3:8
text: Likewise the deacons [are to be] reverent, not double-tongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of ill gain,

title: I Timothy 3:9
text: having the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

title: I Timothy 3:10
text: And let these also first be tested, then let them [use the office of a deacon], being blameless.

title: I Timothy 3:11
text: Even so [their] wives are to [be] reverent, not slanderers, temperate, faithful in all things.

title: I Timothy 3:12
text: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling [their] children and households well.

title: I Timothy 3:13
text: For they having served well gain a good grade for themselves, and much boldness in the faith, those in Christ Jesus.

title: I Timothy 3:14
text: I write these things to you, hoping to come to you shortly.

title: I Timothy 3:15
text: But if I should delay, that you may know how you ought to behave in the house of God, which is [the] church of the living God, [the] pillar and foundation of the truth.

title: I Timothy 3:16
text: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen by angels, preached among nations, believed on in [the] world, and received up into glory.

title: I Timothy 4:1
text: But the Spirit expressly says that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits and teachings of demons,

title: I Timothy 4:2
text: speaking lies in hypocrisy, being seared in [their] own conscience,

title: I Timothy 4:3
text: forbidding to marry, [saying] to abstain from foods which God has created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

title: I Timothy 4:4
text: For every creation of God [is] good, and nothing to be refused if it is received with thanksgiving.

title: I Timothy 4:5
text: For it is sanctified through the Word of God and prayer.

title: I Timothy 4:6
text: Having suggested these things to the brothers, you shall be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and by the good doctrine which you have followed.

title: I Timothy 4:7
text: But refuse profane and old-womanish tales, and exercise yourself to godliness.

title: I Timothy 4:8
text: For bodily exercise profits a little, but godliness is profitable to all things, having promise of the present life, and of that which is to come.

title: I Timothy 4:9
text: Faithful [is] the Word, and worthy of all acceptance.

title: I Timothy 4:10
text: For to this we both labor and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the preserver of all men, especially of those who believe.

title: I Timothy 4:11
text: Command and teach these things.

title: I Timothy 4:12
text: Let no one despise your youth, but be an example of the believers, in word, in conduct, in love, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

title: I Timothy 4:13
text: Until I come, attend to reading, to exhortation, to teaching.

title: I Timothy 4:14
text: Do not neglect the gift in you, which was given you by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the body of elders.

title: I Timothy 4:15
text: Meditate on these things; be in these things in order that your improvement may appear to all.

title: I Timothy 4:16
text: Hold on to yourself and to the doctrine; continue in them, for doing this you shall both save yourself and those who hear you.

title: I Timothy 5:1
text: Do not sharply rebuke an elder, but exhort as a father, [and] the younger ones as brothers,

title: I Timothy 5:2
text: older women as mothers, the younger as sisters in all purity.

title: I Timothy 5:3
text: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

title: I Timothy 5:4
text: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them first learn to be godly to their own house, and give back to [their] forebears what is due them; for that is good and pleasing before God.

title: I Timothy 5:5
text: But she being really a widow, and having been left alone, trusts on God and continues in supplications and prayers night and day.

title: I Timothy 5:6
text: But she who lives in self-pleasure has died while living.

title: I Timothy 5:7
text: And command these things so that they may be blameless.

title: I Timothy 5:8
text: But if anyone does not provide for [his] own, and especially [his] family, he has denied the faith and is worse than an infidel.

title: I Timothy 5:9
text: Do not let a widow be enrolled under sixty years old, [the] wife of one man,

title: I Timothy 5:10
text: well reported of for good works: if she brought up children, if she lodged strangers, if she washed the feet of the saints, if she relieved the afflicted, if she followed after every good work.

title: I Timothy 5:11
text: But refuse younger widows, for whenever they grow lustful against Christ, they desire to marry;

title: I Timothy 5:12
text: having guilt because they have cast off the first faith.

title: I Timothy 5:13
text: And with it all they also learn [to be] idle, going around the houses; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things they ought not.

title: I Timothy 5:14
text: Therefore I want the younger ones to marry, bear children, guide the house, giving no occasion to the adversary because of reproach.

title: I Timothy 5:15
text: For some have already turned aside after Satan.

title: I Timothy 5:16
text: If any believing man or believing woman has widows, let them relieve them, and do not let the church be charged, so that it may relieve those who are widows indeed.

title: I Timothy 5:17
text: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in word and doctrine.

title: I Timothy 5:18
text: For the Scripture says, "You shall not muzzle the ox treading out grain," and, "The laborer [is] worthy of his reward."

title: I Timothy 5:19
text: Do not receive an accusation against an elder except before two or three witnesses.

title: I Timothy 5:20
text: Those who sin, rebuke before all, so that the rest also may fear.

title: I Timothy 5:21
text: I charge [you] before God and [the] Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that you guard these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

title: I Timothy 5:22
text: Do not lay hands quickly on anyone, neither be partaker of [the] sins of others. Keep yourself pure.

title: I Timothy 5:23
text: Drink water no longer, but use a little wine for your stomach's sake, and for your many infirmities.

title: I Timothy 5:24
text: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment. And some follow after.

title: I Timothy 5:25
text: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand, and those otherwise cannot be hidden.

title: I Timothy 6:1
text: Let as many slaves as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, so that the name and doctrine of God may not be blasphemed.

title: I Timothy 6:2
text: And those who have believing masters, let them not despise [them] because they are brothers. But rather let them serve, because they are faithful and beloved, those of the good service receiving in return. Teach and exhort these things.

title: I Timothy 6:3
text: If anyone teaches otherwise, and does not consent to wholesome words (those of our Lord Jesus Christ), and to the doctrine according to godliness,

title: I Timothy 6:4
text: he is proud, knowing nothing. [He is] sick concerning doubts and arguments, from which comes envy, strife, evil speakings, evil suspicions,

title: I Timothy 6:5
text: meddling, of men whose minds have been corrupted and deprived of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness. Withdraw from such.

title: I Timothy 6:6
text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

title: I Timothy 6:7
text: For we brought nothing into the world, [and it is] clear that we can carry nothing out.

title: I Timothy 6:8
text: But having food and clothing, we will be content.

title: I Timothy 6:9
text: But they who will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and [into] many foolish and hurtful lusts which plunge men into death and destruction.

title: I Timothy 6:10
text: For the love of money is a root of all evils, of which some having lusted after, they were seduced from the faith and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

title: I Timothy 6:11
text: But you, O man of God, flee these things and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, and meekness.

title: I Timothy 6:12
text: Fight the good fight of faith. Lay hold on eternal life, to which you are also called and have professed a good profession before many witnesses.

title: I Timothy 6:13
text: I charge you before God (who makes all things alive) and [in the sight of] Christ Jesus (who witnessed the good confession [before] Pontius Pilate),

title: I Timothy 6:14
text: that you keep the commandment without spot and without blame until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: I Timothy 6:15
text: For He in His own time will reveal [who is] the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings and Lord of lords,

title: I Timothy 6:16
text: who alone has immortality, dwelling in light which cannot be approached, whom no one of men have seen, nor can see; to whom be honor and power everlasting. Amen.

title: I Timothy 6:17
text: Charge the rich in this world that they be not high-minded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, He offering to us richly all things to enjoy,

title: I Timothy 6:18
text: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to share, to be generous,

title: I Timothy 6:19
text: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.

title: I Timothy 6:20
text: O Timothy, guard the Deposit, avoiding profane [and] vain babblings, and opposing the theories of falsely-named science,

title: I Timothy 6:21
text: which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace [be] with you. Amen.

title: II Timothy 1:1
text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which [is] in Christ Jesus,

title: II Timothy 1:2
text: to Timothy, [my] dearly beloved child. Grace, mercy, peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

title: II Timothy 1:3
text: I thank God, whom I serve from [my] forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I remember you in my prayers night and day,

title: II Timothy 1:4
text: greatly desiring to see you, being mindful of your tears, so that I may be filled with joy,

title: II Timothy 1:5
text: taking recollection of the unfeigned faith that is in you, which first dwelt [in] your grandmother Lois, and in your mother Eunice. And I am persuaded that it is in you also.

title: II Timothy 1:6
text: Therefore I remind you to inflame anew the gift of God, which is in you by the putting on of my hands.

title: II Timothy 1:7
text: For God has not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.

title: II Timothy 1:8
text: Therefore do not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor [of] me His prisoner. But be partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to [the] power of God,

title: II Timothy 1:9
text: who has saved us and called [us] with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to His own purpose and grace which was given us in Christ Jesus before the eternal times.

title: II Timothy 1:10
text: But it is now made manifest by the appearing of our Savior Jesus Christ, who has made death of no effect, bringing life and immortality to light through the gospel;

title: II Timothy 1:11
text: to which I am appointed a preacher and an apostle and a teacher of the nations.

title: II Timothy 1:12
text: For this cause I also suffer these things; but I am not ashamed, for I know whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that He is able to keep that which I have committed to Him against that Day.

title: II Timothy 1:13
text: Hold fast the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love [which is] in Christ Jesus.

title: II Timothy 1:14
text: Guard the good Deposit [given] through [the] Holy Spirit indwelling in us.

title: II Timothy 1:15
text: This you know, that all those in Asia have turned away from me, of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

title: II Timothy 1:16
text: May the Lord give mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me and was not ashamed [of] my chain.

title: II Timothy 1:17
text: But when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently and found [me].

title: II Timothy 1:18
text: May the Lord grant to him that he may find mercy from [the] Lord in that Day. And in what things he ministered [to me] at Ephesus, you know very well.

title: II Timothy 2:1
text: Therefore, my son, be strong in the grace [that is] in Christ Jesus.

title: II Timothy 2:2
text: And the things that you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

title: II Timothy 2:3
text: Therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

title: II Timothy 2:4
text: No one who wars tangles with the affairs of [this] life, that he may please him who chose [him] to be a soldier.

title: II Timothy 2:5
text: And also if anyone competes, he is not crowned unless he competes lawfully.

title: II Timothy 2:6
text: It is right for the laboring farmer to partake first of the fruits.

title: II Timothy 2:7
text: Consider what I say, and the Lord will give you understanding in all things.

title: II Timothy 2:8
text: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from [the] dead according to my gospel,

title: II Timothy 2:9
text: in which I suffer ill as an evildoer, [even] to bonds. But the Word of God is not chained.

title: II Timothy 2:10
text: Therefore I endure all things for the sake of the elect, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

title: II Timothy 2:11
text: Faithful [is] the word, for if we are dead with [Him], we shall also live with [Him].

title: II Timothy 2:12
text: If we suffer, we shall also reign with [Him]. If we deny [Him], He also will deny us.

title: II Timothy 2:13
text: If we do not believe [Him], [yet] He remains faithful; He cannot deny Himself.

title: II Timothy 2:14
text: Put [them] in memory of these things, charging them before the Lord not to dispute about words to no profit, to the subverting of the hearers.

title: II Timothy 2:15
text: [Study] earnestly to present yourself approved to God, a workman that does not need to be ashamed, rightly dividing the Word of Truth.

title: II Timothy 2:16
text: But shun profane, vain babblings, for they will increase to more ungodliness.

title: II Timothy 2:17
text: And their word will eat like a gangrene; among whom [are] Hymeneus and Philetus,

title: II Timothy 2:18
text: who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and who overthrow the faith of some.

title: II Timothy 2:19
text: Nevertheless the foundation of God stands sure, having this seal: "[The] Lord knew those who are His." And, "Let everyone who names the name of Christ depart from iniquity!"

title: II Timothy 2:20
text: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honor, and some to dishonor.

title: II Timothy 2:21
text: Therefore if anyone purges himself from these, he shall be a vessel to honor, sanctified and useful to the Master, prepared for every good work.

title: II Timothy 2:22
text: But flee youthful lusts, and follow righteousness, faith, love, peace, with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

title: II Timothy 2:23
text: But avoid foolish and unlearned questions, knowing that they give birth to strifes.

title: II Timothy 2:24
text: But the servant of [the] Lord must not strive, but to be gentle to all, apt to teach, patient,

title: II Timothy 2:25
text: in meekness instructing those who oppose, if perhaps God will give them repentance to the acknowledging of [the] truth,

title: II Timothy 2:26
text: and [that] they awake out of the snare of the Devil, having been taken captive by him, so as to do the will of that one.

title: II Timothy 3:1
text: Know this also, that in [the] last days grievous times will be [on us].

title: II Timothy 3:2
text: For men will be self-lovers, money-lovers, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

title: II Timothy 3:3
text: without natural affection, unyielding, false accusers, without self-control, savage, despisers of good,

title: II Timothy 3:4
text: traitors, reckless, puffed up, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

title: II Timothy 3:5
text: having a form of godliness, but denying the power of it; even turn away from these.

title: II Timothy 3:6
text: For of these are those who creep into houses and lead captive silly women loaded with sins, led away with different kinds of lusts,

title: II Timothy 3:7
text: ever learning and never able to come to the full knowledge of [the] truth.

title: II Timothy 3:8
text: But as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so these also resist the truth, men of corrupt mind, reprobate concerning the faith.

title: II Timothy 3:9
text: But they shall proceed no further. For their foolishness shall be plain to all, as theirs also became.

title: II Timothy 3:10
text: But you have fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, long-suffering, love, patience,

title: II Timothy 3:11
text: persecutions, afflictions, such as happened to me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra. What persecutions I endured! But the Lord delivered me out of all.

title: II Timothy 3:12
text: Yea, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

title: II Timothy 3:13
text: But evil men and seducers will go forward to worse, deceiving and being deceived.

title: II Timothy 3:14
text: But continue in the things that you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned [them],

title: II Timothy 3:15
text: and that from a babe you have known the Holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise to salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

title: II Timothy 3:16
text: All Scripture [is] God-breathed, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness,

title: II Timothy 3:17
text: that the man of God may be perfected, thoroughly furnished to every good work.

title: II Timothy 4:1
text: Therefore I solemnly witness before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who is going to judge [the] living and [the] dead according to His appearance and His kingdom,

title: II Timothy 4:2
text: preach the Word, be instant in season and out of season, reprove, rebuke, exhort with all long-suffering and doctrine.

title: II Timothy 4:3
text: For the time will be when they will not endure sound doctrine, but they will heap up teachers to themselves according to their own lusts, tickling the ear.

title: II Timothy 4:4
text: And they will turn away [their] ears from the truth and will be turned to myths.

title: II Timothy 4:5
text: But you watch in all things, endure afflictions, do [the] work of an evangelist, fully carry out your ministry."

title: II Timothy 4:6
text: For I am already being poured out, and the time of my release is here.

title: II Timothy 4:7
text: I have fought a good fight, I have finished the course, I have kept the faith.

title: II Timothy 4:8
text: Now there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, shall give me at that Day; and not to me only, but also to all those who love His appearing.

title: II Timothy 4:9
text: Make haste to come to me quickly.

title: II Timothy 4:10
text: For Demas has forsaken me, having loved this present world, and [he] has departed to Thessalonica. Crescens [went] to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.

title: II Timothy 4:11
text: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark [and] bring [him] with you, for he is profitable to me for [the] ministry.

title: II Timothy 4:12
text: And I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

title: II Timothy 4:13
text: When you come, bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus, and the books, especially the parchments.

title: II Timothy 4:14
