text: Alexander the coppersmith showed many evil things to me. The Lord will give to him according to his works.

title: II Timothy 4:15
text: You also should beware of [him], for he has greatly withstood our words.

title: II Timothy 4:16
text: At my first answer no one was beside me, but all deserted me. May it not be laid to their charge.

title: II Timothy 4:17
text: But the Lord stood with me and strengthened me, that through me the preaching might be fully known, and [that] all the nations might hear. And I was delivered out of [the] mouth of the lion.

title: II Timothy 4:18
text: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work and will preserve [me] for His heavenly kingdom, to whom [be] glory forever and ever. Amen.

title: II Timothy 4:19
text: Greet Priscilla and Aquila and the household of Onesiphorus.

title: II Timothy 4:20
text: Erastus stayed at Corinth, but Trophimus I left sick at Miletus.

title: II Timothy 4:21
text: Try to come before winter. Eubulus greets you, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brothers.

title: II Timothy 4:22
text: May the Lord Jesus Christ [be] with your spirit. Grace [be] with you. Amen.

title: Titus 1:1
text: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ (according to [the] faith of God's elect, in the acknowledging of [the] truth which is according to godliness

title: Titus 1:2
text: on hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before [the] eternal times,

title: Titus 1:3
text: but revealed in its own times in a proclamation of His word, with which I was entrusted by [the] command of God our Savior,)

title: Titus 1:4
text: to Titus, a true child according to [our] common faith. Grace mercy and peace from God [the] Father and [the] Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

title: Titus 1:5
text: For this cause I left you in Crete, that you should set in order the things that are lacking and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed you,

title: Titus 1:6
text: if anyone is blameless, husband of one wife, having believing children, not accused of loose behavior, or disobedient.

title: Titus 1:7
text: For an overseer must be blameless, as a steward of God, not self-willed, not full of passion, not given to wine, not quarrelsome, not greedy for ill gain;

title: Titus 1:8
text: but hospitable, a lover of good, discreet, just, holy, temperate

title: Titus 1:9
text: holding fast the faithful word according to the doctrine, that he may be able, by sound doctrine, both to exhort and to convict the gainsayers.

title: Titus 1:10
text: For there are indeed many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of [the] circumcision,

title: Titus 1:11
text: whose mouth [you] must stop, who subvert whole houses, teaching things not right for the sake of ill gain.

title: Titus 1:12
text: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, Cretans [are] always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.

title: Titus 1:13
text: This witness is true; for which cause convict them sharply, so that they may be sound in the faith,

title: Titus 1:14
text: not giving heed to Jewish myths and commandments of men, turning away from the truth.

title: Titus 1:15
text: To the pure all things [are] pure. But to those who are defiled and unbelieving nothing [is] pure, but even their mind and conscience is defiled.

title: Titus 1:16
text: They profess that they know God, but in [their] works they deny [Him], being abominable and disobedient and reprobate to every good work.

title: Titus 2:1
text: But you speak [the] things which become sound doctrine:

title: Titus 2:2
text: aged men to be temperate, sensible, discreet, sound in faith, in love, in patience.

title: Titus 2:3
text: Let the aged women likewise [be] in reverent behavior, not slanderers, not enslaved by much wine, teachers of good;

title: Titus 2:4
text: that they may train the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,

title: Titus 2:5
text: [to be] discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, subject to [their] own husbands, that the Word of God may not be blasphemed.

title: Titus 2:6
text: Likewise exhort the young men to be discreet;

title: Titus 2:7
text: In all things having shown yourself a pattern of good works: in doctrine, purity, sensibleness, without corruption,

title: Titus 2:8
text: [in] sound speech that cannot be condemned, that he who is opposed may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.

title: Titus 2:9
text: Slaves [are] to be obedient to [their] masters, to please them well in all [things], not talking back,

title: Titus 2:10
text: not stealing, but showing all good faith, so that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Savior in all things.

title: Titus 2:11
text: For the grace of God that brings salvation has appeared to all men,

title: Titus 2:12
text: teaching us that having denied ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live discreetly, righteously and godly, in this present world,

title: Titus 2:13
text: looking for the blessed hope, and the glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ,

title: Titus 2:14
text: who gave Himself for us that He might redeem us from all iniquity and purify to Himself a special people, zealous of good works.

title: Titus 2:15
text: Speak these things, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.

title: Titus 3:1
text: Put them in mind to be subject to rulers and authorities, to be obedient, to be ready to every good work,

title: Titus 3:2
text: to speak evil of no one, not being quarrelsome, [but] forbearing, showing all meekness to all men.

title: Titus 3:3
text: For we ourselves also were once foolish, disobedient, deceived, slaving for various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, hating one another.

title: Titus 3:4
text: But when the kindness and love of God our Savior toward man appeared,

title: Titus 3:5
text: not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to His mercy He saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewal of the Holy Spirit,

title: Titus 3:6
text: whom He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,

title: Titus 3:7
text: that being justified by His grace, we should become heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

title: Titus 3:8
text: Faithful [is] the Word, and as to these things, I desire that you strongly affirm that those believing God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men.

title: Titus 3:9
text: But avoid foolish questions and genealogies and contentions, and strivings about the Law, for they are unprofitable and vain.

title: Titus 3:10
text: After the first and second warning, reject a man of heresy,

title: Titus 3:11
text: knowing that he who is such has been perverted, and sins, being self-condemned.

title: Titus 3:12
text: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, hasten to come to me at Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

title: Titus 3:13
text: Diligently set forward Zenas the lawyer, and Apollos, that nothing may be lacking to them.

title: Titus 3:14
text: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, so that they may not be unfruitful.

title: Titus 3:15
text: All those with me greet you. Greet those who love us in [the] faith. May grace [be] with you all. Amen.

title: Philemon 1:1
text: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy [our] brother, to Philemon the beloved and fellow laborer,

title: Philemon 1:2
text: and to Apphia the beloved, and to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church in your house.

title: Philemon 1:3
text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Philemon 1:4
text: I thank my God, making mention of you always in my prayers,

title: Philemon 1:5
text: hearing of your love and faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all saints,

title: Philemon 1:6
text: that the fellowship of your faith may operate in a full knowledge of every good thing in you in Christ Jesus.

title: Philemon 1:7
text: For we have great joy and consolation over your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed by you, brother.

title: Philemon 1:8
text: Therefore, having much boldness in Christ to enjoin you to do the fitting thing;

title: Philemon 1:9
text: rather through love I entreat, being such a one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

title: Philemon 1:10
text: I entreat you for my child Onesimus, whom I have fathered in my bonds,

title: Philemon 1:11
text: he once worthless to you, but now useful to you and to me; whom I sent back to you.

title: Philemon 1:12
text: Even receive him, that is, my own heart,

title: Philemon 1:13
text: whom I resolved to retain with me, so that for you he might have ministered to me in the bonds of the gospel.

title: Philemon 1:14
text: But without your consent I was willing to do nothing, that your good should not be of necessity, but willingly.

title: Philemon 1:15
text: For perhaps because of this he was separated from you for an hour, that you should receive him eternally,

title: Philemon 1:16
text: not now as a slave, but beyond a slave, a beloved brother, especially to me, but how much more to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

title: Philemon 1:17
text: If then you have me as a partner, receive him as me.

title: Philemon 1:18
text: If he has wronged you or owes [you] in anything, put that on my account.

title: Philemon 1:19
text: I, Paul, wrote it with my own hand; I will repay, that I do not say to you that you owe even yourself to me also.

title: Philemon 1:20
text: Yes, brother, that I may have your help in the Lord, refresh my heart in the Lord.

title: Philemon 1:21
text: Trusting to your obedience, I wrote to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

title: Philemon 1:22
text: But at once prepare lodging for me, for I hope that through your prayers I shall be given to you.

title: Philemon 1:23
text: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

title: Philemon 1:24
text: and also Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, Luke, my fellow-laborers.

title: Philemon 1:25
text: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with your spirit.

title: Hebrews 1:1
text: God, who at many times and in many ways spoke in time past to the fathers by the prophets,

title: Hebrews 1:2
text: has in these last days spoken to us by His Son, whom He has appointed heir of all things, by whom also He made the worlds,

title: Hebrews 1:3
text: who being the shining splendor of [His] glory, and the express image of His essence, and upholding all things by the word of His power, having made purification of our sins, [He] sat down on [the] right of the Majesty on high,

title: Hebrews 1:4
text: being made so much better than the angels, as He has by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.

title: Hebrews 1:5
text: For to which of the angels did He say at any time, "You are My Son, this day I have begotten Thee?" And again, "I will be to Him a Father, and He shall be to Me a Son?"

title: Hebrews 1:6
text: And again, when He brings in the First-born into the world, He says, "And let all [the] angels of God worship Him."

title: Hebrews 1:7
text: And of the angels He says, "Who makes His angels spirits and His ministers a flame of fire."

title: Hebrews 1:8
text: But to the Son [He says], "Your throne, O God, [is] forever and ever. A scepter of righteousness [is] the scepter of Your kingdom.

title: Hebrews 1:9
text: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity, therefore God, Your God, has anointed You with the oil of gladness above Your fellows."

title: Hebrews 1:10
text: And, "You, Lord, have laid the foundation of the earth in the beginning, and the heavens are the works of Your hands.

title: Hebrews 1:11
text: They shall perish, but You will remain. And [they] shall all become old as a garment,

title: Hebrews 1:12
text: and as a covering You shall fold them up, and [they] shall be changed. But You are the same, and Your years shall not fail."

title: Hebrews 1:13
text: But to which of the angels, did He say at any time, "Sit on My right hand until I make Your enemies Your footstool?"

title: Hebrews 1:14
text: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for those who shall be heirs of salvation?

title: Hebrews 2:1
text: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let [them] slip.

title: Hebrews 2:2
text: For if the word spoken by angels was steadfast, and if every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense of reward,

title: Hebrews 2:3
text: how shall we escape [if] we neglect so great a salvation, which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by those who heard [Him];

title: Hebrews 2:4
text: God [also] bearing [them] witness, both with signs and wonders, and with different kinds of miracles and gifts [of the] Holy Spirit, according to His own will?

title: Hebrews 2:5
text: For He has not put in subjection to the angels the world to come, of which we speak.

title: Hebrews 2:6
text: But one testified in a certain place, saying, "What is man, that You are mindful of him; or the son of man, that You visit him?

title: Hebrews 2:7
text: You have made him a little lower than [the] angels. You crowned him with glory and honor and set him over the works of Your hands.

title: Hebrews 2:8
text: You have subjected all things under his feet." For in order that He put all things under him, He did not leave anything not subjected. But now we do not see all things having been put under him.

title: Hebrews 2:9
text: But we see Jesus, who [was] made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honor, that He by [the] grace of God should taste death for every [son].

title: Hebrews 2:10
text: For it became Him, for whom [are] all things and by whom [are] all things, in bringing many sons into glory, to perfect the Captain of their salvation through sufferings.

title: Hebrews 2:11
text: For both He who sanctifies and they who are sanctified [are] all of One, for which cause He is not ashamed to call them brothers,

title: Hebrews 2:12
text: saying, "I will declare Your name to My brothers; in the midst of the assembly I will sing praise to You."

title: Hebrews 2:13
text: And again, "I will put My trust in Him." And again, "Behold Me and the children whom God has given Me."

title: Hebrews 2:14
text: Since then the children have partaken of flesh and blood, He also Himself likewise partook of the same; that through death He might destroy him who had the power of death (that is, the Devil),

title: Hebrews 2:15
text: and deliver those who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

title: Hebrews 2:16
text: For truly He did not take [the nature of] angels, but He took hold of [the] seed of Abraham.

title: Hebrews 2:17
text: Therefore [in all things] it behoved him to be made like [His] brothers, that He might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make propitiation for the sins of [His] people.

title: Hebrews 2:18
text: For in that He Himself has suffered, having been tempted, He is able to rescue those who have been tempted.

title: Hebrews 3:1
text: Therefore, holy brothers, called [to be] partakers of the heavenly [calling], consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus,

title: Hebrews 3:2
text: who was faithful to Him who appointed Him, as Moses also [was faithful] in all his house.

title: Hebrews 3:3
text: For He was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who has built the house has more honor than the house.

title: Hebrews 3:4
text: For every house is built by someone, but He who built all things [is] God.

title: Hebrews 3:5
text: And Moses truly [was] faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken afterward.

title: Hebrews 3:6
text: But Christ [was faithful] as a Son over his own house; whose house we are, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm to the end.

title: Hebrews 3:7
text: Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says, "Today if you will hear His voice,

title: Hebrews 3:8
text: do not harden your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness,

title: Hebrews 3:9
text: when your fathers tempted Me, proved Me, and saw My works forty years.

title: Hebrews 3:10
text: Therefore I was grieved with that generation and said, They always err in [their] heart, and they have not known My ways.

title: Hebrews 3:11
text: So I swore in My wrath, They shall not enter into My rest."

title: Hebrews 3:12
text: Take heed, brothers, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from [the] living God.

title: Hebrews 3:13
text: But exhort one another daily, while it is called today, lest any of you be hardened through [the] deceitfulness of sin.

title: Hebrews 3:14
text: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence steadfast to [the] end,

title: Hebrews 3:15
text: while it is said, "Today if you will hear His voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation."

title: Hebrews 3:16
text: For some, when they had heard, did provoke; however, not all who came out of Egypt by Moses.

title: Hebrews 3:17
text: But with whom was He grieved forty years? [Was it] not with those who had sinned, whose carcasses fell in the wilderness?

title: Hebrews 3:18
text: And to whom did He swear [that they should] not enter into His rest, but to those who did not believe?

title: Hebrews 3:19
text: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.

title: Hebrews 4:1
text: Therefore, a promise being left to enter into His rest, let us fear lest any of you should seem to come short of it.

title: Hebrews 4:2
text: For also the gospel was preached [to us], as well as to them. But the word [preached] did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in those who heard [it].

title: Hebrews 4:3
text: For we who have believed do enter into the rest, as He said, "I have sworn in My wrath that they should not enter into My rest;" although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

title: Hebrews 4:4
text: For He spoke in a certain place of the seventh [day] in this way: "And God rested the seventh day from all His works."

title: Hebrews 4:5
text: And in this place again, "They shall not enter into My rest."

title: Hebrews 4:6
text: Since then it remains that some must enter into it, and since they to whom it was first preached did not enter in because of unbelief,

title: Hebrews 4:7
text: He again marks out a certain day, saying in David, "Today," (after so long a time). Even as it is said, "Today, if you will hear His voice, harden not your hearts."

title: Hebrews 4:8
text: For if Joshua had given them rest, then He would not afterward have spoken of another day.

title: Hebrews 4:9
text: So then there remains a rest to the people of God.

title: Hebrews 4:10
text: For he who has entered into his rest, he also has ceased from his own works, as God [did] from His.

title: Hebrews 4:11
text: Therefore let us labor to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of unbelief.

title: Hebrews 4:12
text: For the word of God [is] living and powerful and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to [the] dividing apart of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

title: Hebrews 4:13
text: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in His sight, but all things [are] naked and opened to the eyes of Him with whom we have to do.

title: Hebrews 4:14
text: Since then we have a great High Priest who has passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast [our] profession.

title: Hebrews 4:15
text: For we do not have a high priest who cannot be touched with the feelings of our infirmities, but was in all points tempted just as [we are, yet] without sin.

title: Hebrews 4:16
text: Therefore let us come boldly to the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need.

title: Hebrews 5:1
text: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in the things [pertaining] to God, so that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins,

title: Hebrews 5:2
text: who can have compassion on the ignorant and on those who are out of the way. For he himself also is compassed with infirmity.

title: Hebrews 5:3
text: And because of this he should, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.

title: Hebrews 5:4
text: And no man takes this honor to himself, but he who is called of God, as Aaron [was].

title: Hebrews 5:5
text: So also Christ did not glorify Himself to be made a high priest, but He who said to Him, "You are My Son, today I have begotten You."

title: Hebrews 5:6
text: As He says also in another [place], "You [are] a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek."

title: Hebrews 5:7
text: [For Jesus], in the days of His flesh, when He had offered up prayers and supplications with strong cryings and tears to Him who was able to save Him from death, and was heard in that He feared,

title: Hebrews 5:8
text: though being a Son, yet He learned obedience by the things which He suffered.

title: Hebrews 5:9
text: And being made perfect, He became [the] Author of eternal salvation to all those who obey Him,

title: Hebrews 5:10
text: being called by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek;

title: Hebrews 5:11
text: of whom we [have] many things to say, and hard to be explained since you are dull of hearing.

title: Hebrews 5:12
text: For indeed because of the time, you ought to be teachers, you have need that one teach you again what [are] the first principles of the oracles of God. And you have become [in] need of milk, and not of solid food.

title: Hebrews 5:13
text: For everyone who uses milk [is] unskillful [in the] word of righteousness, for he is an infant.

title: Hebrews 5:14
text: But solid food belongs to those who are of full age, [even] those who because of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.

title: Hebrews 6:1
text: Therefore, having left the discourse of the beginning of Christ, let us go on to full growth, not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,

title: Hebrews 6:2
text: of [the] baptisms, of doctrine, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

title: Hebrews 6:3
text: And this we will do, if God permits.

title: Hebrews 6:4
text: For [it is] impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of [the] Holy Spirit,

title: Hebrews 6:5
text: and have tasted [the] good Word of God and [the] powers of the world to come,

title: Hebrews 6:6
text: and who have fallen away; it is impossible, I say, to renew them again to repentance, since they crucify the Son of God afresh to themselves and put [Him] to an open shame.

title: Hebrews 6:7
text: (For the earth which drinks in the rain that comes often upon it, and brings forth plants fit for those by whom it is dressed, receives blessing from God.

title: Hebrews 6:8
text: But [that which] bears thorns and briers [is] rejected and [is] near cursing, whose end [is] to be burned.)

title: Hebrews 6:9
text: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you and things that accompany salvation, though we speak in this way.

title: Hebrews 6:10
text: For God [is] not unrighteous to forget your work and labor of love which you have shown toward His name, in that you have ministered to the saints, and do minister.

title: Hebrews 6:11
text: And we desire that each one of you show the same eagerness to the full assurance of hope to [the] end,

title: Hebrews 6:12
text: that you be not slothful, but imitators of those who through faith and patience inherit the promises.

title: Hebrews 6:13
text: For when God made promise to Abraham, because He could swear by no greater, [He] swore by Himself,

title: Hebrews 6:14
text: saying, "Surely in blessing I will bless you, and in multiplying I will multiply you."

title: Hebrews 6:15
text: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

title: Hebrews 6:16
text: For men truly swear by the greater, and an oath for confirmation [is] to them an end of all strife.

title: Hebrews 6:17
text: In this way desiring to declare more fully to the heirs of promise the immutability of His counsel, God interposed by an oath,

title: Hebrews 6:18
text: so that by two immutable things, in which [it was] impossible [for] God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before [us],

title: Hebrews 6:19
text: which [hope] we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and steadfast, and which enters into that within the veil,

title: Hebrews 6:20
text: where the Forerunner has entered for us, even Jesus, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

title: Hebrews 7:1
text: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of the Most High God, met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him.

title: Hebrews 7:2
text: To him Abraham also gave a tenth of all. [He was] first by interpretation king of righteousness, and after that also king of Salem, which is king of peace,

title: Hebrews 7:3
text: without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God, [he] remains a priest continually.

title: Hebrews 7:4
text: Now consider how great this man [was], to whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.

title: Hebrews 7:5
text: And truly they [who are] of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priest, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the Law, that is, from their brothers, though they come out of the loins of Abraham.

title: Hebrews 7:6
text: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.

title: Hebrews 7:7
text: And without all contradiction the lesser is blessed by the better.

title: Hebrews 7:8
text: And here men who die receive tithes; but there he [receives them], of whom it is witnessed that he lives.

title: Hebrews 7:9
text: And if I may say so, Levi, also, who receives tithes, paid tithes in Abraham.

title: Hebrews 7:10
text: For he was still in the loins of his father when Melchizedek met him.

title: Hebrews 7:11
text: Therefore if perfection were by the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people received the Law), what further need [was there] that another priest should rise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

title: Hebrews 7:12
text: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made in the law also.

title: Hebrews 7:13
text: For He of whom these things are spoken belongs to another tribe, from which no man gave attendance at the altar.

title: Hebrews 7:14
text: For [it is] evident that our Lord sprang out of Judah, of which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

title: Hebrews 7:15
text: And it is still far more evident, since there arises a different priest after the likeness of Melchizedek,

title: Hebrews 7:16
text: who is made, not according to the law of a fleshly commandment, but according to the power of an endless life.

title: Hebrews 7:17
text: For He testifies, "You [are] a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek."

title: Hebrews 7:18
text: For [truly there] is a putting away of the commandment which went before, because of the weakness and unprofitableness of it.

title: Hebrews 7:19
text: For the Law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope [did], by which we draw near to God.

title: Hebrews 7:20
text: And inasmuch as [He was not made priest] without an oath

title: Hebrews 7:21
text: (for those priests were made without an oath, but this one was made with an oath by Him who said to Him, "The Lord swore and will not repent, You [are] a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek,")

title: Hebrews 7:22
text: by so much was Jesus made a surety of a better covenant.

title: Hebrews 7:23
text: And they truly were many priests, because they were not allowed to continue because of death;

title: Hebrews 7:24
text: but He, because He continues forever, has an unchangeable priesthood.

title: Hebrews 7:25
text: Therefore He is able also to save to the uttermost those who come unto God by Him, [since He] ever lives to make intercession for them.

title: Hebrews 7:26
text: For such a high priest became us, [who is] holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners and made higher than the heavens,

title: Hebrews 7:27
text: who does not need, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice daily, first for his own [sins] and then for the people's sins. For He did this once for all, when He offered up Himself.

title: Hebrews 7:28
text: For the Law appoints men high priests who have infirmity, but the word of the swearing of an oath, after the Law, [has consecrated] the Son forever, having been perfected.

title: Hebrews 8:1
text: Now the sum of the things which we have spoken [is this]: We have such a High Priest, who has sat down on [the] right of the throne of the Majesty in Heaven,

title: Hebrews 8:2
text: a Minister of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.

title: Hebrews 8:3
text: For every high priest is appointed to offer gifts and sacrifices. Therefore [it is] necessary that this One have something to offer also.

title: Hebrews 8:4
text: For if indeed He were on earth, He would not be a priest, since there are priests who offer gifts according to the Law,

title: Hebrews 8:5
text: who serve the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was warned of God when he was about to make the tabernacle. For, He says "See [that] you make all things according to the pattern shown to you in the mountain."

title: Hebrews 8:6
text: But now He has obtained a more excellent ministry, by so much He is also the Mediator of a better covenant, which was built upon better promises.

title: Hebrews 8:7
text: For if that first [covenant] had been without fault, [then] no place would have been sought for the second.

title: Hebrews 8:8
text: For finding fault with them, He said to them, "Behold, days are coming, says [the] Lord, and I will make an end on the house of Israel and on the house of Judah; a new covenant shall be,

title: Hebrews 8:9
text: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day I took hold of their hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt," because they did not continue in My covenant, and I did not regard them, says the Lord.

title: Hebrews 8:10
text: "For this [is] the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the Lord: I will put My laws into their mind and write them in their hearts, and I will be their God, and they shall be My people.

title: Hebrews 8:11
text: And they shall not each man teach his neighbor, and each man his brother, saying, Know the Lord, for all shall know Me, from the least to the greatest.

title: Hebrews 8:12
text: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities I will remember no more."

title: Hebrews 8:13
text: In that He says, A new [covenant], He has made the first one old. Now that which decays and becomes old [is] ready to vanish away.

title: Hebrews 9:1
text: Then truly the first [tabernacle] had also ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.

title: Hebrews 9:2
text: For the first tabernacle was prepared, in which [was] both the lampstand, and the table, and the setting out of the loaves, which is called holy.

title: Hebrews 9:3
text: And after the second veil [was] a tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

title: Hebrews 9:4
text: having a golden altar of incense, and the ark of the covenant overlaid all around with gold, in which [was] the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant.

title: Hebrews 9:5
text: And over it were the cherubs of glory overshadowing the mercy-seat (about which we cannot now speak piece by piece.

title: Hebrews 9:6
text: Now when these things were ordained in this way, the priests always went into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service [of God].

title: Hebrews 9:7
text: But once [in] the year into the second the high priest [goes] alone, not without blood, which he offered for himself and for the errors of the people)

title: Hebrews 9:8
text: the Holy Spirit signifying [by] this [that] the way into the Holiest of all was not yet made manifest while the first tabernacle was still standing.

title: Hebrews 9:9
text: For it [was] a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices that could not make him who did the service perfect as regards the conscience,

title: Hebrews 9:10
text: [which stood] only in meats and drinks, and different kinds of washings and fleshly ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.

title: Hebrews 9:11
text: But when Christ had become a high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building

title: Hebrews 9:12
text: nor by the blood of goats and calves, but by [His] own blood [He] entered once for all into the [Holy of] Holies, having obtained eternal redemption [for us].

title: Hebrews 9:13
text: For if the blood of bulls and of goats and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling the unclean sanctifies to the purifying of the flesh,

title: Hebrews 9:14
text: how much more shall the blood of Christ (who through [the] eternal Spirit offered Himself unblemished spot to God) purge your conscience from dead works to serve [the] living God?

title: Hebrews 9:15
text: And for this cause He is the Mediator of the new covenant, so that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions [that were] under the first covenant, those who are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.

title: Hebrews 9:16
text: For where a covenant [is], the death of him covenanting must be offered.

title: Hebrews 9:17
text: For a covenant [is] affirmed over [those] dead, since it never has force when the covenanting one is living.

title: Hebrews 9:18
text: From which we see that neither was the first [covenant] dedicated without blood.

title: Hebrews 9:19
text: For [when] Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the Law, [he] took the blood of calves and of goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,

title: Hebrews 9:20
text: saying, "This [is] the blood of the covenant which God has enjoined to you."

title: Hebrews 9:21
text: And likewise he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry.

title: Hebrews 9:22
text: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood, and without shedding of blood is no remission.

title: Hebrews 9:23
text: Therefore [it was] necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified [with] these, but the heavenly things themselves were purified with better sacrifices than these.

title: Hebrews 9:24
text: For Christ has not entered into the [Holy of] Holies made with hands, [which are] the figures of the true, but into Heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us.

title: Hebrews 9:25
text: Nor yet that He should offer Himself often, even as the high priest enters into the [Holy of] Holies every year with the blood of others

title: Hebrews 9:26
text: (for then He must have suffered often since [the] foundation of the world), but now once in the end of the world He has appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of Himself.

title: Hebrews 9:27
text: And as it is appointed to men once to die, but after this the judgment,

title: Hebrews 9:28
text: so Christ was once offered to bear [the] sins of many. And to those who look for Him He shall appear the second [time] without sin to salvation.

title: Hebrews 10:1
text: For the Law which has a shadow of good things to come, not the very image of the things, [appearing] year by year with the same sacrifices, which they offer continually, they are never able to perfect those drawing near.

title: Hebrews 10:2
text: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? Because the worshipers, when they had been once for all purged, would have had no more conscience of sin.

title: Hebrews 10:3
text: But in those [sacrifices there is] a remembrance again of sins every year.

title: Hebrews 10:4
text: For [it is] not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.

title: Hebrews 10:5
text: Therefore when He comes into the world, He says, "Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but You have prepared a body for Me.

title: Hebrews 10:6
text: In burnt offerings and [sacrifices] for sin You have had no pleasure.

title: Hebrews 10:7
text: Then I said, Lo, I come ([in the] volume of the Book it is written of Me) to do Your will, O God."

title: Hebrews 10:8
text: Above, when He said, "Sacrifice and offering, and burnt offerings and [offering] for sin You did not desire, neither did You have pleasure in them" (which are offered by the Law),

title: Hebrews 10:9
text: then He said, "Lo, I come to do Your will, O God." He takes away the first so that He may establish the second.

title: Hebrews 10:10
text: By this will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

title: Hebrews 10:11
text: And indeed every priest stands daily ministering and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.

title: Hebrews 10:12
text: But this Man, after He had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down [on the] right of God,

title: Hebrews 10:13
text: from then on expecting until His enemies are made His footstool.

title: Hebrews 10:14
text: For by one offering He has perfected forever those who are sanctified.

title: Hebrews 10:15
text: The Holy Spirit also is a witness to us; for after He had said before,

title: Hebrews 10:16
text: "This [is] the covenant that I will make with them after those days, says the Lord; I will put My laws into their hearts, and in their minds I will write them,"

title: Hebrews 10:17
text: also [He ads], "their sins and their iniquities I will remember no more."

title: Hebrews 10:18
text: Now where remission of these [is, there is] no more offering for sin.

title: Hebrews 10:19
text: Therefore, my brothers, having boldness to enter into the [Holy of] Holies by the blood of Jesus,

title: Hebrews 10:20
text: by a new and living way which He has consecrated for us through the veil, that is to say, His flesh;

title: Hebrews 10:21
text: and [having] a High Priest over the house of God,

title: Hebrews 10:22
text: let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and [our] bodies having been washed with pure water.

title: Hebrews 10:23
text: Let us hold fast the profession of [our] faith without wavering (for He is faithful who promised),

title: Hebrews 10:24
text: and let us consider one another to provoke to love and to good works,

title: Hebrews 10:25
text: not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some [is], but exhorting [one another], and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.

title: Hebrews 10:26
text: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more sacrifice for sins,

title: Hebrews 10:27
text: but a certain fearful looking for judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.

title: Hebrews 10:28
text: He who despised Moses' law died without mercy on [the word of] two or three witnesses.

title: Hebrews 10:29
text: Of how much worse punishment, do you suppose, will be thought worthy [to receive] punishment, the [one] who has trampled the Son of God, and who has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

title: Hebrews 10:30
text: For we know Him who has said, "Vengeance [belongs] to Me, I will repay, says [the] Lord." And again, "The Lord shall judge His people."

title: Hebrews 10:31
text: [It is] a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

title: Hebrews 10:32
text: But call to memory the former days, in which (after you were illuminated) you endured a great fight of afflictions,

title: Hebrews 10:33
text: indeed being exposed both by reproaches and afflictions, and while you became companions of those who were so used.

title: Hebrews 10:34
text: For you both sympathized with my bonds and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that you have in Heaven a better and an enduring substance.

title: Hebrews 10:35
text: Therefore do not cast away your confidence, which has great [recompense of] reward.

title: Hebrews 10:36
text: For you have need of patience, so that after you have done the will of God you might receive the promise.

title: Hebrews 10:37
text: For "yet a little while, and He who shall come will come and will not delay."

title: Hebrews 10:38
text: Now, "the Just shall live by faith. But if he draws back, My soul shall have no pleasure in him."

title: Hebrews 10:39
text: But we are not of withdrawal to destruction, but of those who believe to [the] saving of [the] soul.

title: Hebrews 11:1
text: Now faith is [the] substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

title: Hebrews 11:2
text: For by it the elders obtained a good report.

title: Hebrews 11:3
text: Through faith we understand that the ages were framed by a word of God, so that the things seen [should] not have come into being out of the things that appear.

title: Hebrews 11:4
text: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness [that he] was righteous, God testifying of his gifts. And by it he, being dead, yet speaks.

title: Hebrews 11:5
text: By faith Enoch was translated [so as] not to see death, and he was not found, because God had translated him; for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.

title: Hebrews 11:6
text: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [Him], for he who comes to God must believe that He is and [that] He is a rewarder of those who diligently seek Him.

title: Hebrews 11:7
text: By faith Noah, having been warned by God of things not yet seen, moved with fear, prepared an ark to [the] saving of his house, by which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness [which is by] faith.

title: Hebrews 11:8
text: By faith Abraham obeyed when he was called to go out into a place which he was afterward going to receive for an inheritance. And [he] went out, not knowing where he went.

title: Hebrews 11:9
text: By faith he lived in the land of promise as [in] a strange [country], dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs of the same promise with him.

title: Hebrews 11:10
text: For he looked for a city which has foundations, whose builder and maker [is] God.

title: Hebrews 11:11
text: Through faith also Sarah herself received strength to conceive seed and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged Him who had promised [to be] faithful.

title: Hebrews 11:12
text: Because of this came into being [from] one, and that [from] one as good as dead, [seed] even as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the seashore.

title: Hebrews 11:13
text: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off. And they were persuaded of [them] and embraced [them] and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

title: Hebrews 11:14
text: For they who say such things declare plainly that they seek a fatherland.

title: Hebrews 11:15
text: And truly, if they had been mindful of that [country] from which they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.

title: Hebrews 11:16
text: But now they stretch forth to a better [fatherland], that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for He has prepared a city for them.

title: Hebrews 11:17
text: By faith Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. And he who had received the promises offered up his only-begotten [son],

title: Hebrews 11:18
text: of whom it was said that in Isaac your Seed shall be called,

title: Hebrews 11:19
text: concluding that God [was] able to raise him up, even from [the] dead, from where he even received him, in a figure.

title: Hebrews 11:20
text: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.

title: Hebrews 11:21
text: By faith Jacob, [when he was] dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph and worshiped, [leaning] upon the top of his staff.

title: Hebrews 11:22
text: By faith, Joseph dying remembered concerning the Exodus of the sons of Israel and gave orders concerning his bones.

title: Hebrews 11:23
text: By faith Moses, having been born, was hidden three months by his parents, because they saw [he was] a beautiful child. And they were not afraid of the king's commandments.

title: Hebrews 11:24
text: Having become great, Moses by faith refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter,

title: Hebrews 11:25
text: choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,

title: Hebrews 11:26
text: esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt, for he was looking to the reward.

title: Hebrews 11:27
text: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king, for he endured as seeing Him who is invisible.

title: Hebrews 11:28
text: Through faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, lest He who destroyed the first-born should touch them.

title: Hebrews 11:29
text: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as by dry [land], which the Egyptians attempting to do were drowned.

title: Hebrews 11:30
text: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been compassed seven days.

title: Hebrews 11:31
text: By faith the harlot Rahab did not perish with those who did not believe, when she had received the spies with peace.

title: Hebrews 11:32
text: And what more shall I say? For the time would fail me to tell of Gideon and Barak and Samson and Jephthah; also David, and Samuel and the prophets,

title: Hebrews 11:33
text: who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped [the] mouths of lions,

title: Hebrews 11:34
text: quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, became valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the strangers.

title: Hebrews 11:35
text: Women received their dead raised to life again, and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

title: Hebrews 11:36
text: And others had trial of [cruel] mockings and scourgings; yes, more, of bonds and imprisonments.

title: Hebrews 11:37
text: They were stoned, they were sawed in two, were tempted, were slain with the sword. They wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins, being destitute, afflicted, tormented.

title: Hebrews 11:38
text: The world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts and mountains and dens and caves of the earth.

title: Hebrews 11:39
text: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, did not receive the promise,

title: Hebrews 11:40
text: for God had provided some better thing for us, that they should not be made perfect without us.

title: Hebrews 12:1
text: Therefore since we also are surrounded with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily besets [us], and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

title: Hebrews 12:2
text: looking to Jesus the Author and Finisher of [our] faith, who for the joy that was set before Him endured [the] cross, despising the shame, and sat down at the right of the throne of God.

title: Hebrews 12:3
text: For consider Him who endured such contradiction of sinners against Himself, lest you be weary and faint in your minds.

title: Hebrews 12:4
text: You have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.

title: Hebrews 12:5
text: And you have forgotten the exhortation which speaks to you as to children, "My son, despise not the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are rebuked by Him;

title: Hebrews 12:6
text: for whom the Lord loves He chastens, and He scourges every son whom He receives."

title: Hebrews 12:7
text: If you endure chastening, God deals with you as with sons, for what son is he whom the father does not chasten?

title: Hebrews 12:8
text: But if you are without chastisement, of which all are partakers, then you are bastards and not sons.

title: Hebrews 12:9
text: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh who corrected [us], and we gave [them] reverence. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?

title: Hebrews 12:10
text: For truly they chastened [us] for a few days according to their own pleasure, but He for our profit, that [we] might be partakers of His holiness.

title: Hebrews 12:11
text: Now chastening for the present does not seem to be joyous, but grievous. Nevertheless afterward it yields the peaceable fruit of righteousness to those who are exercised by it.

title: Hebrews 12:12
text: Because of this, straighten up the hands which hang down and the enfeebled knees.

title: Hebrews 12:13
text: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way, but let it rather be healed.

title: Hebrews 12:14
text: Follow peace with all, and holiness, without which no one shall see the Lord;

title: Hebrews 12:15
text: looking diligently lest any fail of the grace of God, or lest any root of bitterness springing up disturb [you], and by it many are defiled,

title: Hebrews 12:16
text: (lest there [be] any fornicator, or profane person like Esau, who for one morsel of food sold his birthright.

title: Hebrews 12:17
text: For you know that afterward, when he desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected; for he did not find any place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears).

title: Hebrews 12:18
text: For you have not come to the mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, nor to blackness and darkness and tempest,

title: Hebrews 12:19
text: and the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words (which [voice] they who heard begged that the word should not be spoken to them any more,

title: Hebrews 12:20
text: for they could not endure the thing commanded, "And if so much as a beast should touch the mountain, it shall be stoned or thrust through with a dart,"

title: Hebrews 12:21
text: and so fearful was the sight [that] Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake).

title: Hebrews 12:22
text: But you have come to Mount Zion and to [the] city of [the] living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,

title: Hebrews 12:23
text: to the [general] assembly and church of the first-born who are written in Heaven, and to God [the] judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

title: Hebrews 12:24
text: and to Jesus the Mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better things than [that of] Abel.

title: Hebrews 12:25
text: See [that] you do not refuse Him who speaks. For if they did not escape, those who refused him that spoke on earth, much more we [shall not escape] if we turn away from Him who speaks from Heaven,

title: Hebrews 12:26
text: whose voice then shook the earth; but now He has promised, saying, "Yet once more I will not only shake the earth, but also the heavens."

title: Hebrews 12:27
text: And this [word], "Yet once more," signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, so that the things which cannot be shaken may remain.

title: Hebrews 12:28
text: Therefore, since we are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us have grace, by which we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear,

title: Hebrews 12:29
text: for also, "Our God [is] a consuming fire."

title: Hebrews 13:1
text: Let brotherly love continue.

title: Hebrews 13:2
text: Do not be forgetful to entertain strangers, for by this some have entertained angels without knowing it.

title: Hebrews 13:3
text: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with [them], those who suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.

title: Hebrews 13:4
text: Marriage [is] honorable in all, and the bed undefiled, but fornicators and adulterers God will judge.

title: Hebrews 13:5
text: [Let your] way of life [be] without the love of money, [and be] content with such things as you have, for He has said, "Not at all will I leave you, not at all will I forsake you, never!"

title: Hebrews 13:6
text: so that we may boldly say, "[The] Lord [is] my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do to me."

title: Hebrews 13:7
text: Remember your leaders, who have spoken to you the Word of God. Follow [their] faith, considering the end of [their] conduct:

title: Hebrews 13:8
text: Jesus Christ the same yesterday and today and forever.

title: Hebrews 13:9
text: Do not be carried about with different and strange doctrines, for [it is] good for the heart to be established with grace, not with foods, in which those who have walked [in them] were not helped.

title: Hebrews 13:10
text: We have an altar of which they have no right to eat, those who serve the tabernacle.

title: Hebrews 13:11
text: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the [Holy of] Holies by the high priest for sin, are burned outside the camp.

title: Hebrews 13:12
text: Therefore Jesus also, so that He might sanctify the people with His own blood, suffered outside the gate.

title: Hebrews 13:13
text: Therefore let us go forth to Him outside the camp, bearing His reproach.

title: Hebrews 13:14
text: For here we have no continuing city, but we seek one to come.

title: Hebrews 13:15
text: By Him, then, let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, [the] fruit of [our] lips, giving thanks to His name.

title: Hebrews 13:16
text: But do not forget to do good and to share, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

title: Hebrews 13:17
text: Yield to your leaders, and be submissive, for they watch for your souls, [as those who must] give account, that they may do it with joy and not with grief; for that [is] unprofitable for you.

title: Hebrews 13:18
text: Pray for us; for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.

title: Hebrews 13:19
text: But I beseech [you] the rather to do this, so that I may be more quickly restored to you.

title: Hebrews 13:20
text: Now may the God of peace (who brought again our Lord Jesus from [the] dead, that great Shepherd of the sheep, through [the] blood of the everlasting covenant)

title: Hebrews 13:21
text: make you perfect in every good work to do His will, working in you that [which] is well pleasing in His sight through Jesus Christ, to whom [be] glory forever and ever. Amen.

title: Hebrews 13:22
text: And I beseech you, brothers, allow the word of exhortation. For I have written a letter to you in few words.

title: Hebrews 13:23
text: Know that [our] brother Timothy has been set at liberty, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

title: Hebrews 13:24
text: Greet all those who have the rule over you, and all the saints. Those from Italy greet you.

title: Hebrews 13:25
text: Grace [be] with you all. Amen.

title: James 1:1
text: James, a servant of God and of [the] Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes in the Dispersion, greeting:

title: James 1:2
text: My brothers, count [it] all joy when you fall into different kinds of temptations,

title: James 1:3
text: knowing that the trying of your faith works patience.

title: James 1:4
text: But let patience have its perfect work, so that you may be perfect and entire, lacking nothing.

title: James 1:5
text: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, [who] gives to all liberally and with no reproach, and it shall be given to him.

title: James 1:6
text: But let him ask in faith, doubting nothing. For he who doubts is like a wave of [the] sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

title: James 1:7
text: For do not let that man think that he shall receive anything from the Lord;

title: James 1:8
text: [he is] a double-minded man, not dependable in all his ways.

title: James 1:9
text: But let [the] humble brother rejoice in his exaltation;

title: James 1:10
text: and the rich one [rejoice] in his humiliation, because he shall pass away as the flower of the grass.

title: James 1:11
text: For the sun rose with the hot wind and dried up the grass, and its flower fell out, and the beauty of its appearance perished; so also the rich one will fade away in his ways.

title: James 1:12
text: Blessed [is] the man who endures temptation, because having been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord has promised to those who love Him.

title: James 1:13
text: Let no one being tempted say, I am tempted from God. For God is not tempted by evils, and He tempts no one.

title: James 1:14
text: But each one is tempted by his lusts, being drawn away and seduced [by them].

title: James 1:15
text: Then when lust has conceived, [it] brings forth sin. And sin, when it is fully formed, brings forth death.

title: James 1:16
text: Do not err, my beloved brothers.

title: James 1:17
text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above and comes down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness nor shadow of turning.

title: James 1:18
text: Of [His own] will He brought us forth with [the] Word of truth, for us to be a certain firstfruit of His creatures.

title: James 1:19
text: Therefore, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath.

title: James 1:20
text: For the wrath of man does not work out [the] righteousness of God.

title: James 1:21
text: Therefore putting aside all filthiness and overflowing of evil, receive in meekness the implanted Word, which is able to save your souls.

title: James 1:22
text: But become doers of the Word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

title: James 1:23
text: For if anyone is a hearer of [the] Word and not a doer, he is like a man studying his natural face in a mirror.

title: James 1:24
text: For he studied himself and went his way, and immediately [he] forgot what he was like.

title: James 1:25
text: But whoever looks into the perfect law of liberty and continues [in it], he is not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of [the] work. This one shall be blessed in his doing.

title: James 1:26
text: If anyone thinks to be religious among you, [yet] does not bridle his tongue, but deceives his own heart, this one's religion [is] vain.

title: James 1:27
text: Pure religion and undefiled before God and [the] Father [is] this, to visit orphans and widows in their afflictions, and to keep oneself unspotted from the world.

title: James 2:1
text: My brothers, do not have the faith of our Lord Christ, [the Lord] of glory, with respect of persons.

title: James 2:2
text: For if there comes a gold-fingered man in fancy clothing into your assembly, and if there also comes in a poor man in shabby clothing,

title: James 2:3
text: and if you have respect to him who has the fancy clothing and say to him, You sit here in a good place, and say to the poor, You stand there, or sit here under my footstool;

title: James 2:4
text: Did you not make a difference among yourselves and became judges [with] evil thoughts?

title: James 2:5
text: Listen, my beloved brothers, has not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith and heirs of the kingdom which He has promised to those who love Him?

title: James 2:6
text: But you dishonored the poor one. Do not rich men oppress you and draw you before the judgment seats?

title: James 2:7
text: Do they not blaspheme that worthy Name by which you are called?

title: James 2:8
text: If you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself," you do well.

title: James 2:9
text: But if you have respect to persons, you commit sin and are convicted by the law as transgressors.

title: James 2:10
text: For whoever shall keep the whole law and yet offend in one [point], he is guilty of all.

title: James 2:11
text: For He who said, "Do not commit adultery," also said, "Do not murder." But if you do not commit adultery, yet if you murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

title: James 2:12
text: So speak and do as those who shall be judged by [the] law of liberty.

title: James 2:13
text: For he who has shown no mercy shall have judgment without mercy, and mercy exults over judgment.

title: James 2:14
text: My brothers, what profit [is it] if a man says he has faith and does not have works? Can faith save him?

title: James 2:15
text: If a brother or sister is naked and destitute of daily food,

title: James 2:16
text: and if one of you says to them, Go in peace, be warmed and filled, but you do not give them those things which are needful to the body, what good [is it]?

title: James 2:17
text: Even so, if it does not have works, faith is dead, being by itself.

title: James 2:18
text: But someone will say, You have faith, and I have works. Show me your faith without your works, and I will show you my faith by my works.

title: James 2:19
text: You believe that there is one God, you do well; even the demons believe and tremble.

title: James 2:20
text: But will you know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?

title: James 2:21
text: Was not Abraham our father justified by works when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?

title: James 2:22
text: Do you see how faith worked with his works, and by the works faith was made complete?

title: James 2:23
text: And the Scripture was fulfilled which says, "Abraham believed God, and it was imputed to him for righteousness, and he was called the friend of God."

title: James 2:24
text: You see then how a man is justified by works, and not by faith only.

title: James 2:25
text: And in the same way, was not Rahab the harlot also justified by works when she had received the messengers and had [sent] them out another way?

title: James 2:26
text: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

title: James 3:1
text: My brothers, do not be many teachers, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.

title: James 3:2
text: For [in] many [things] we all offend. If anyone does not offend in word, the same [is] a full-grown man, able also to bridle the whole body.

title: James 3:3
text: Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, so that they may obey us, and we turn about their whole body.

title: James 3:4
text: Behold also the ships being so great, and driven by fierce winds, yet they are turned about with a very small rudder, where the impulse of him steering desires.

title: James 3:5
text: Even so the tongue is a little member and boasts great things. Behold how little a fire kindles how large a forest!

title: James 3:6
text: And the tongue [is] a fire, a world of iniquity. So the tongue is set among our members, spotting all the body and inflaming the course of nature, and being inflamed by hell.

title: James 3:7
text: For every kind of animals, and of birds, and of reptiles, and of sea-animals, is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind.

title: James 3:8
text: But no one can tame the tongue, [it is] an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.

title: James 3:9
text: By this we bless God, even [the] Father. And by this we curse men, who have come into being according to the image of God.

title: James 3:10
text: Out of the same mouth proceeds blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

title: James 3:11
text: Does a fountain send forth at the same hole the sweet and the bitter?

title: James 3:12
text: Can the fig tree, my brothers, bear olive berries; or a vine, figs? So no fountain [can] yield both salt water and fresh.

title: James 3:13
text: Who [is] wise and knowing among you? Let him show his works by [his] good conduct with meekness of wisdom.

title: James 3:14
text: But if you have bitter jealousy and strife in your hearts, do not glory and lie against the truth.

title: James 3:15
text: This is not the wisdom coming down from above, but [is] earthly, sensual, devilish.

title: James 3:16
text: For where envying and strife [are], there [is] confusion and every foul deed.

title: James 3:17
text: But the wisdom that is from above is first truly pure, then peaceable, gentle, easy to be entreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality and without hypocrisy.

title: James 3:18
text: And [the] fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

title: James 4:1
text: From where do wars and fightings among you [come]? [Is it] not from this, from your lusts which war in your members?

title: James 4:2
text: You desire, and do not have. You murder, and are jealous, and cannot obtain. You fight and war, yet you have not because you ask not.

title: James 4:3
text: You ask and receive not, because you ask amiss, that you may spend [it] upon your lusts.

title: James 4:4
text: Adulterers and adulteresses! Do you not know that the friendship of the world is enmity [with] God? Therefore whoever desires to be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.

title: James 4:5
text: Do you think that the Scripture says in vain, The spirit that dwells in us yearns to envy?

title: James 4:6
text: But He gives more grace. Therefore He says, God resists the proud, but He gives grace to the humble.

title: James 4:7
text: Therefore submit yourselves to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

title: James 4:8
text: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse [your] hands, sinners; and purify your hearts, double-minded ones.

title: James 4:9
text: Be afflicted, and mourn and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and [your] joy to heaviness.

title: James 4:10
text: Be humbled before the Lord, and He will lift you up.

title: James 4:11
text: Do not speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against [his] brother, and who judges his brother, speaks against the Law and judges the Law. But if you judge the Law, you are not a doer of the Law, but a judge.

title: James 4:12
text: There is one Lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. Who are you who judges another?

title: James 4:13
text: Come now, those saying, Today or tomorrow we will go into such a city and spend a year there, and we will trade and will make a profit,

title: James 4:14
text: who do not know of the morrow. For what [is] your life? For it is a vapor, which appears for a little time, and then disappears.

title: James 4:15
text: Instead of you saying, If the Lord wills, we shall live and do this or that.

title: James 4:16
text: But now you boast in your presumptions. All such boasting is evil.

title: James 4:17
text: Therefore to him who knows to do good, and does not do [it], to him it is sin.

title: James 5:1
text: Come now, rich ones, weep and howl for your hardships coming on.

title: James 5:2
text: Your riches have rotted, and your clothes have become moth-eaten.

title: James 5:3
text: Your gold and silver have corroded, and their poison will be a witness against you, and will eat your flesh as fire. You heaped treasure in the last days.

title: James 5:4
text: Behold, the hire of the laborers reaping your fields cry out, being kept back by you. And the cries of those who have reaped have entered into the ears of [the] Lord of hosts.

title: James 5:5
text: You have lived luxuriously on the earth, and lived wantonly. You have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.

title: James 5:6
text: You have condemned [and] murdered the just; he does not resist you.

title: James 5:7
text: Therefore be patient, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth and has long patience for it, until he receives [the] early and the latter rain.

title: James 5:8
text: You also be patient, establish your hearts, for the coming of your Lord draws near.

title: James 5:9
text: Do not grudge against one another, brothers, lest you be condemned. Behold, [the] Judge stands before the door.

title: James 5:10
text: My brothers, take the prophets who have spoken in the name of [the] Lord, [for] an example of suffering ill, and of patience.

title: James 5:11
text: Behold, we count blessed those who endure. You have heard of the patience of Job, and you have seen the end of the Lord, that the Lord is full of pity and of tender mercy.

title: James 5:12
text: But before all things, my brothers, do not swear; neither by the heaven nor by the earth, nor any other oath. But let your yes be yes, and [your] no, no, lest you fall into condemnation.

title: James 5:13
text: Is any among you afflicted? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing psalms.

title: James 5:14
text: Is any sick among you? Let him call for the elders of the church, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord.

title: James 5:15
text: And the prayer of faith will cure the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up. And if he has committed sins, it will be forgiven him.

title: James 5:16
text: Confess faults to one another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed. [The] effectual fervent prayer of a righteous one avails much.

title: James 5:17
text: Elijah was a man of like passion as we are. And he prayed earnestly [that it] might not rain, and it did not rain on the earth for the time of three years and six months.

title: James 5:18
text: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth caused its fruit to sprout.

title: James 5:19
text: Brothers, if anyone among you err from the truth, and if anyone turns him back,

title: James 5:20
text: know that he who turns back the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.

title: I Peter 1:1
text: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to [the] elect sojourners of [the] Dispersion of Pontus, of Galatia, of Cappadocia, of Asia, and of Bithynia,

title: I Peter 1:2
text: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of [the] Spirit, to obedience and sprinkling of [the] blood of Jesus Christ. May grace and peace be multiplied to you.

title: I Peter 1:3
text: Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to His great mercy has regenerated us again to a living hope through [the] resurrection of Jesus Christ from [the] dead,

title: I Peter 1:4
text: to an inheritance incorruptible and undefiled, and unfading, reserved in Heaven for you

title: I Peter 1:5
text: by [the] power of God, having been kept through faith to a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time;

title: I Peter 1:6
text: in which you greatly rejoice, yet a little [while], if need be, grieving in manifold temptations;

title: I Peter 1:7
text: so that the trial of your faith (being much more precious than that of gold that perishes, but being proven through fire) might be found to praise and honor and glory at the revelation of Jesus Christ,

title: I Peter 1:8
text: whom having not seen, you love; in whom not yet seeing, but believing in Him you exult with unspeakable joy, and having been glorified,

title: I Peter 1:9
text: obtaining the end of your faith, the salvation of [your] souls.

title: I Peter 1:10
text: About which salvation the prophets sought out and searched out, prophesying concerning the grace for you;

title: I Peter 1:11
text: searching for what, or what manner of time, the Spirit of Christ made clear within them, testifying beforehand of the sufferings of Christ, and the glories that should follow.

title: I Peter 1:12
text: To them it was revealed that not to themselves, but to us, they ministered the things which are now reported to you by those who have preached the gospel to you in [the] Holy Spirit sent from Heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.

title: I Peter 1:13
text: Therefore girding up the loins of your mind, being sober, perfectly hope for the grace being brought to you at [the] revelation of Jesus Christ,

title: I Peter 1:14
text: as obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance,

title: I Peter 1:15
text: but according to the Holy One who has called you, you also become holy in all conduct,

title: I Peter 1:16
text: because it is written, "Be holy, for I am holy."

title: I Peter 1:17
text: And if you call on [the] Father, who without respect of persons judges according to the work of each one, pass the time of your [earthly] residence in fear,

title: I Peter 1:18
text: knowing that you were not redeemed with corruptible things, silver or gold, from your vain manner of life handed down from [your] fathers,

title: I Peter 1:19
text: but with [the] precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot;

title: I Peter 1:20
text: indeed having been foreknown before [the] foundation of [the] world, but revealed in [the] last times for you,

title: I Peter 1:21
text: those believing in God through Him, He who raised Him up from [the] dead and gave Him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.

title: I Peter 1:22
text: Purifying your souls in the obedience of the truth through the Spirit to unfeigned love of the brothers, love one another fervently out of a pure heart,

title: I Peter 1:23
text: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the living word of God, and abiding forever.

title: I Peter 1:24
text: For all flesh [is] as grass, and all the glory of men as the flower of the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls out,

title: I Peter 1:25
text: but the Word of the Lord endures forever. And this is the Word preached as gospel to you.

title: I Peter 2:1
text: Therefore laying aside all malice and all guile and hypocrisies and envyings, and all evil speakings,

title: I Peter 2:2
text: desire the sincere milk of the word, as newborn babes, so that you may grow by it;

title: I Peter 2:3
text: if truly you have tasted that the Lord [is] gracious.

title: I Peter 2:4
text: For having been drawn to Him, a living Stone, indeed rejected by men, but elect, precious with God;

title: I Peter 2:5
text: you also as living stones are built up a spiritual house, a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

title: I Peter 2:6
text: Therefore also it is contained in the Scripture: "Behold, I lay in Zion a chief corner Stone, elect, precious, and he who believes on Him shall never be ashamed."

title: I Peter 2:7
text: Therefore to you who believe [is] the honor. But to those who are disobedient, [He is the] Stone which the builders rejected; this One came to be [the] Head of the corner,

title: I Peter 2:8
text: and a Stone-of-stumbling and a Rock-of-offense to those disobeying, who stumble at the word, to which they also were appointed.

title: I Peter 2:9
text: But you [are] a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for possession, so that you might speak of the praises of Him who has called you out of darkness into His marvelous light;

title: I Peter 2:10
text: [you] who then were not a people, but now the people of God, those not pitied [then], but now pitied.

title: I Peter 2:11
text: Dearly beloved, I exhort [you] as [temporary] residents and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,

title: I Peter 2:12
text: having your conduct honest among the nations, in that which they speak against you as evildoers, they may glorify God in a day of [His] visitation, seeing [your] good works.

title: I Peter 2:13
text: Then be in obedience to every ordinance of men, because of the Lord, whether to a king as supreme,

title: I Peter 2:14
text: or to governors as sent by Him for vengeance [on] evildoers, but for praise [on] well-doers.

title: I Peter 2:15
text: For such is the will of God, doing good to silence the ignorance of foolish men;

title: I Peter 2:16
text: as free, and not having freedom as a cover of evil, but as servants of God.

title: I Peter 2:17
text: Honor all. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

title: I Peter 2:18
text: Servants, [be] subject to [your] masters with all fear, not only to those good and forbearing, but also to the perverse ones.

title: I Peter 2:19
text: For this [is] a grace, if for conscience [toward] God anyone endures grief, suffering wrongfully.

title: I Peter 2:20
text: For what glory [is it] if you patiently endure [while] sinning and being buffeted? But if you suffer [while] doing good, and patiently endure, this [is] a grace from God.

title: I Peter 2:21
text: For you were not called to this? For Christ also suffered on our behalf, leaving us an example, that you should follow His steps,

title: I Peter 2:22
text: He who did no sin, nor was guile found in His mouth,

title: I Peter 2:23
text: who when He was reviled did not revile in return. When He suffered, He did not threaten, but gave [Himself] up to Him who judges righteously.

title: I Peter 2:24
text: [He] Himself bore our sins in His own body on the tree, that dying to sins, we might live to righteousness; by whose stripes you were healed.

title: I Peter 2:25
text: For you were as sheep going astray, but now you are turned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

title: I Peter 3:1
text: Likewise, wives, [be] in subjection to your own husbands, so that if any do not obey the word, they may also be won without the word by the conduct of the wives,

title: I Peter 3:2
text: having witnessed your chaste behavior in [the] fear [of God].

title: I Peter 3:3
text: Of whom let not be the adorning of garments, or outward braiding of hair and wearing of gold, or of putting on clothing,

title: I Peter 3:4
text: but [let it be] the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, the meek and quiet spirit, which is of great price in the sight of God.

title: I Peter 3:5
text: For so once indeed the holy women hoping in God adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands;

title: I Peter 3:6
text: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord; whose children you became, doing good and fearing no terror.

title: I Peter 3:7
text: Likewise, husbands, live together according to knowledge, giving honor to the wife as to the weaker vessel, the female, as truly [being] co-heirs together of [the] grace of life, not cutting off your prayers.

title: I Peter 3:8
text: And finally, all [be] of one mind, having compassion on one another, loving the brothers, tenderhearted, friendly.

title: I Peter 3:9
text: Never give back evil for evil, or reviling for reviling, but on the contrary, [giving] blessing, knowing that you are called to this so that you might inherit blessing.

title: I Peter 3:10
text: For he that wants to love life and to see good days, let him restrain his tongue from evil, and his lips from speaking guile.

title: I Peter 3:11
