text: Let him turn aside from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.

title: I Peter 3:12
text: For the eyes of [the] Lord [are] on the righteous, and His ears [open] to their prayers. But [the] Lord's face [is] against [those] who do evil.

title: I Peter 3:13
text: And who [is] the [one] who will harm you if you become imitators of the good?

title: I Peter 3:14
text: But if you also suffer for righteousness' sake, [you are] blessed. And do not fear their fear, nor be troubled,

title: I Peter 3:15
text: but sanctify the Lord God in your hearts, and [be] ready always to [give] an answer to everyone who asks you a reason of the hope in you, with meekness and fear;

title: I Peter 3:16
text: having a good conscience, that while they speak against you as evildoers they may be shamed, those falsely accusing your good behavior in Christ.

title: I Peter 3:17
text: For [it is] better, if the will of God wills [it], to suffer [for] well-doing than [for] evil-doing.

title: I Peter 3:18
text: For Christ also once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that He might bring us to God, indeed being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit;

title: I Peter 3:19
text: in which also He went and preached to the spirits in prison,

title: I Peter 3:20
text: to disobeying ones, when once the long-suffering of God waited in [the] days of Noah, while the ark was being prepared (in which a few, that is, eight souls were saved through water);

title: I Peter 3:21
text: which figure now also saves us, baptism; not a putting away of [the] filth of [the] flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God, by [the] resurrection of Jesus Christ;

title: I Peter 3:22
text: who is at [the] right [hand] of God, having gone into Heaven, where [the] angels and authorities and powers are being subjected to Him.

title: I Peter 4:1
text: Therefore, Christ having suffered for us in [the] flesh, also you arm yourselves [with] the same thought, that he suffering in [the] flesh has been made to rest from sin,

title: I Peter 4:2
text: in order no longer to [live] in [the] lusts of men, but in [the] will of God the remaining time in [the] flesh.

title: I Peter 4:3
text: For the time of life which is past is enough for us to have worked out the will of the nations, having gone on in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, parties, carousings, and abominable idolatries.

title: I Peter 4:4
text: In these things they are surprised, [that] you [are] not running with [them] into the same excess of riot, blaspheming.

title: I Peter 4:5
text: But they shall give account to Him who is ready to judge [the] living and [the] dead.

title: I Peter 4:6
text: For to this [end] the gospel was preached also to [the] dead, that they might be judged according to men in [the] flesh, but live according to God in [the] Spirit.

title: I Peter 4:7
text: But the end of all things has drawn near. Therefore be of sound mind, and be sensible to prayers.

title: I Peter 4:8
text: And above all things have fervent love to yourselves, for love will cover a multitude of sins.

title: I Peter 4:9
text: Be hospitable to one another, without grudging;

title: I Peter 4:10
text: each one as he received a gift, ministering it to yourselves as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

title: I Peter 4:11
text: If anyone speaks, [let it be] as [the] words of God. If anyone ministers, let him do it as of the ability which God gives, so that God may be glorified in all things through Jesus Christ, to whom is the glory, and the might forever and ever. Amen.

title: I Peter 4:12
text: Beloved, do not be astonished at the fiery trial which is to try you, as [though] a strange thing happened to you,

title: I Peter 4:13
text: but rejoice according as you are partakers of Christ's suffering, so that when His glory shall be revealed, you may be glad also with exceeding joy.

title: I Peter 4:14
text: If you are reviled for [the] name of Christ, [you are] blessed, because the Spirit of God and of glory rests on you. Truly according to them, He is blasphemed, but according to you He is glorified.

title: I Peter 4:15
text: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evildoer, or a meddler in the affairs of others.

title: I Peter 4:16
text: But if [one suffers] as a Christian, let him not be ashamed, but let him glorify God because of this.

title: I Peter 4:17
text: For the time [has come] for the judgment to begin from the house of God. And if [it] first [begins] from us, what [will be] the end of those disobeying the gospel of God?

title: I Peter 4:18
text: And if the righteous one is scarcely saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?

title: I Peter 4:19
text: Therefore let those who suffer according to the will of God commit their souls in well-doing, as to a faithful Creator.

title: I Peter 5:1
text: I exhort the elders who are among you, I being also an elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed.

title: I Peter 5:2
text: Feed the flock of God among you, taking the oversight, not by compulsion, but willingly; nor for base gain, but readily;

title: I Peter 5:3
text: nor as lording it over those allotted [to you by God], but becoming examples to the flock.

title: I Peter 5:4
text: And when the Chief Shepherd shall appear, you shall receive a never-fading crown of glory.

title: I Peter 5:5
text: Likewise, younger ones, be subject to older ones, and all being subject to one another. Put on humility. For God resists proud ones, but He gives grace to the humble.

title: I Peter 5:6
text: Therefore be humbled under the mighty hand of God, so that He may exalt you in due time,

title: I Peter 5:7
text: casting all your anxiety onto Him, for He cares for you.

title: I Peter 5:8
text: Be sensible [and] vigilant, because your adversary [the] Devil walks about like a roaring lion, seeking someone he may devour;

title: I Peter 5:9
text: whom firmly resist in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions in [the] world are being completed in your brotherhood.

title: I Peter 5:10
text: But the God of all grace, He calling us to His eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little, [He] will perfect, confirm, strengthen, and establish [you].

title: I Peter 5:11
text: To Him [be] the glory and the might forever and ever. Amen.

title: I Peter 5:12
text: I wrote to you through a few [words], by Silvanus, a faithful brother to you, as I suppose, exhorting and testifying this to be [the] true grace of God in which you stand.

title: I Peter 5:13
text: The fellow-elected in Babylon greet you; also Mark my son.

title: I Peter 5:14
text: Greet one another with a kiss of holy love. Peace [be] to you, all those in Christ Jesus. Amen.

title: II Peter 1:1
text: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained like precious faith with us through [the] righteousness of God and our Savior Jesus Christ,

title: II Peter 1:2
text: Grace and peace be multiplied to you through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

title: II Peter 1:3
text: according as His divine power has given to us all things that [pertain] to life and godliness, through the knowledge of Him who has called us to glory and virtue,

title: II Peter 1:4
text: through which He has given to us exceedingly great and precious promises, so that by these you might be partakers of [the] divine nature, having escaped the corruption [that is] in [the] world through lust.

title: II Peter 1:5
text: But also in this very thing, bringing in all diligence, filling out your faith with virtue, and with virtue, knowledge;

title: II Peter 1:6
text: and knowledge [with] self-control, and [with] self-control, patience, and [with] patience. godliness,

title: II Peter 1:7
text: and [with] godliness, brotherly kindness, and [with] brotherly kindness, love.

title: II Peter 1:8
text: For if these things are in you and abound, [you shall] not [be] idle nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: II Peter 1:9
text: But he in whom these things [are] not present is blind and cannot see afar off and has forgotten that he was purged from his sins in times past.

title: II Peter 1:10
text: Therefore, brothers, rather be diligent to make your calling and election sure, for [if you] do these things, you shall never fall.

title: II Peter 1:11
text: For so an entrance shall be ministered to you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

title: II Peter 1:12
text: Therefore I will not neglect to put you always in remembrance of these things, though [you] know [them] and are established in the present truth.

title: II Peter 1:13
text: But I think [it] right, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by a reminder,

title: II Peter 1:14
text: knowing that the putting off of my tabernacle is soon, as indeed our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

title: II Peter 1:15
text: And I will also be diligent to cause you to always have memory of these things after my departure.

title: II Peter 1:16
text: For not following cunningly devised fables, but becoming eyewitnesses of the majesty of Jesus Christ, we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord.

title: II Peter 1:17
text: For He received honor and glory from God [the] Father, when was borne to Him a voice from the excellent glory, "This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."

title: II Peter 1:18
text: And we heard this voice being borne from Heaven, being with Him in the holy mountain.

title: II Peter 1:19
text: We also have a more sure word of prophecy, to which you do well to take heed, as to a light that shines in a dark place, until the day dawns and the Daystar arises in your hearts,

title: II Peter 1:20
text: knowing this first, that no prophecy of the Scripture came into being of [its] own private interpretation.

title: II Peter 1:21
text: For prophecy was not borne at any time by [the] will of man, but holy men of God spoke being borne along by the Holy Spirit.

title: II Peter 2:1
text: But there were also false prophets among the people, even as there will be false teachers among you, who secretly will bring in destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.

title: II Peter 2:2
text: And many will follow their pernicious ways, and because of them the way of truth will be evil spoken of.

title: II Peter 2:3
text: And through covetousness they will use you for gain with well-turned words; for whom judgment from of old does not linger, and their destruction does not sleep.

title: II Peter 2:4
text: For God did not spare the angels who sinned, but thrust [them] down into Tartarus, and delivered [them] into chains of darkness, being reserved to judgment.

title: II Peter 2:5
text: And He did not spare [the] old world, but saved Noah [the] eighth one, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly.

title: II Peter 2:6
text: And turning the cities [of] Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, He condemned [them] with an overthrow, setting an example to men intending to live ungodly.

title: II Peter 2:7
text: And He delivered righteous Lot, oppressed with the lustful behavior of the lawless.

title: II Peter 2:8
text: For that righteous one living among them, in seeing and hearing, [his] righteous soul [was] tormented from day to day with [their] unlawful deeds.

title: II Peter 2:9
text: [The] Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation, and to reserve the unjust for a day of judgment, to be punished,

title: II Peter 2:10
text: and especially those who walk after the flesh in [the] lust of uncleanness, and despise dominion. They are darers, self-pleasing; not trembling [at] glories, speaking evil.

title: II Peter 2:11
text: Where angels, [who are] greater in power and might, do not bring a reproaching accusation against them before [the] Lord.

title: II Peter 2:12
text: But these, as unreasoning natural brute animals, having been born for capture and corruption, speak evil of the things that they do not understand. And they will utterly perish in their own corruption,

title: II Peter 2:13
text: being about to receive [the] wages of unrighteousness, deeming indulgence [as] pleasure in [the] daytime, and reveling [in] spots and blemishes, feasting along with you in their deceits,

title: II Peter 2:14
text: having eyes full of adultery and never ceasing from sin, alluring unstable souls, having a heart exercised [with] covetousness. [They are] cursed children

title: II Peter 2:15
text: who have forsaken the right way and have gone astray, following the way of Balaam [the son] of Beor, who loved [the] wages of unrighteousness,

title: II Peter 2:16
text: but had reproof of [his] lawbreaking, a dumb ass speaking in a man's voice, held back the madness of the prophet.

title: II Peter 2:17
text: These are wells without water, clouds driven with a tempest, for whom the blackness of darkness is reserved forever.

title: II Peter 2:18
text: For when they speak great swelling [words] of vanity, they lure through [the] lusts of the flesh, by unbridled lust, the ones who were escaping from those who live in error;

title: II Peter 2:19
text: promising them liberty, they themselves are the slaves of corruption. For by whom anyone has been overcome, even to this one he has been enslaved.

title: II Peter 2:20
text: For if [they] have escaped the pollutions of the world through the full knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus, and are again entangled, they have been overcome by these, [their] last things are worse [than] the first.

title: II Peter 2:21
text: For it would have been better for them not to have fully known the way of righteousness, than fully knowing [it], to turn from the holy commandment delivered to them.

title: II Peter 2:22
text: But [the] word of the true proverb has happened to them: [The] dog turning to [his] own vomit; and, [The] washed sow to wallowing in the mire.

title: II Peter 3:1
text: Beloved, I now write this second letter to you, in which I stir up your pure mind to remember

title: II Peter 3:2
text: the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of the Lord and Savior by us, the apostles.

title: II Peter 3:3
text: First, knowing this, that there will come in [the] last days scoffers walking according to their own lusts

title: II Peter 3:4
text: and saying, Where is the promise of His coming? For since [the] fathers fell asleep, all things continue as [they were] from the beginning of creation.

title: II Peter 3:5
text: For this is hidden from them [by their] willing it, that the heavens were of old, and the earth out of the water, and through water, being held together by the word of God,

title: II Peter 3:6
text: through which the world that then was, being flooded by water, perished.

title: II Peter 3:7
text: But the present heavens and the earth being kept in store by the same word, are being kept for fire until the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

title: II Peter 3:8
text: But, beloved, let not this one thing be hidden [from you], that one day [is] with [the] Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

title: II Peter 3:9
text: The Lord is not slow concerning His promise, as some count slowness, but is long-suffering toward us, not willing that any [of us] should perish, but that all [of us] should come to repentance.

title: II Peter 3:10
text: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in [the] night, in which the heavens will pass away with a rushing noise, and [the] elements will melt with fervent heat. And the earth and the works in it will be burned up.

title: II Peter 3:11
text: Then, all these things being [about to be] dissolved, what sort ought you to be in holy behavior and godliness,

title: II Peter 3:12
text: looking for and rushing the coming of the Day of God, on account of which [the] heavens, being on fire, will melt away, and [the] elements will melt, burning with heat?

title: II Peter 3:13
text: But according to His promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth in which righteousness dwells.

title: II Peter 3:14
text: Therefore, beloved, looking for these things, be diligent, spotless, and without blemish, to be found by Him in peace.

title: II Peter 3:15
text: And think of the long-suffering of our Lord [as] salvation (as our beloved brother Paul also has written to you according to the wisdom given to him

title: II Peter 3:16
text: as also in all his letters, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which the unlearned and unstable pervert, as also [they do] the rest of the Scriptures, to [their] own destruction).

title: II Peter 3:17
text: Therefore, beloved, knowing beforehand, beware lest being led away with the error of the lawless, you fall from [your] own steadfastness.

title: II Peter 3:18
text: But grow in grace and [in] knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him [be] the glory, both now and to [the] day of eternity. Amen.

title: I John 1:1
text: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, concerning the Word of life,

title: I John 1:2
text: (for the Life was revealed, and we have seen [it] and bear witness, and show to you the everlasting Life, who was with the Father and was revealed to us),

title: I John 1:3
text: that which we have seen and heard we declare unto you, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And truly our fellowship [is] with the Father and with His Son Jesus Christ.

title: I John 1:4
text: And we write these things to you so that your joy may be full.

title: I John 1:5
text: And this is the message which we have heard from Him and declare to you, that God is light, and in Him is no darkness at all.

title: I John 1:6
text: If we say that we have fellowship with Him and walk in darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.

title: I John 1:7
text: But if we walk in the light, as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ His Son cleanses us from all sin.

title: I John 1:8
text: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

title: I John 1:9
text: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us [our] sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

title: I John 1:10
text: If we say that we have not sinned, we make Him a liar, and His word is not in us.

title: I John 2:1
text: My little children, I write these things to you so that you do not sin. And if anyone sins, we have an Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ [the] righteous.

title: I John 2:2
text: And He is [the] propitiation concerning our sins, and not concerning ours only, but also concerning [the sins of] all the world.

title: I John 2:3
text: And by this we know that we have known Him, if we keep His commandments.

title: I John 2:4
text: He who says, I have known Him, and does not keep His commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

title: I John 2:5
text: But whoever keeps His word, truly in this one the love of God is perfected. By this we know that we are in Him.

title: I John 2:6
text: He who says he abides in Him ought himself also to walk even as He walked.

title: I John 2:7
text: Brothers, I do not write a new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from [the] beginning. The old commandment is the word which you have heard from [the] beginning.

title: I John 2:8
text: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which thing is true in Him and in you, because the darkness is passing away, and the true Light now shines.

title: I John 2:9
text: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in darkness until now.

title: I John 2:10
text: He who loves his brother rests in the light, and there is no offense in him.

title: I John 2:11
text: But he who hates his brother is in darkness, and walks in darkness, and does not know where he is going, because darkness has blinded his eyes.

title: I John 2:12
text: I write to you, little children, because [your] sins are forgiven you for His name's sake.

title: I John 2:13
text: I write to you, fathers, because you have known Him [who is] from [the] beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you have known the Father.

title: I John 2:14
text: I write to you, fathers, because you have known Him [who is] from [the] beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

title: I John 2:15
text: Do not love the world, nor the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him,

title: I John 2:16
text: because all that [is] in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

title: I John 2:17
text: And the world passes away, and the lust of it, but he who does the will of God abides forever.

title: I John 2:18
text: Little children, it is the last time. And just as you have heard that antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have risen up, from which we know that it is the last hour.

title: I John 2:19
text: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they were of us, they would have continued with us. But [they went out] so that it might be revealed that they were not all of us.

title: I John 2:20
text: But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and you know all things.

title: I John 2:21
text: I have not written to you because you do not know the truth, but because you know it, and know that no lie is of the truth.

title: I John 2:22
text: Who is a liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? He who denies the Father and the Son is anti-christ.

title: I John 2:23
text: Everyone who denies the Son neither has the Father. The [one] confessing the Son also has the Father.

title: I John 2:24
text: Therefore what you heard from the beginning, let it abide in you. If what you heard from [the] beginning remains in you, you will abide in both the Son and in the Father.

title: I John 2:25
text: And this is the promise that He has promised us: everlasting life.

title: I John 2:26
text: These [things] I have written to you concerning those leading you astray.

title: I John 2:27
text: But the anointing which you received from Him abides in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But as His anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true and no lie, and as He has taught you, abide in Him.

title: I John 2:28
text: And now, little children, abide in Him, so that when He is revealed, we may have confidence and not be ashamed before Him in His coming.

title: I John 2:29
text: If you know that He is righteous, you know that everyone who does righteousness has been born of Him.

title: I John 3:1
text: Behold what manner of love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God. Therefore the world does not know us, because it did not know Him.

title: I John 3:2
text: Beloved, now we are children of God, and it has not yet been revealed what we shall be. But we know that when He shall be revealed, we shall be like Him, for we shall see Him as He is.

title: I John 3:3
text: And everyone who has this hope on him purifies himself, even as that [One] is pure.

title: I John 3:4
text: Everyone who practices sin also practices lawlessness, for sin is lawlessness.

title: I John 3:5
text: And you know that He was revealed that He might take away our sins, and in Him is no sin.

title: I John 3:6
text: Everyone who abides in Him does not sin. Everyone who sins has not seen Him nor known Him.

title: I John 3:7
text: Little children, let no one deceive you. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as that [One] is righteous.

title: I John 3:8
text: He who practices sin is of the Devil, for the Devil sins from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was revealed, that He might undo the works of the Devil.

title: I John 3:9
text: Everyone who has been born of God does not commit sin, because His seed remains in him, and he cannot sin, because he has been born of God.

title: I John 3:10
text: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the Devil: everyone not practicing righteousness is not of God, also he who does not love his brother.

title: I John 3:11
text: For this is the message that you have heard from [the] beginning, that we should love one another;

title: I John 3:12
text: not as Cain [who] was of the evil one, and killed his brother. And for what did he kill him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's things were righteous.

title: I John 3:13
text: Do not marvel, my brothers, if the world hates you.

title: I John 3:14
text: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love the brothers. He who does not love [his] brother abides in death.

title: I John 3:15
text: Everyone hating his brother is a murderer. And you know that no murderer has everlasting life abiding in him.

title: I John 3:16
text: By this we have known the love [of God], because He laid down His life for us. And we ought to lay down [our] lives for the brothers.

title: I John 3:17
text: But whoever has this world's goods and sees his brother having need, and shuts up his bowels from him, how does the love of God dwell in him?

title: I John 3:18
text: My children, let us not love in word or in tongue, but in deed and in truth.

title: I John 3:19
text: And in this we shall know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before Him,

title: I John 3:20
text: that if our heart accuses us, God is greater than our heart and knows all things.

title: I John 3:21
text: Beloved, if our heart does not accuse us, we have confidence toward God.

title: I John 3:22
text: And whatever we ask, we receive from Him, because we keep His commandments and do those things that are pleasing in His sight.

title: I John 3:23
text: And this is His commandment, that we should believe on the name of His Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as He gave us commandment.

title: I John 3:24
text: And he who keeps His commandment dwells in Him, and He in him. And by this we know that He abides in us, by the Spirit which He gave to us.

title: I John 4:1
text: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but try the spirits to see if they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

title: I John 4:2
text: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in [the] flesh is of God;

title: I John 4:3
text: and every spirit that does not confess that Jesus Christ has come in [the] flesh is not of God. And this is the antichrist you heard is coming, and even now is already in the world.

title: I John 4:4
text: You are of God, little children, and [you have] overcome them, because He who is in you is greater than he who is in the world.

title: I John 4:5
text: They are of the world, therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.

title: I John 4:6
text: We are of God. He who knows God hears us. The one who is not of God does not hear us. From this we know the spirit of truth and the spirit of error.

title: I John 4:7
text: Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God, and everyone who loves has been born of God, and knows God.

title: I John 4:8
text: The one who does not love has not known God. For God is love.

title: I John 4:9
text: In this the love of God was revealed in us, because God sent His only begotten Son into the world that we might live through Him.

title: I John 4:10
text: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son [to be] the propitiation concerning our sins.

title: I John 4:11
text: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.

title: I John 4:12
text: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwells in us, and His love is perfected in us.

title: I John 4:13
text: By this we know that we dwell in Him, and He in us, because He has given us of His Spirit.

title: I John 4:14
text: And we have seen and testify that the Father sent the Son [to be] the Savior of the world.

title: I John 4:15
text: Whoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwells in him and he in God.

title: I John 4:16
text: And we have known and believed the love that God has in us. God is love, and he who abides in love abides in God, and God in him.

title: I John 4:17
text: In this is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, that as He is, so also we are in this world.

title: I John 4:18
text: There is no fear in love, but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has torment. He who fears has not been perfected in love.

title: I John 4:19
text: We love Him because He first loved us.

title: I John 4:20
text: If anyone says, I love God, and hates his brother, he is a liar. For if he does not love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

title: I John 4:21
text: And we have this commandment from Him, that he who loves God should love his brother also.

title: I John 5:1
text: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. And everyone who loves Him who begets also loves him who has been born of Him.

title: I John 5:2
text: By this we know that we love the children of God, whenever we love God and keep His commandments.

title: I John 5:3
text: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments, and His commandments are not burdensome.

title: I John 5:4
text: For everything that has been born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that overcomes the world, our faith.

title: I John 5:5
text: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

title: I John 5:6
text: This is He who came through water and blood, Jesus Christ, not by water only, but by the water and blood. And the Spirit is He who bears witness, because the Spirit is the truth.

title: I John 5:7
text: [For there are three that bear record in Heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit, and these three are one.]

title: I John 5:8
text: And there are three that bear witness in the earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood; and the three are to the one.

title: I John 5:9
text: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater. For this is the witness of God which He has testified about His Son.

title: I John 5:10
text: He who believes on the Son of God has the witness in himself. He who does not believe God has made Him a liar, because he does not believe the record that God gave of His Son.

title: I John 5:11
text: And this is the record, that God has given to us everlasting life, and this life is in His Son.

title: I John 5:12
text: He who has the Son has life; he who does not have the Son of God does not have life.

title: I John 5:13
text: I have written these things to you who believe on the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have everlasting life, and that you may believe on the name of the Son of God.

title: I John 5:14
text: And this is the confidence that we have toward Him, that if we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.

title: I John 5:15
text: And if we know that He hears us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of Him.

title: I John 5:16
text: If anyone sees his brother sin a sin not to death, he shall ask, and He shall give him life for those that do not sin to death. There is a sin to death, I do not say that he shall pray for it.

title: I John 5:17
text: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is a sin not to death.

title: I John 5:18
text: We know that everyone who has been born of God does not continue in sin, but the one born of God guards himself, and the evil one does not touch him.

title: I John 5:19
text: We know that we are of God, and all the world lies in evil.

title: I John 5:20
text: And we know that the Son of God has come, and [He] has given us an understanding so that we may know Him who is true. And we are in Him that is true, in His Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and the everlasting life.

title: I John 5:21
text: Little children, guard yourselves from idols. Amen.

title: II John 1:1
text: The elder to the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth and not only I, but also all those who have known the truth,

title: II John 1:2
text: for the sake of the truth dwelling in us, and [which] shall be with us forever.

title: II John 1:3
text: Grace will be with you, mercy [and] peace from God [the] Father and from [the] Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

title: II John 1:4
text: I rejoiced greatly that I found your children walking in truth, as we have received command from the Father.

title: II John 1:5
text: And now I beseech you, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment to you, but that which we had from [the] beginning, that we love one another.

title: II John 1:6
text: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the commandment, as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

title: II John 1:7
text: For many deceivers have entered into the world, who do not confess that Jesus Christ has come in [the] flesh. This is the deceiver and the anti-christ.

title: II John 1:8
text: Look to yourselves, so that we may not lose those things which we worked out, but that we may receive a full reward.

title: II John 1:9
text: Everyone transgressing and not abiding in the doctrine of Christ does not have God. He who abides in the doctrine of Christ, he has both the Father and the Son.

title: II John 1:10
text: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this doctrine, do not receive him into [your] house, nor speak a greeting to him.

title: II John 1:11
text: For he who speaks a greeting to him is partaker of his evil deeds.

title: II John 1:12
text: Having many things to write to you, I do not want [to say] with paper and ink. But I trust to come to you and speak face to face, so that our joy may be full.

title: II John 1:13
text: The children of your elect sister greet you. Amen.

title: III John 1:1
text: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in the truth.

title: III John 1:2
text: Beloved, in regard to all things I pray [that] you prosper and be in health, even as your soul prospers.

title: III John 1:3
text: For I rejoiced greatly when [the] brothers came and testified of the truth that is in you, even as you walk in the truth.

title: III John 1:4
text: I have no greater joy than these things, to hear that my children walk in the truth.

title: III John 1:5
text: Beloved, you do faithfully whatever you work for the brothers and for strangers,

title: III John 1:6
text: who in love bore witness of you before [the] church, whom you will do well to send forward worthily of God;

title: III John 1:7
text: because they went forth for His name's sake, taking nothing from the nations.

title: III John 1:8
text: Therefore we ought to entertain such, so that we might be co-workers in the truth.

title: III John 1:9
text: I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to have the preeminence among them, did not receive us.

title: III John 1:10
text: Therefore if I come, I will remember his deeds which he does, ranting against us with evil words. And not content [with] these, neither does he himself receive the brothers. And he forbids those who would, and casts [them] out of the church.

title: III John 1:11
text: Beloved, do not imitate the bad, but the good. He who does good is from God, but he who does evil has not seen God.

title: III John 1:12
text: Demetrius has good report by all, and by the truth itself. And we also bear witness, and you know that our witness is true.

title: III John 1:13
text: I had many things to write, but I will not write to you with pen and ink,

title: III John 1:14
text: but I trust I shall shortly see you, and we shall speak face to face. Peace [be] to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.

title: Jude 1:1
text: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to the [ones] called in God [the] Father, having been set apart, and having been kept by Jesus Christ:

title: Jude 1:2
text: Mercy and peace and love be multiplied to you.

title: Jude 1:3
text: Having made all haste to write to you about the common salvation, beloved, I had need to write to you to exhort [you] to contend earnestly for the faith once delivered to the saints.

title: Jude 1:4
text: For certain men crept in secretly, those having been of old previously written into this condemnation, ungodly ones perverting the grace of our God for unbridled lust, and denying the only Master, God, even our Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Jude 1:5
text: But I intend to remind you, you once knowing these things, that the Lord having delivered a people out of the land of Egypt, in the second place destroyed the ones not believing.

title: Jude 1:6
text: And those angels not having kept their first place, but having deserted their dwelling-place, He has kept in everlasting chains under darkness for the judgment of a great Day;

title: Jude 1:7
text: as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the cities around them, in like manner to these, committing fornication, and going away after other flesh, laid down an example before-times, undergoing vengeance of everlasting fire.

title: Jude 1:8
text: Likewise, indeed, also these dreaming ones even defile flesh, and despise rulership, and speak evil of glories.

title: Jude 1:9
text: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the Devil, he argued about the body of Moses, he dared not bring a judgment of blasphemy, but said, Let the Lord rebuke you!

title: Jude 1:10
text: But what things they do not know, they speak evil of these. And what things they understand naturally, like the animals without reason, they are corrupted by these.

title: Jude 1:11
text: Woe to them! For they went the way of Cain, and gave themselves up to the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Korah.

title: Jude 1:12
text: These are sunken rocks in your love feasts, feasting together with you; feeding themselves without fear; waterless clouds being carried about by winds; fruitless autumn trees, having died twice, having been plucked up by the roots;

title: Jude 1:13
text: wild waves of the sea foaming up their shames; wandering stars for whom blackness of darkness has been kept forever.

title: Jude 1:14
text: And Enoch, the seventh from Adam, also prophesied to these, saying, Behold, the Lord came with myriads of His saints,

title: Jude 1:15
text: to do judgment against all, and to rebuke all the ungodly of them concerning all their ungodly works which they ungodly did, and concerning all the hard things ungodly sinners spoke against Him.

title: Jude 1:16
text: These are murmurers, complainers, leading lives according to their lusts. And their mouth speaks proud things, admiring faces for the sake of gain.

title: Jude 1:17
text: But you, beloved, remember the words spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ,

title: Jude 1:18
text: because they told you that at [the] last time there will be mockers according to their lusts, leading ungodly lives.

title: Jude 1:19
text: These are those setting themselves apart, animal-like ones, not having the Spirit.

title: Jude 1:20
text: But you, beloved, building yourselves up by your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,

title: Jude 1:21
text: keep yourselves in the love of God, eagerly awaiting the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to everlasting life.

title: Jude 1:22
text: But pity some, making distinction.

title: Jude 1:23
text: But save others with fear, snatching [them] out of the fire; hating even the garment having been stained from the flesh.

title: Jude 1:24
text: Now to Him being able to keep you without stumbling, and to set you before His glory without blemish, with unspeakable joy;

title: Jude 1:25
text: to the only wise God, our Savior, [be] glory and majesty and might and authority, even now and forever. Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:1
text: A Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave to Him to declare to His servants things which must shortly come to pass. And He signified [it] by sending His angel to His servant John,

title: Revelation of John 1:2
text: who bore record of the Word of God and of the testimony of Jesus Christ and of all the things that he saw.

title: Revelation of John 1:3
text: Blessed [is] the [one] who reads and hears the words of this prophecy, and the ones keeping the things written in it, for the time [is] near.

title: Revelation of John 1:4
text: John to the seven churches which are in Asia. Grace to you and peace from Him who is and who was and who [is] coming; and from the seven spirits which are before His throne;

title: Revelation of John 1:5
text: even from Jesus Christ the faithful Witness, the First-born from the dead and the Ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loved us and washed us from our sins in His own blood,

title: Revelation of John 1:6
text: and made us kings and priests to God and His Father, to Him [be] glory and dominion forever and ever. Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:7
text: Behold, He comes with the clouds, and every eye will see Him, and those who pierced Him will see Him, and all the kindreds of the earth will wail because of Him. Even so, Amen.

title: Revelation of John 1:8
text: I am the Alpha and Omega, [the] Beginning and [the] Ending, says the Lord, who is and who was and who [is] to come, the Almighty.

title: Revelation of John 1:9
text: I, John, [who] also [am] your brother and companion in the affliction, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the island that is called Patmos, for the Word of God and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.

title: Revelation of John 1:10
text: I came to be in [the] Spirit in the Lord's day and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,

title: Revelation of John 1:11
text: saying, I am the Alpha and Omega, the First and the Last. Also, What you see, write in a book and send [it] to the seven churches which are in Asia: to Ephesus, and to Smyrna, and to Pergamos, and to Thyatira, and to Sardis, and to Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.

title: Revelation of John 1:12
text: And I turned to see the voice that spoke with me.

title: Revelation of John 1:13
text: And having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands. And in the midst of the seven lampstands I saw [One] like [the] Son of man, clothed with a garment down to [the] feet, and tied around the breast with a golden band.

title: Revelation of John 1:14
text: His head and hair [were] white like wool, as white as snow. And His eyes [were] like a flame of fire.

title: Revelation of John 1:15
text: And His feet were like burnished brass having been fired in a furnace. And His voice was like the sound of many waters.

title: Revelation of John 1:16
text: And He had seven stars in His right hand, and out of His mouth went a sharp two-edged sword. And His face [was] like the sun shining in its strength.

title: Revelation of John 1:17
text: And when I saw Him, I fell at His feet as dead. And He laid His right hand upon me, saying to me, Do not fear, I am the First and the Last,

title: Revelation of John 1:18
text: and the Living One, and I became dead, and behold, I am alive for ever and ever, Amen. And I have the keys of hell and of death.

title: Revelation of John 1:19
text: Write the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be after this,

title: Revelation of John 1:20
text: the mystery of the seven stars which you saw in My right hand and the seven golden lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands which you saw are the seven churches.

title: Revelation of John 2:1
text: To the angel of the Church of Ephesus write: He who holds the seven stars in His right hand, who walks in the midst of the seven golden lampstands, says these things.

title: Revelation of John 2:2
text: I know your works and your labor and your patience, and how you cannot bear those who are evil. And [you] tried those pretending to be apostles, and are not, and have found them liars.

title: Revelation of John 2:3
text: And [you] have borne, and have patience, and for My name's sake you have labored and have not fainted.

title: Revelation of John 2:4
text: But I have against you that you left your first love.

title: Revelation of John 2:5
text: Therefore remember from where you have fallen, and repent, and do the first works, or else I will come to you quickly and will remove your lampstand out of its place unless you repent.

title: Revelation of John 2:6
text: But you have this, that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

title: Revelation of John 2:7
text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes I will give him to eat of the Tree of Life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.

title: Revelation of John 2:8
text: And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write: The First and the Last, who became dead and lived, says these things:

title: Revelation of John 2:9
text: I know your works and tribulation and poverty (but you are rich), and [I know] the blasphemy of those saying themselves to be Jews, and are not, but [are] the synagogue of Satan.

title: Revelation of John 2:10
text: Do not at all fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the Devil will cast [some] of you into prison, so that you may be tried. And you will have tribulation ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.

title: Revelation of John 2:11
text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. He who overcomes will not be hurt by the second death.

title: Revelation of John 2:12
text: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write: He who has the sharp sword with two edges says these things.

title: Revelation of John 2:13
text: I know your works, and where you live, [even] where Satan's seat [is]. And you hold fast My name and have not denied My faith, even in those days in which Antipas [was] My faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwells.

title: Revelation of John 2:14
text: But I have a few things against you, because you have there those who hold the teachings of Balaam, who taught Balak to cast a stumbling-block before the sons of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols and to commit fornication.

title: Revelation of John 2:15
text: So you also have those who hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.

title: Revelation of John 2:16
text: Repent! But if not I will come to you quickly, and will fight with them by the sword of My mouth.

title: Revelation of John 2:17
text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes I will give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give to him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knows except he who receives [it].

title: Revelation of John 2:18
text: And to the angel of the church at Thyatira write: The Son of God, He who has His eyes like a flame of fire and His feet like burnished metal, says these things:

title: Revelation of John 2:19
text: I know your works and love and service and faith and your patience, and your works; and the last [to be] more than the first.

title: Revelation of John 2:20
text: But I have a few things against you because you allow that woman Jezebel to teach, she saying herself [to be] a prophetess, and to cause My servants to go astray, and to commit fornication, and to eat idol-sacrifices.

title: Revelation of John 2:21
text: And I gave her time that she might repent of her fornication, and she did not repent.

title: Revelation of John 2:22
text: Behold, I am throwing her into a bed, and those who commit adultery with her into great affliction, unless they repent of their deeds.

title: Revelation of John 2:23
text: And I will kill her children with death. And all the churches will know that I am He who searches the reins and hearts, and I will give to every one of you according to your works.

title: Revelation of John 2:24
text: But to you I say, and to the rest in Thyatira, as many as do not have this doctrine, and who have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak, I will put on you no other burden.

title: Revelation of John 2:25
text: But that which you have, hold fast until I come.

title: Revelation of John 2:26
text: And he who overcomes and keeps My works to the end, to him I will give power over the nations.

title: Revelation of John 2:27
text: And he will rule them with a rod of iron, as the vessels [of a potter] they will be broken to pieces, even as I received from My Father.

title: Revelation of John 2:28
text: And I will give him the Morning Star.

title: Revelation of John 2:29
text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

title: Revelation of John 3:1
text: And to the angel of the church in Sardis write: He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars says these things. I know your works, that you have a name that you live, and are dead.

title: Revelation of John 3:2
text: Be watchful and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die. For I have not found your works being fulfilled before God.

title: Revelation of John 3:3
text: Remember then how you have received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. Therefore if you will not watch, I will come upon you as a thief, and you will not know what hour I will come upon you.

title: Revelation of John 3:4
text: You have a few names even in Sardis who have not defiled their garments. And they will walk with Me in white, for they are worthy.

title: Revelation of John 3:5
text: The one who overcomes, that one will be clothed in white clothing. And I will not blot out his name out of the Book of Life, but I will confess his name before My Father and before His angels.

title: Revelation of John 3:6
text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

title: Revelation of John 3:7
text: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: He who is holy, He who is true, He who has the key of David, He who opens and no one shuts; and shuts and no one opens, says these things:

title: Revelation of John 3:8
text: I know your works. Behold, I have given before you an open door, and no one can shut it. For you have a little strength and have kept My word and have not denied My name.

title: Revelation of John 3:9
text: Behold, I will give out of those of the synagogue of Satan, those saying themselves to be Jews and are not, but lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.

title: Revelation of John 3:10
text: Because you have kept the word of My patience, I also will keep you from the hour of temptation which will come upon all the world, to try those who dwell upon the earth.

title: Revelation of John 3:11
text: Behold, I come quickly. Hold fast to that which you have, so that no one may take your crown.

title: Revelation of John 3:12
text: Him who overcomes I will make him a pillar in the temple of My God, and he will go out no more. And I will write upon him the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God, New Jerusalem, which comes down out of Heaven from My God, and My new name.

title: Revelation of John 3:13
text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

title: Revelation of John 3:14
text: And to the angel of the church of the Laodicea write: The Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the Head of the creation of God, says these things:

title: Revelation of John 3:15
text: I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I would that you were cold or hot.

title: Revelation of John 3:16
text: So because you are lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will vomit you out of My mouth.

title: Revelation of John 3:17
text: Because you say, I am rich and increased with goods and have need of nothing, and do not know that you are wretched and miserable and poor and blind and naked,

title: Revelation of John 3:18
text: I counsel you to buy from Me gold tried in the fire, so that you may be rich; and white clothing, so that you may be clothed, and [so that] the shame of your nakedness does not appear. And anoint your eyes with eye salve, so that you may see.

title: Revelation of John 3:19
text: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten; therefore be zealous and repent.

title: Revelation of John 3:20
text: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and will dine with him and he with Me.

title: Revelation of John 3:21
text: To him who overcomes I will grant to sit with Me in My throne, even as I also overcame and have sat down with My Father in His throne.

title: Revelation of John 3:22
text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

title: Revelation of John 4:1
text: After these things I looked, and behold, a door [was] opened in Heaven. And the first voice which I heard [was] as it were of a trumpet talking with me, saying, Come up here, and I will show you what must occur after these things.

title: Revelation of John 4:2
text: And immediately I became in spirit. And behold, a throne was set in Heaven, and [One] sat upon the throne.

title: Revelation of John 4:3
text: And He who sat there looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. And a rainbow [was] around the throne, looking like an emerald.

title: Revelation of John 4:4
text: And around the throne [I saw] twenty-four thrones. And on the thrones I saw twenty-four elders sitting, clothed in white clothing. And they had crowns of gold on their heads.

title: Revelation of John 4:5
text: And out of the throne came lightnings and thunderings and voices. And seven lamps of fire [were] burning in front of the throne, which are the seven spirits of God.

title: Revelation of John 4:6
text: And a sea of glass [was] in front of the throne, like crystal. And in [the] midst of the throne, and around the throne, [were] four living creatures, full of eyes in front and behind.

title: Revelation of John 4:7
text: And the first living creature [was] like a lion, and the second living creature like a calf, and the third living creature had the face of a man, and the fourth living creature like a flying eagle.

title: Revelation of John 4:8
text: And each one of the four living creatures had six wings about [him], and within being full of eyes. And they had no rest day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God, the Almighty, who was and is and [is] to come.

title: Revelation of John 4:9
text: And whenever the living creatures gave glory and honor and thanks to Him who sat on the throne, who lives forever and ever,

title: Revelation of John 4:10
text: the twenty-four elders fell down before the One sitting on the throne. And they worshiped Him who lives for ever and ever, and threw their crowns before the throne, saying,

title: Revelation of John 4:11
text: O Lord, You are worthy to receive glory and honor and power, because You created all things, and for Your will they are and were created.

title: Revelation of John 5:1
text: And I saw a book on the right of Him sitting on the throne, written inside and on the back, sealed with seven seals.

title: Revelation of John 5:2
text: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book and to loosen its seals?

title: Revelation of John 5:3
text: And no one in Heaven, nor on the earth, nor under the earth, was able to open the book or to look at it.

title: Revelation of John 5:4
text: And I wept very much, because no one was found worthy to open and to read the book, nor to look at it.

title: Revelation of John 5:5
text: And one of the elders said to me, Do not weep. Behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has prevailed to open the book and to loose the seven seals of it.

title: Revelation of John 5:6
text: And I looked, and lo, in [the] midst of the throne and of the four living creatures, amidst the elders, a Lamb stood, as if it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

title: Revelation of John 5:7
text: And He came and took the book out of the right [hand] of Him sitting on the throne.

title: Revelation of John 5:8
text: And when He had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having harps and golden vials full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

title: Revelation of John 5:9
text: And they sang a new song, saying, You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for You were slain and have redeemed us to God by Your blood out of every kindred and tongue and people and nation.

title: Revelation of John 5:10
text: And You made us kings and priests to our God, and we will reign over the earth.

title: Revelation of John 5:11
text: And I looked, and I heard the voice of many angels around the throne, and the living creatures and the elders. And the number of them was myriads and myriads, and thousands of thousands,

title: Revelation of John 5:12
text: saying with a great voice, Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing.

title: Revelation of John 5:13
text: And I heard every creature which is in the Heaven and on the earth, and under the earth, and those that are in the sea, and all who are in them, saying, Blessing and honor and glory and power be to Him sitting on the throne, and to the Lamb forever and ever.

title: Revelation of John 5:14
text: And the four living creatures said, Amen. And the twenty-four elders fell down and worshiped [the] One living forever and ever.

title: Revelation of John 6:1
text: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures like a sound of thunder, saying, Come and see.

title: Revelation of John 6:2
text: And I saw. And behold a white horse! And he sitting on it had a bow. And a crown was given to him, and he went forth conquering and to conquer.

title: Revelation of John 6:3
text: And when He had opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, Come and see.

title: Revelation of John 6:4
text: And another, a red horse, went out. And power was given to him sitting on it, to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. And there was given to him a great sword.

title: Revelation of John 6:5
text: And when He had opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, Come and see. And I looked, and lo, a black horse. And he sitting on it had a balance in his hand.

title: Revelation of John 6:6
text: And I heard a voice in [the] midst of the four living creatures say, A choenix of wheat [for] a denarius, and three choenixes of barley [for] a denarius. And do not hurt the oil and the wine.

title: Revelation of John 6:7
text: And when He had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, Come and see.

title: Revelation of John 6:8
text: And I looked, and behold, a pale horse. And the name of him sitting on it [was] Death, and Hell followed with him. And authority was given to them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with the sword and with hunger and with death and by the beasts of the earth.

title: Revelation of John 6:9
text: And when He had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held.

title: Revelation of John 6:10
text: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, Until when, Master, holy and true, do You not judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?

title: Revelation of John 6:11
text: And white robes were given to each one of them. And it was said to them that they should rest yet for a little time, until both their fellow servants and their brothers (those about to be killed as they [were]) should have their number made complete.

title: Revelation of John 6:12
text: And when He had opened the sixth seal, I looked, and behold, there was a great earthquake. And the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became like blood.

title: Revelation of John 6:13
text: And the stars of heaven fell to the earth, even as a fig tree casts her untimely figs when she is shaken by a mighty wind.

title: Revelation of John 6:14
text: And [the] heaven departed like a scroll when it is rolled together. And every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

title: Revelation of John 6:15
text: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every freeman, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains.

title: Revelation of John 6:16
text: And they said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us and hide us from [the] face of Him sitting on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb;

title: Revelation of John 6:17
text: for the great day of His wrath has come, and who will be able to stand?

title: Revelation of John 7:1
text: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth so that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.

title: Revelation of John 7:2
text: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God. And he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,

title: Revelation of John 7:3
text: saying, Do not hurt the earth or the sea or the trees until we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.

title: Revelation of John 7:4
text: And I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred [and] forty-four thousands, having been sealed out of every tribe of the sons of Israel.

title: Revelation of John 7:5
text: Out of the tribe of Judah, twelve thousand were sealed. Out of the tribe of Reuben, twelve thousand were sealed. Out of the tribe of Gad, twelve thousand had been sealed.

title: Revelation of John 7:6
text: Out of the tribe of Asher, twelve thousand had been sealed. Out of the tribe of Naphtali, twelve thousand had been sealed. Out of the tribe of Manasseh, twelve thousand had been sealed.

title: Revelation of John 7:7
text: Out of the tribe of Simeon, twelve thousand had been sealed. Out of the tribe of Levi, twelve thousand had been sealed. Out of the tribe of Issachar, twelve thousand had been sealed.

title: Revelation of John 7:8
text: Out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve thousand had been sealed. Out of the tribe of Joseph, twelve thousand had been sealed. Out of the tribe of Benjamin, twelve thousand had been sealed.

title: Revelation of John 7:9
text: After these things I looked, and lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, out of all nations and kindreds and people and tongues, stood before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, with palms in their hands.

title: Revelation of John 7:10
text: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God sitting on the throne, and to the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 7:11
text: And all the angels stood around the throne, and the elders, and the four living creatures, and they fell before the throne on their faces and worshiped God,

title: Revelation of John 7:12
text: saying, Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanksgiving and honor and power and might [be] to our God forever and ever. Amen.

title: Revelation of John 7:13
text: And one of the elders answered, saying to me, Who are these who are arrayed in white robes, and from where do they come?

title: Revelation of John 7:14
text: And I said to him, Sir, you know. And he said to me, These are the ones who came out of great tribulation and have washed their robes, and have whitened them in the blood of the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 7:15
text: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve Him day and night in His temple. And He sitting on the throne will dwell among them.

title: Revelation of John 7:16
text: They will not hunger any more, nor thirst any more, nor will the sun light on them, nor any heat.

title: Revelation of John 7:17
text: For the Lamb who is in the midst of the throne will feed them and will lead them to [the] fountains of living waters. And God will wipe away all tears from their eyes.

title: Revelation of John 8:1
text: And when He opened the seventh seal, there was silence in Heaven for about half an hour.

title: Revelation of John 8:2
text: And I saw the seven angels who stood before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

title: Revelation of John 8:3
text: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer. And many incenses were given to him, so that he should offer [it] with the prayers of all saints on the golden altar before the throne.

title: Revelation of John 8:4
text: And the smoke of the incense [which came] with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God from the angel's hand.

title: Revelation of John 8:5
text: And the angel took the censer and filled it with fire from the altar, and cast [it] into the earth. And voices and thunderings and lightnings and an earthquake occurred.

title: Revelation of John 8:6
text: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

title: Revelation of John 8:7
text: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mixed with blood, and they were cast on the earth. And the third [part] of trees was burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

title: Revelation of John 8:8
text: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea. And the third [part] of the sea became blood.

title: Revelation of John 8:9
text: And the third [part] of the creatures in the sea, those having souls, died; and the third [part] of the ships was destroyed.

title: Revelation of John 8:10
text: And the third angel sounded, and a great star burning like a lamp fell from the heaven, and it fell on the third [part] of the rivers and on the fountains of waters.

title: Revelation of John 8:11
text: And the name of the star is called Wormwood, and a third [part] of the waters became wormwood. And many men died from the waters, because they were made bitter.

title: Revelation of John 8:12
text: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third [part] of the sun was stricken, and the third [part] of the moon, and the third [part] of the stars, so that the third [part] of them was darkened, and the day did not appear for a third [part] of it, and the night also.

title: Revelation of John 8:13
text: And I saw and I heard one angel flying in mid-heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe! Woe! Woe to the inhabitants of the earth, from the rest of the voices of the trumpet of the three angels being about to sound!

title: Revelation of John 9:1
text: And the fifth angel sounded. And I saw a star fall from the heaven to the earth, and it was given the key to the bottomless pit.

title: Revelation of John 9:2
text: And it opened the bottomless pit. And there arose a smoke out of the pit, like the smoke of a great furnace. And the sun and air were darkened because of the smoke of the pit.

title: Revelation of John 9:3
text: And out of the smoke came forth locusts onto the earth. And authority was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have authority.

title: Revelation of John 9:4
text: And they were commanded not to hurt the grass of the earth, or any green thing, or any tree, but only those men who do not have the seal of God in their foreheads.

title: Revelation of John 9:5
text: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months. And their torment [was] like a scorpion's torment when he stings a man.

title: Revelation of John 9:6
text: And in those days men will seek death and will not find it. And they will long to die, and death will flee from them.

title: Revelation of John 9:7
text: And the shapes of the locusts [were] like horses prepared for battle. And on their heads were as it [were] crowns like gold, and their faces [were] like the faces of men.

title: Revelation of John 9:8
text: And they had hairs like the hairs of women, and their teeth were like [the teeth] of lions.

title: Revelation of John 9:9
text: And they had breastplates like breastplates of iron. And the sound of their wings [was] like the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.

title: Revelation of John 9:10
text: And they had tails like scorpions, and there were stings in their tails. And their authority [was] to hurt men five months.

title: Revelation of John 9:11
text: And they had a king over them, the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue [is] Abaddon, but in Greek his name [is] Apollyon.

title: Revelation of John 9:12
text: The first woe is past. Behold, after these things yet come two woes.

title: Revelation of John 9:13
text: And the sixth angel sounded his trumpet. And I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar before God,

title: Revelation of John 9:14
text: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, Loose the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates.

title: Revelation of John 9:15
text: And the four angels were loosed, who were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, in order to slay the third [part] of men.

title: Revelation of John 9:16
text: And the number of the armies of the horsemen [was] two myriads of myriads. And I heard their number.

title: Revelation of John 9:17
text: And so I saw the horses in the vision, and those sitting on them, having breastplates of fire, even dusky red and brimstone. And the heads of the horses [were] like the heads of lions. And out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.

title: Revelation of John 9:18
text: By these three the third [part] of men was killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone which issued out of their mouths.

title: Revelation of John 9:19
text: For their authority is in their mouth and in their tails. For their tails [were] like serpents with heads, and with them they do harm.

title: Revelation of John 9:20
text: And the rest of the men who were not killed by these plagues [still] did not repent of the works of their hands, that they should not worship demons, and golden, and silver, and bronze, and stone, and wooden idols (which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk).

title: Revelation of John 9:21
text: And they did not repent of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.

title: Revelation of John 10:1
text: And I saw another mighty angel coming down out of the heaven, clothed with a cloud. And a rainbow [was] on his head, and his face [was] as the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

title: Revelation of John 10:2
text: And he had a little book open in his hand. And he set his right foot on the sea and [his] left [foot] on the earth.

title: Revelation of John 10:3
text: And he cried with a loud voice, like a lion roaring. And when he had cried, seven thunders spoke their sounds.

title: Revelation of John 10:4
text: And when the seven thunders spoke their sounds, I was about to write. And I heard a voice from Heaven saying to me, Seal up what things the seven thunders spoke, and do not write these things.

title: Revelation of John 10:5
text: And the angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the earth lifted his hand to the heaven,

title: Revelation of John 10:6
text: and swore by Him who lives forever and ever, who created the heaven and the things in it, and the earth and the things in it, and the sea and the things in it, that there should no longer be time.

title: Revelation of John 10:7
text: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he will begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as He has declared to His servants the prophets.

title: Revelation of John 10:8
text: And the voice which I heard from Heaven spoke to me again, and said, Go, take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the earth.

title: Revelation of John 10:9
text: And I went to the angel and said to him, Give me the little book. And he said to me, Take [it] and eat it up, and it will make your belly bitter, but it will be sweet as honey in your mouth.

title: Revelation of John 10:10
text: And I took the little book out of the angel's hand and ate it up. And it was sweet as honey in my mouth, and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was made bitter.

title: Revelation of John 10:11
text: And he said to me, You must prophesy again before many peoples and nations and tongues and kings.

title: Revelation of John 11:1
text: And a reed like a rod was given to me. And the angel stood, saying, Rise up and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

title: Revelation of John 11:2
text: But leave out the court which is outside the temple, and do not measure it, for it was given to the nations. And they will trample the holy city forty-two months.

title: Revelation of John 11:3
text: And I will give [power] to My two witnesses, and they will prophesy a thousand, two hundred and sixty days, clothed [in] sackcloth.

title: Revelation of John 11:4
text: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands standing before the God of the earth.

title: Revelation of John 11:5
text: And if anyone will hurt them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. And if anyone will hurt them, so it is right for him to be killed.

title: Revelation of John 11:6
text: These have authority to shut up the heaven, that it may not rain in the days of their prophecy. And they have authority over waters to turn them to blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

title: Revelation of John 11:7
text: And when they complete their testimony, the beast coming up out of the abyss will make war against them and will overcome them and kill them.

title: Revelation of John 11:8
text: And their bodies [will lie] in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.

title: Revelation of John 11:9
text: And many of the peoples and tribes and tongues and nations will see their dead bodies three days and a half, and they will not allow their dead bodies to be put in tombs.

title: Revelation of John 11:10
text: And the ones who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, and will make merry, and will send one another gifts, because these two prophets tormented those living on the earth.

title: Revelation of John 11:11
text: And after three days and a half, a spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. And great fear fell on those seeing them.

title: Revelation of John 11:12
text: And they heard a great voice from Heaven saying to them, Come up here. And they went up to Heaven in a cloud, and their enemies watched them.

title: Revelation of John 11:13
text: And in that hour a great earthquake occurred, and the tenth [part] of the city fell. And seven thousand names of men were slain in the earthquake. And the rest were frightened and gave glory to the God of Heaven.

title: Revelation of John 11:14
text: The second woe passed away. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.

title: Revelation of John 11:15
text: And the seventh angel sounded. And there were great voices in Heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world have become [the kingdoms] of our Lord, and of His Christ. And He will reign forever and ever.

title: Revelation of John 11:16
text: And the twenty-four elders sitting before God on their thrones, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

title: Revelation of John 11:17
text: saying, We thank You, O Lord God Almighty, who are, and who was, and who is coming, because You took Your great power and reigned.

title: Revelation of John 11:18
text: And the nations were full of wrath, and Your wrath came, and the time of the judging of the dead, and to give the reward to Your servants the prophets, and to the saints, and to the ones fearing Your name, to the small and to the great, and to destroy those destroying the earth.

title: Revelation of John 11:19
text: And the temple of God was opened in Heaven, and there was seen in His temple the ark of His covenant, and occurred lightnings and voices, and thunders and an earthquake, and a great hail.

title: Revelation of John 12:1
text: And there appeared a great sign in the heavens, a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon was under her feet, and a crown of twelve stars on her head,

title: Revelation of John 12:2
text: and having [a babe] in womb, she cries, being in travail, having been distressed to bear.

title: Revelation of John 12:3
text: And another sign was seen in the heavens. And behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns and seven crowns on his heads!

title: Revelation of John 12:4
text: And his tail drew the third [part] of the stars of heaven, and cast them onto the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman being about to bear, so that when she bears he might devour her child.

title: Revelation of John 12:5
text: And she bore a son, a male, who is going to rule all nations with a rod of iron. And her child was caught up to God and [to] His throne.

title: Revelation of John 12:6
text: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she had a place prepared by God, so that they might nourish her there a thousand, two hundred [and] sixty days.

title: Revelation of John 12:7
text: And there was war in Heaven. Michael and his angels warring against the dragon. And the dragon and his angels warred,

title: Revelation of John 12:8
text: but did not prevail. Nor was place found for them in Heaven any more.

title: Revelation of John 12:9
text: And the great dragon was cast out, the old serpent called Devil, and Satan, who deceives the whole world. He was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

title: Revelation of John 12:10
text: And I heard a great voice saying in Heaven, Now has come the salvation and power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of His Christ. For the accuser of our brothers is cast down, who accused them before our God day and night.

title: Revelation of John 12:11
text: And they overcame him because of the blood of the Lamb, and because of the word of their testimony. And they did not love their soul to the death.

title: Revelation of John 12:12
text: Therefore rejoice, O heavens, and those tabernacling in them. Woe to the inhabitants of the earth and in the sea! For the Devil came down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a little time.

title: Revelation of John 12:13
text: And when the dragon saw that he was cast to the earth, he persecuted the woman who bore the man [child].

title: Revelation of John 12:14
